jobs.title: Client Regulatory Reporting Specialist 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The role holder supports the complete, accurate, and timely execution of daily
regulatory reporting obligations in compliance with the following financial market
regulations: EMIR, MiFID II/MiFIR, FinMIA/ FinfraG, Bank of Israel and Shareholder
Rights Directive II (SRD2).

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Support the complete, accurate and timely execution of daily regulatory client reporting obligations in compliance with the financial market regulations of Bank of Israel, EMIR, MiFID II/MiFIR, FinfraG (Switzerland), and SRD2 (Shareholder Identification)

• Monitor and maintain high data quality standards by identifying discrepancies, initiating corrections, and escalating anomalies according to defined procedures

• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and compliance functions to resolve breaks, clarify reporting obligations, and implement corrective actions

• Support in business related change activities

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 2–3 years of experience in operations within a financial institution, ideally involving regulatory transaction reporting or transaction monitoring

• Solid understanding of investment products and their main characteristics

• Practical familiarity with European financial regulations, including EMIR, MiFID II/MiFIR, FinfraG, and SRD2 reporting requirements is a plus

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics or a related discipline

• Fluency in English (written and spoken); proficiency in German is strongly preferred

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel; experience with regulatory transaction reporting platforms is beneficial

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Vulnerability Manager / Security Specialist IT 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

This role supports the management of vulnerabilities and helps protect the Banks infrastructure from cyber threats. Remediation coordination across multiple technologies and ensuring the transparency of vulnerability status.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Vulnerability Management: Assessing host vulnerabilities identified by our Nexpose scanner across a diverse infrastructure landscape, including Windows Server, Linux, and Azure cloud environments. This includes analyzing vulnerability findings to review criticality and correlating them with other security data from our Splunk SIEM to prioritize remediation efforts

• Remediation Coordination: Working collaboratively with infrastructure owners across Network Operations, Server Administration, DevOpsEngineers, and Application Development teams to develop and implement Remediation Tasks for identified vulnerabilities and compliance gaps. This requires strong communication and negotiation skills to ensure timely and effective remediatio

• Reporting and Escalation: Providing regular updates on vulnerability status, compliance progress, key risks, and escalating critical issues to the appropriate management levels

• Process Improvement: Contributing to the continuous improvement of our vulnerability management and security compliance processes

YOUR PROFILE

• Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning tools

• Solid understanding of operating system security (Windows Server, Linux)

• Experience with virtualization technologies

• Familiarity with cloud security concepts (Azure experience is a plus)

• Knowledge of network security principles and devices (Cisco experience is a plus)

• Experience using ServiceNow or similar ITSM/GRC platforms

• Strong understanding of security frameworks and regulations

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field

• 3+ years of experience in a technical security role, with a strong focus on vulnerability management and security compliance

• Fluency in English

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

Questo ruolo supporta la gestione delle vulnerabilità e aiuta a proteggere le infrastrutture Banks dalle minacce informatiche. Coordinamento di riparazione attraverso più tecnologie e garantire la trasparenza dello stato di vulnerabilità.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Gestione della vulnerabilità: Valutare le vulnerabilità degli host identificate dal nostro scanner Nexpose attraverso un paesaggio di infrastrutture diversificato, tra cui Windows Server, Linux e Azure ambienti cloud. Questo include l'analisi dei risultati della vulnerabilità per rivedere la criticità e correlarli con altri dati di sicurezza dal nostro SIEM Splunk per priorità gli sforzi di bonifica

• Coordination Remediation: Lavorare collaborativamente con i proprietari di infrastrutture attraverso operazioni di rete, amministrazione server, DevOpsEngineers e team di sviluppo delle applicazioni per sviluppare e implementare le attività di bonifica per vulnerabilità identificate e lacune di conformità. Ciò richiede forti capacità di comunicazione e di negoziazione per garantire una tempestiva ed efficace remediatio

• Reporting e Escalation: Fornire aggiornamenti regolari sullo stato della vulnerabilità, sul progresso della conformità, sui rischi chiave e sull'escalation di problemi critici ai livelli di gestione appropriati

• Miglioramento del processo: contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi di gestione delle vulnerabilità e di conformità alla sicurezza

Il tuo progetto

• Esperienza pratica con strumenti di scansione vulnerabilità

• Solida comprensione della sicurezza del sistema operativo (Windows Server, Linux)

• Esperienza con le tecnologie di virtualizzazione

• Familiarità con i concetti di sicurezza cloud (l'esperienza Azzurra è un plus)

• Conoscenza dei principi e dei dispositivi di sicurezza della rete (l'esperienza di Cisco è un plus)

• Esperienza utilizzando ServiceNow o piattaforme ITSM/GRC simili

• Forte comprensione dei quadri di sicurezza e dei regolamenti

• Laurea in Informatica, sicurezza delle informazioni, o un campo relativo

• 3+ anni di esperienza in un ruolo di sicurezza tecnica, con una forte attenzione alla gestione delle vulnerabilità e alla conformità della sicurezza

• Fluency in inglese

jobs.title: Account Manager Intermediaries 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In addition to the Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Intermediaries & Family Offices role profile, the Account Manager Intermediaries & Family Offices (AM INT) takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration. In contrast to the Relationship Manager (RM), the AM INT does not have an own client book. The AM INT reaches out to clients where appropriate in close collaboration with the RM. He/she demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients and the RM. The AM INT ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently, provides clients with relevant in- formation and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the AM INT acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients, RMs and Team Heads (THs) in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion, and Excellence) and thus, helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals and departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. The AM INT shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management:

• Ensures that accurate and high-quality client relationship documentation formalities are always met and maintained to a high standard including client identification documentation (CDB), account opening forms and other relevant legal forms

• Actively ensures that operational account management is undertaken professionally, with all tasks/system alerts cleared directly where possible or via RM if necessary

• Where appropriate is part of client meetings and even leads parts of the meeting (e.g. documentation formalities, compliance, other requests of the client) if case allows

• Actively maintains client key data in liaison with the RM to ensure CRM and other data sets are correct for good maintenance of the relationship

• Interacts with clients in an independent and professional manner in all aspects of account management

• Proactively takes the lead in supporting the RMs/TH in client relationship and all related tasks (systems, applications, processes, documents etc.), with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Ensures operational coverage and client interaction (not advice) within the team during absences

• Creates and provides clients with customized information, reports and statistics, etc.

YOUR PROFILE
Personal and Social Skills:

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with a high level of risk awareness

• Proactive and independent work approach

• Positive “can do” attitude and approaches challenges with an open mind

• Takes on extra responsibilities at own initiative

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Exceptional communication skills and always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Aims for excellence by finding ways to do things smarter, faster, better and is also not afraid to question a status quo

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform exceedingly well under pressure

• Team player

• High personal integrity and ethical behaviour

• Is a go-to person by e.g. helping colleagues, training other assistants, participating in the “Buddy Programme”

Professional & Technical Skills:

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Profound understanding of relevant products, services as well as tools in Intermediaries & Family Offices

• Advanced knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education & Experience:

• Either at least 5 years of experience as ARM or 3 years of experience as ARM and job-related higher degree (e.g. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), without counting the apprenticeship period

• Excellent language skills (verbal and written) in English. German and French a plus

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (on boarding of new clients, maintaining and extending current relationships)

• Successful completion of applicable internal AM Intermediaries & FO training programme

Oltre al profilo di ruolo di Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Intermediaries & Family Offices, il Account Manager Intermediaries & Family Offices (AM INT) prende possesso dell'amministrazione del conto, delle formalità di documentazione e delle attività nelle operazioni quotidiane e dei progetti che influiscono sull'amministrazione del conto. A differenza del Relationship Manager (RM), AM INT non ha un proprio libro client. L'AM INT raggiunge i clienti se del caso in stretta collaborazione con la RM. Egli dimostra eccellenti competenze professionali, personali e sociali quando si legano con i clienti e la RM. L'AM INT garantisce la gestione operativa dell'account cliente e interagisce con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni in modo indipendente, fornisce ai clienti una formazione in-formazione rilevante e supporta la RM nell'implementazione di soluzioni personalizzate. Inoltre, l'AM INT agisce come modello di ruolo nel portare la migliore qualità del servizio ai clienti, RM e Team Heads (THs) in modo veloce, professionale e amichevole, vivendo sempre i valori di Julius Baer (Care, Passione e Eccellenza) e, quindi, aiutando il team a gestire e crescere la sua attuale base clienti. Inserisce il feedback dei clienti per le persone e i dipartimenti pertinenti all'interno della Banca per promuovere il miglioramento continuo e l'adattamento rapido dei processi. L'AM INT mostra l'impegno professionale per garantire un'ottima amministrazione del conto, per i clienti e per la Banca ed è disposto ad andare il miglio in più.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Amministrazione e gestione clienti:

• Assicura che le formalità accurate e di alta qualità della documentazione dei rapporti con i clienti siano sempre soddisfatte e mantenute ad un elevato standard, tra cui la documentazione di identificazione del cliente (CDB), i moduli di apertura del conto e altre forme legali rilevanti

• Actively assicura che la gestione del conto operativo sia eseguita professionalmente, con tutte le attività/le notifiche del sistema cancellate direttamente se possibile o tramite RM se necessario

• Se del caso fa parte delle riunioni del cliente e conduce anche parti della riunione (ad esempio formalità di documentazione, conformità, altre richieste del cliente) se il caso permette

• Mantiene attivamente i dati chiave del cliente in collegamento con il RM per garantire che CRM e altri set di dati siano corretti per una buona manutenzione del rapporto

• Interagisce con i clienti in modo indipendente e professionale in tutti gli aspetti della gestione del conto

• Proattivamente prende il comando nel supportare i RM/TH nel rapporto cliente e tutte le attività correlate (sistemi, applicazioni, processi, documenti ecc.), con elevata qualità, precisione e tempestiva reattività.

• Assicura la copertura operativa e l'interazione del cliente (non consiglio) all'interno del team durante le assenze

• Crea e fornisce ai clienti informazioni, report e statistiche personalizzate, ecc.

Il tuo progetto
Competenze personali e sociali:

• Ottima adattabilità situazioniale (in grado di lavorare con RM e clienti da diversi background)

• Personalità amichevole, affidabile e discreta con un alto livello di consapevolezza del rischio

• Approccio di lavoro attivo e indipendente

• Positivo atteggiamento “può fare” e affronta le sfide con una mente aperta

• Prende su responsabilità extra di propria iniziativa

• Altamente orientato al servizio e appassionato di assistenza clienti

• Capacità comunicative eccezionali e comunica sempre in modo amichevole, competente e professionale

• Obiettivi per l'eccellenza trovando modi per fare le cose più intelligenti, più veloce, meglio e non ha anche paura di mettere in discussione uno status quo

• Sistematico, preciso e diligente stile di lavoro e la capacità di eseguire molto bene sotto pressione

• Giocatore di squadra

• Alta integrità personale e comportamento etico

• È una persona che aiuta i colleghi, formando altri assistenti, partecipando al “Programma di bilancio”

Competenze professionali e tecniche:

• Sonoro affinità con il mercato geografico coperto, cioè familiarità con l'ambiente giuridico e normativo e la consapevolezza culturale

• Una comprensione approfondita dei prodotti, dei servizi e degli strumenti pertinenti negli uffici intermedi e familiari

• Conoscenza avanzata dei mercati finanziari globali e degli attuali sviluppi nel settore

Istruzione e esperienza:

• O almeno 5 anni di esperienza come ARM o 3 anni di esperienza come ARM e livello superiore relativo al lavoro (ad esempio Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), senza contare il periodo di apprendistato

• Competenze linguistiche eccellenti (verbale e scritta) in inglese e mandarino. Tedesco e francese un plus.

• Provato record di traccia nel servizio clienti bancari con esigenze complesse (su imbarco di nuovi clienti, mantenendo e estendendo le relazioni correnti)

• Completamento del programma di formazione AM Intermediaries & FO applicabile

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completa attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro si possono trovare sul nostro sito Career.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In addition to the Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Intermediaries & Family Offices role profile, the Account Manager Intermediaries & Family Offices (AM INT) takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration. In contrast to the Relationship Manager (RM), the AM INT does not have an own client book. The AM INT reaches out to clients where appropriate in close collaboration with the RM. He/she demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients and the RM. The AM INT ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently, provides clients with relevant in- formation and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the AM INT acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients, RMs and Team Heads (THs) in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion, and Excellence) and thus, helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals and departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. The AM INT shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management:

• Ensures that accurate and high-quality client relationship documentation formalities are always met and maintained to a high standard including client identification documentation (CDB), account opening forms and other relevant legal forms

• Actively ensures that operational account management is undertaken professionally, with all tasks/system alerts cleared directly where possible or via RM if necessary

• Where appropriate is part of client meetings and even leads parts of the meeting (e.g. documentation formalities, compliance, other requests of the client) if case allows

• Actively maintains client key data in liaison with the RM to ensure CRM and other data sets are correct for good maintenance of the relationship

• Interacts with clients in an independent and professional manner in all aspects of account management

• Proactively takes the lead in supporting the RMs/TH in client relationship and all related tasks (systems, applications, processes, documents etc.), with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Ensures operational coverage and client interaction (not advice) within the team during absences

• Creates and provides clients with customized information, reports and statistics, etc.

YOUR PROFILE
Personal and Social Skills:

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with a high level of risk awareness

• Proactive and independent work approach

• Positive “can do” attitude and approaches challenges with an open mind

• Takes on extra responsibilities at own initiative

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Exceptional communication skills and always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Aims for excellence by finding ways to do things smarter, faster, better and is also not afraid to question a status quo

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform exceedingly well under pressure

• Team player

• High personal integrity and ethical behaviour

• Is a go-to person by e.g. helping colleagues, training other assistants, participating in the “Buddy Programme”

Professional & Technical Skills:

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Profound understanding of relevant products, services as well as tools in Intermediaries & Family Offices

• Advanced knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education & Experience:

• Either at least 5 years of experience as ARM or 3 years of experience as ARM and job-related higher degree (e.g. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), without counting the apprenticeship period

• Excellent language skills (verbal and written) in English. German and French a plus

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (on boarding of new clients, maintaining and extending current relationships)

• Successful completion of applicable internal AM Intermediaries & FO training programme

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Zusätzlich zum Rollenprofil des Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Intermediaries & Family Offices übernimmt der Account Manager Intermediaries & Family Offices (AM INT) die Verantwortung für die Kontoverwaltung, Dokumentationsformalitäten und Aufgaben im täglichen Betrieb und für Projekte, die sich auf die Kontoverwaltung auswirken. Im Gegensatz zum Relationship Manager (RM) verfügt der AM INT nicht über ein eigenes Kundenbuch. Die AM INT wendet sich gegebenenfalls an Kunden in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der RM. Er / sie zeigt hervorragende berufliche, persönliche sowie soziale Fähigkeiten bei der Verbindung mit Kunden und der RM. Die AM INT stellt die operative Kundenkontoverwaltung sicher und interagiert unabhängig mit internen sowie externen Stakeholdern, stellt den Kunden relevante In-Formation zur Verfügung und unterstützt die RM bei der Implementierung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen. Darüber hinaus fungiert der AM INT als Vorbild, um Kunden, RMs und Teamleitern (THs) schnell, professionell und freundlich die beste Servicequalität zu bieten, immer die Werte von Julius Bär (Care, Passion und Excellence) zu leben und somit dem Team zu helfen, seinen aktuellen Kundenstamm zu verwalten und auszubauen. Er leitet das Kundenfeedback an die relevanten Personen und Abteilungen innerhalb der Bank, um die kontinuierliche Verbesserung und schnelle Anpassung der Prozesse zu fördern. Die AM INT zeigt professionelles Engagement für eine hervorragende Verwaltung des Kontos, für Kunden sowie für die Bank und ist bereit, die extra Meile zu gehen.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG
Client Administration & Management:

• Gewährleistet, dass genaue und qualitativ hochwertige Dokumentationsformalitäten für Kundenbeziehungen immer erfüllt und auf einem hohen Standard gehalten werden, einschließlich Kundenidentifizierungsdokumentation (CDB), Kontoeröffnungsformularen und anderen relevanten Rechtsformen

• Aktiv stellt sicher, dass die operative Kontoverwaltung professionell durchgeführt wird, wobei alle Aufgaben / Systembenachrichtigungen nach Möglichkeit direkt oder bei Bedarf über RM gelöscht werden

• Gegebenenfalls Teil von Kundenbesprechungen ist und sogar Teile der Besprechung leitet (z. B. Dokumentationsformalitäten, Compliance, andere Anfragen des Kunden), wenn der Fall es zulässt

• Verwaltet aktiv die Kundenschlüsseldaten in Verbindung mit dem RM, um sicherzustellen, dass CRM und andere Datensätze für eine gute Aufrechterhaltung der Beziehung korrekt sind

• Interagiert mit Kunden in einer unabhängigen und professionellen Art und Weise in allen Aspekten der Kontoverwaltung

• Proaktiv übernimmt die Führung bei der Unterstützung der RMs / TH in der Kundenbeziehung und allen damit verbundenen Aufgaben (Systeme, Anwendungen, Prozesse, Dokumente usw.) mit hoher Qualität, Präzision und rechtzeitiger Reaktionsfähigkeit

• Gewährleistet operative Abdeckung und Kundeninteraktion (nicht Beratung) innerhalb des Teams während Abwesenheiten

• Erstellt und bietet Kunden maßgeschneiderte Informationen, Berichte und Statistiken usw.

IHR PROFIL
Persönliche und soziale Fähigkeiten:

• Hervorragende situative Anpassungsfähigkeit (in der Lage, mit RMs und Clients mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund zu arbeiten)

• Freundliche, vertrauenswürdige und diskrete Persönlichkeit mit hohem Risikobewusstsein

• Proaktiver und unabhängiger Arbeitsansatz

• Positive "Can Do" -Haltung und nähert sich Herausforderungen mit einem offenen Geist

• Übernimmt zusätzliche Verantwortung aus eigener Initiative

• Sehr serviceorientiert und leidenschaftlich über Kundenservice

• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kommuniziert immer freundlich, kompetent und professionell

• Zielt auf Exzellenz, indem man Wege findet, Dinge intelligenter, schneller und besser zu machen, und hat auch keine Angst, einen Status quo in Frage zu stellen

• Systematischer, präziser und fleißiger Arbeitsstil und die Fähigkeit, unter Druck überaus gut zu arbeiten

• Teamplayer

• Hohe persönliche Integrität und ethisches Verhalten

• Ist eine Anlaufstelle, indem Sie z.B. Kollegen helfen, andere Assistenten ausbilden, am „Buddy-Programm teilnehmen

Professionelle und technische Fähigkeiten:

• Solide Affinität zu dem/den abgedeckten geografischen Markt(en), d. h. Vertrautheit mit dem rechtlichen und regulatorischen Umfeld sowie kulturelles Bewusstsein

• Umfassendes Verständnis relevanter Produkte, Dienstleistungen sowie Tools in Intermediaries & Family Offices

• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse der globalen Finanzmärkte und aktuelle Entwicklungen in der Branche

Bildung & Erfahrung:

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als ARM oder 3 Jahre Erfahrung als ARM und berufsbezogener Hochschulabschluss (z.B. Bachelor, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), ohne die Ausbildungszeit zu zählen

• Hervorragende Sprachkenntnisse (verbal und schriftlich) in Englisch und Mandarin. Deutsch und Französisch ein Plus.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Betreuung von Bankkunden mit komplexen Bedürfnissen (Beim Boarding neuer Kunden, der Aufrechterhaltung und Erweiterung bestehender Beziehungen)

• Erfolgreicher Abschluss des internen AM Intermediaries & FO Trainingsprogramms

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

En plus du profil de rôle du gestionnaire de relations adjoint (ARM) Intermediaries & Family Offices, le gestionnaire de comptes Intermediaries & Family Offices (AM INT) prend en charge l'administration du compte, les formalités de documentation et les tâches dans les opérations quotidiennes et les projets touchant l'administration du compte. Contrairement au gestionnaire de relations (RM), l'INT AM n'a pas de propre carnet de clients. L'INT AM s'adresse aux clients, le cas échéant, en étroite collaboration avec la RM. Il/elle fait preuve d'excellentes compétences professionnelles, personnelles et sociales lors de la liaison avec les clients et la RM. L'INT AM assure la gestion opérationnelle du compte client et interagit de manière indépendante avec les intervenants internes et externes, fournit aux clients une formation pertinente et soutient la RM dans la mise en œuvre de solutions personnalisées. En outre, l'AM INT sert de modèle pour apporter la meilleure qualité de service aux clients, aux RM et aux chefs d'équipe (TH) de manière rapide, professionnelle et amicale, en vivant toujours les valeurs de Julius Baer (Care, Passion et Excellence) et en aidant ainsi l'équipe à gérer et à développer sa clientèle actuelle. Il transmet les commentaires des clients aux personnes et aux départements concernés de la Banque pour favoriser une amélioration continue et une adaptation rapide des processus. L'INT AM démontre son engagement professionnel à assurer une excellente administration du compte, aux clients ainsi qu'à la Banque et est prêt à aller au-delà.

Votre défi
Administration et gestion des clients :

• Veiller à ce que les formalités de documentation relatives aux relations avec les clients soient toujours exactes et de grande qualité et à ce qu'elles soient maintenues à un niveau élevé, y compris les documents d'identification des clients, les formulaires d'ouverture de compte et les autres formulaires juridiques pertinents

• Veiller activement à ce que la gestion des comptes opérationnels soit assurée de manière professionnelle, avec toutes les tâches/alertes système qui sont effacées directement si possible ou par RM si nécessaire.

• Le cas échéant, il fait partie des réunions du client et dirige même des parties de la réunion (par exemple, formalités de documentation, conformité, autres demandes du client) si le cas le permet

• Maintenez activement les données clés du client en liaison avec la RM pour s'assurer que le CRM et les autres ensembles de données sont corrects pour le bon maintien de la relation

• Interagit avec les clients de manière indépendante et professionnelle dans tous les aspects de la gestion de compte

• Prise en charge proactive des RM/TH dans la relation client et toutes les tâches connexes (systèmes, applications, processus, documents, etc.), avec une haute qualité, précision et réactivité en temps opportun

• Assurer la couverture opérationnelle et l'interaction des clients (pas de conseils) au sein de l'équipe pendant les absences

• Crée et fournit aux clients des informations, des rapports et des statistiques personnalisés, etc.

VOTRE PROFIL
Compétences personnelles et sociales :

• Excellente adaptabilité situationnelle (possible de travailler avec des RM et des clients de divers horizons)

• Personnalité amicale, fiable et discrète avec un niveau élevé de sensibilisation aux risques

• Approche de travail proactive et indépendante

• L'attitude positive peut faire et approche les défis avec un esprit ouvert

• Prend des responsabilités supplémentaires de sa propre initiative

• Hautement axé sur le service et passionné par le service client

• Compétences de communication exceptionnelles et communication toujours amicale, compétente et professionnelle

• Atteindre l'excellence en trouvant des façons de faire les choses plus intelligentes, plus rapides, mieux et n'a pas peur de remettre en question un statu quo

• Style de travail systématique, précis et diligent et capacité à effectuer des performances extrêmement bonnes sous pression

• Joueur d'équipe

• Haute intégrité personnelle et comportement éthique

• S'agit-il d'une personne en aidant par exemple des collègues, en formant d'autres assistants, en participant au programme "Buddy"

Compétences professionnelles et techniques :

• Bonne affinité avec le(s) marché(s) géographique(s) couvert(s), c'est-à-dire connaissance de l'environnement juridique et réglementaire ainsi que sensibilisation culturelle

• Compréhension approfondie des produits, services et outils pertinents dans les agences intermédiaires et familiales

• Connaissance avancée des marchés financiers mondiaux et de l'évolution actuelle de l'industrie

Éducation et expérience :

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que MRA ou 3 ans d'expérience en tant que MRA et grade supérieur lié à l'emploi (par exemple baccalauréat, CFA/AZEK/CAIA), sans compter la période d'apprentissage

• Excellentes compétences linguistiques (verbales et écrites) en anglais et mandarin. Allemand et français un plus.

• Expérience éprouvée dans le service des clients bancaires ayant des besoins complexes (sur l'embarquement de nouveaux clients, le maintien et l'extension des relations actuelles)

• Achèvement réussi du programme interne de formation des intermédiaires AM et des FO

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète par l'intermédiaire de notre outil d'application en ligne. D'autres possibilités d'emploi intéressantes se trouvent sur notre site de carrière.
Ce n'est pas tout à fait ce que vous cherchez ? Configurez une alerte d'emploi en créant un compte candidat ici.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Kick-start your career with Julius Baer’s Graduate Programme – April 2027

Are you about to complete your master’s degree or recently graduated and ready to turn ambition into impact? At Julius Baer, we empower graduates to shape the future of wealth management.

Our 18-month Graduate Programme is designed to unleash your potential through three dynamic rotations, including an international assignment. You’ll gain hands-on experience, build a global network, and lay the foundation for a thriving career in wealth management.

Your team:

As part of the COO Digital Business Transformation unit you will join the AI Office, which plays a key role in accelerating the bank’s AI transformation. Working closely with stakeholders across functions, geographies, and business lines, you will help identify high-impact AI journeys & opportunities and drive their successful implementation and value realisation.
From shaping strategic priorities and influencing the AI roadmap to ensuring adoption and measurable business outcomes, you will operate at the intersection of innovation, business, and change.

What’s in it for you?

• Tailored career path: Develop expertise in your chosen field while growing personally and professionally
• Global perspective: Gain international experience and work with diverse teams
• Community & mentorship: Learn from industry leaders and peers and build a strong network
• Impactful work: Contribute to projects that make a real difference from day one

YOUR CHALLENGE
During the programme, you will:

• Analyse end-to-end client and business processes to identify opportunities for AI-driven re-design and enhanced efficiency

• Partner with stakeholders to re-imagine end to end journeys, challenge assumptions, build compelling value hypotheses, and ensure readiness for implementation

• Support the successful implementation of prioritised AI use cases, ensuring business outcomes are delivered

YOUR PROFILE

• Master's degree from a university or university of applied sciences with above-average grades in Business, Economics, Technology, Data Science, or another relevant field (graduation max. 12 months ago)

• Initial practical experience in the banking or financial services sector

• Passion for wealth management and a desire to create value beyond wealth

• A global mindset, excellent interpersonal skills, and a strong appetite for learning

• Fluency in English, with additional languages being a plus

• Eligibility to work in the country where you apply for the position

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Inizia la tua carriera con Julius Baer’s Graduate Programme – aprile 2027

Stai per completare il tuo master o recentemente laureato e pronto a trasformare l'ambizione in impatto? A Julius Baer, possiamo permettere ai laureati di plasmare il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Il nostro programma di laurea di 18 mesi è progettato per scatenare il vostro potenziale attraverso tre rotazioni dinamiche, tra cui un incarico internazionale. Avrai esperienza pratica, costruirai una rete globale, e getterà le basi per una carriera prospera nella gestione della ricchezza.

La tua squadra:

Nell’ambito dell’unità COO Digital Business Transformation vi unirete all’Ufficio AI, che svolge un ruolo chiave nell’accelerare la trasformazione AI della banca. Lavorando a stretto contatto con le parti interessate attraverso funzioni, geografie e linee di business, vi aiuterà a identificare i viaggi AI ad alto impatto e le opportunità e a guidare la loro implementazione e la realizzazione del valore di successo.
Dalla definizione di priorità strategiche e influenzando la roadmap AI per garantire l'adozione e risultati aziendali misurabili, si opera all'incrocio di innovazione, business e cambiamento.

Cosa c'è dentro per te?

• Sentiero di carriera su misura: Sviluppare competenze nel tuo campo scelto, crescendo personalmente e professionalmente
• Prospettive globali: Ottieni esperienza internazionale e lavora con diversi team
• Community & mentorship: Imparare dai leader del settore e coetanei e costruire una forte rete
• Lavoro d'impatto: contribuire a progetti che fanno una vera differenza dal primo giorno

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Durante il programma, si:

• Analizzare i processi aziendali e client end-to-end per identificare le opportunità di riprogettazione basata su AI e migliorare l'efficienza

• Partner con gli stakeholder per ri-immaginare i viaggi finali, sfidare le ipotesi, costruire ipotesi di valore convincenti, e garantire la disponibilità per l'implementazione

• Sostenere l'implementazione di casi di uso AI prioritari, assicurando risultati aziendali sono consegnati

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea magistrale da un'università o un'università di scienze applicate con gradi superiori alla media in Business, Economia, Tecnologia, Scienza dei dati, o un altro campo rilevante (graduazione max. 12 mesi fa)

• Esperienza pratica iniziale nel settore dei servizi bancari o finanziari

• Passione per la gestione della ricchezza e il desiderio di creare valore oltre la ricchezza

• Una mentalità globale, eccellenti competenze interpersonali, e un forte appetito per imparare

• Fluency in inglese, con lingue aggiuntive

• Ammissibilità di lavorare nel paese in cui si applica per la posizione

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completa attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro si possono trovare sul nostro sito Career.

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Your team

As part of Region Western Markets & Switzerland, you will join the ultra-high-net-worth individual (UHNWI) team. The team serves multi-generational families and entrepreneurs in an international environment, where relationships require long-term continuity and trust.
Given the complexity of UHNWI needs, the team coordinates bespoke structures rather than relying solely on standardised products.
To deliver these solutions, they draw on internal and external experts across tax, legal, trading, alternative investments, and structured finance to address the full spectrum of client needs.
Underpinning all of this is the Swiss banking tradition of discretion and service excellence; UHNWI teams are trained to handle sensitive family and financial matters with the utmost professionalism and privacy.

What’s in it for you?

- Tailored career path: Develop expertise in your chosen field while growing personally and professionally
- Global perspective: Gain international experience and work with diverse teams
- Community & mentorship: Learn from industry leaders and peers and build a strong network
- Impactful work: Contribute to projects that make a real difference from day one

YOUR CHALLENGE
During the programme, you will assist Relationship Managers in their daily tasks and specifically be responsible for:

• Opening, servicing, and maintaining client accounts, and ensuring client data remains accurate and up to date

• Coordinating the client onboarding process, collecting required documentation, and supporting compliance with know-your-client (KYC) and anti-money-laundering (AML) requirements

• Supporting the team in preparing client and prospect meeting documents, investment proposals across all asset classes, and ad-hoc analyses

• Transaction execution and follow-up: Processing client instructions, tracking pending transactions, and resolving operational issues with relevant internal teams

• Acting as a secondary contact for day-to-day client enquiries and providing general account-related information

• Preparing client reports and presentations, portfolio statements, and maintaining accurate records of client interactions and instructions

• Liaising with operational, compliance, legal, and product teams to ensure smooth and timely service delivery

YOUR PROFILE

• Master's degree from a university or university of applied sciences with above-average grades (graduated within the last 12 months)

• Fluency in German and English; additional languages are a plus

• Passion for client engagement, relationship building, and holistic wealth management

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a global mindset

• Systematic, precise, and diligent working style with the ability to perform well under pressure

• Proactive, independent approach with a positive attitude and openness to taking on extra responsibilities

• Friendly, trustworthy, and integer personality with a high level of risk awareness

• Strong appetite for learning and a drive for continuous improvement, including challenging the status quo

• Ability to adapt to diverse situations and work effectively with relationship managers and clients from varied backgrounds

• Eligibility to work in the country of application (Switzerland)

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Inizia la tua carriera con Julius Baer’s Graduate Programme – aprile 2027

Stai per completare il tuo master o recentemente laureato e pronto a trasformare l'ambizione in impatto? A Julius Baer, possiamo permettere ai laureati di plasmare il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Il nostro programma di laurea di 18 mesi è progettato per scatenare il vostro potenziale attraverso tre rotazioni dinamiche, tra cui un incarico internazionale. Avrai esperienza pratica, costruirai una rete globale, e getterà le basi per una carriera prospera nella gestione della ricchezza.

La tua squadra

Nell'ambito della Regione Western Markets & Svizzera, ti unirai al team ultra-high-net-worth individuale (UHNWI). Il team serve famiglie e imprenditori multigenerazionali in un ambiente internazionale, dove le relazioni richiedono continuità e fiducia a lungo termine.
Data la complessità delle esigenze UHNWI, il team coordina strutture su misura piuttosto che affidarsi esclusivamente a prodotti standardizzati.
Per fornire queste soluzioni, si rivolgono a esperti interni ed esterni attraverso fiscali, legali, commerciali, investimenti alternativi, e finanza strutturata per affrontare l'intero spettro delle esigenze del cliente.
Sottolineando tutto questo è la tradizione bancaria svizzera di discrezione e di eccellenza di servizio; i team UHNWI sono addestrati a gestire questioni familiari e finanziarie sensibili con la massima professionalità e privacy.

Cosa c'è dentro per te?

- Sentiero di carriera su misura: Sviluppare competenze nel tuo campo scelto, crescendo personalmente e professionalmente
- Prospettive globali: Ottieni esperienza internazionale e lavora con diversi team
- Community & mentorship: Imparare dai leader del settore e coetanei e costruire una forte rete
- Lavoro d'impatto: contribuire a progetti che fanno una vera differenza dal primo giorno

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Durante il programma, assisterai i responsabili delle relazioni nelle loro attività quotidiane e sarai specificamente responsabile di:

• Apertura, manutenzione e mantenimento di account client, e garantire i dati del cliente rimangono accurati e aggiornati

• Coordinare il processo di bordo del cliente, raccogliere la documentazione richiesta e sostenere la conformità con i requisiti di know-your-client (KYC) e anti-money-laundering (AML)

• Sostenere il team nella preparazione dei documenti di riunione dei clienti e delle prospettive, delle proposte di investimento in tutte le classi di attività e delle analisi ad-hoc

• Esecuzione delle transazioni e follow-up: Elaborazione delle istruzioni del cliente, monitoraggio delle transazioni in sospeso e risoluzione dei problemi operativi con i team interni rilevanti

• Agire come contatto secondario per richieste di clienti quotidiane e fornire informazioni generali relative al conto

• Preparazione dei report e delle presentazioni dei clienti, delle dichiarazioni di portafoglio e del mantenimento di registrazioni accurate delle interazioni e delle istruzioni dei clienti

• Liaising con team operativi, conformi, legali e di prodotto per garantire la consegna dei servizi fluidi e tempestivi

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea magistrale presso un'università o un'università di scienze applicate con gradi superiori alla media ( laureati negli ultimi 12 mesi)

• Fluency in tedesco e inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un plus

• Passione per il coinvolgimento del cliente, la costruzione di relazioni e la gestione della ricchezza olistica

• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali con una mentalità globale

• Sistematico, preciso e diligente stile di lavoro con la capacità di eseguire bene sotto pressione

• Approccio proattivo e indipendente con atteggiamento positivo e apertura all'assunzione di responsabilità extra

• Personalità amichevole, affidabile e integer con un alto livello di consapevolezza del rischio

• Forte appetito per l'apprendimento e una spinta per il miglioramento continuo, tra cui sfidare lo status quo

• Capacità di adattarsi a situazioni diverse e lavorare in modo efficace con i responsabili delle relazioni e i clienti da diversi background

• Ammissibilità al lavoro nel paese di applicazione (Svizzera)

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completa attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro si possono trovare sul nostro sito Career.
Non è questo che stai cercando? Impostare un avviso di lavoro creando un account candidato qui.

Dans le cadre de Region Western Markets & Suisse, vous rejoindrez l'équipe individuelle ultra-haute valeur nette (UHNWI). L'équipe sert les familles et les entrepreneurs multigénérationnels dans un environnement international où les relations exigent une continuité et une confiance à long terme.
Compte tenu de la complexité des besoins de l'UHNWI, l'équipe coordonne des structures sur mesure plutôt que de s'appuyer uniquement sur des produits normalisés.
Pour fournir ces solutions, ils font appel à des experts internes et externes dans les domaines fiscal, juridique, commercial, des investissements alternatifs et du financement structuré pour répondre à l'ensemble des besoins des clients.
Tout cela est sous-tendu par la tradition bancaire suisse de discrétion et d'excellence de service; les équipes de l'UHNWI sont formées pour traiter les questions familiales et financières sensibles avec le plus grand professionnalisme et la plus grande intimité.

- Perspective mondiale : acquérir une expérience internationale et travailler avec diverses équipes
- Communauté et mentorat : apprendre des leaders et des pairs de l'industrie et bâtir un réseau solide
- Travail efficace: contribuer à des projets qui font une réelle différence depuis le premier jour

Votre défi
Pendant le programme, vous assisterez les gestionnaires de relations dans leurs tâches quotidiennes et serez particulièrement responsable :

• Coordonner le processus d'embarquement du client, recueillir les documents requis et appuyer la conformité avec les exigences relatives à la connaissance de votre client et à la lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent

• Aider l'équipe à préparer des documents de réunion sur les clients et les perspectives, des propositions d'investissement pour toutes les catégories d'actifs et des analyses ad hoc

• Exécution et suivi des opérations : traitement des instructions du client, suivi des opérations en cours et règlement des problèmes opérationnels avec les équipes internes compétentes

• Agir à titre de contact secondaire pour les demandes quotidiennes des clients et fournir des renseignements généraux sur les comptes

• Préparer les rapports et les présentations des clients, les états du portefeuille et tenir des registres exacts des interactions avec les clients et des instructions

• Assurer la liaison avec les équipes opérationnelles, de conformité, juridiques et de produits afin d'assurer une prestation de services en douceur et en temps opportun

• Excellente communication et compétences interpersonnelles avec un état d'esprit global

• Style de travail systématique, précis et diligent avec la capacité de bien fonctionner sous pression

• Une approche proactive et indépendante, avec une attitude positive et une ouverture à assumer des responsabilités supplémentaires

• Personnalité amicale, digne de confiance et entière avec un niveau élevé de sensibilisation au risque

• Un fort appétit pour l'apprentissage et un élan pour l'amélioration continue, y compris la remise en question du statu quo

• Aptitude à s'adapter à diverses situations et à travailler efficacement avec les gestionnaires de relations et les clients de divers horizons

• Admissibilité au travail dans le pays de candidature (Suisse)

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Kick-start your career with Julius Baer’s Graduate Programme – April 2027

Are you about to complete your master’s degree or recently graduated and ready to turn ambition into impact? At Julius Baer, we empower graduates to shape the future of wealth management.

Your team

As part of the CFO unit you will join the Treasury Corporate FX and Hedging Team, which plays a key role in managing the FX risk and hedge accounting for the bank.

What’s in it for you?

- Tailored career path: Develop expertise in your chosen field while growing personally and professionally
- Global perspective: Gain international experience and work with diverse teams
- Community & mentorship: Learn from industry leaders and peers and build a strong network
- Impactful work: Contribute to projects that make a real difference from day one

YOUR CHALLENGE
During the programme, you will:

• Prepare the daily macro hedge FX position report, gaining direct exposure to how the bank manages its FX risk

• Build hands-on expertise in FX hedging at an international financial institution by helping test a new FX risk management tool, feeding your findings directly into its development

• Support the month-end closing processes for interest rate risk (IRR) hedge accounting, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting

• Assist in setting up and maintaining IRR hedge accounting relationships

• Actively support the implementation of Murex MX.3, a leading hedge accounting platform and develop the automation of the hedge accounting processes

Treasury Singapore (international assignment)

• Prepare the daily FX positions to be booked to Zurich

• Build a detailed understanding of foreign currency flows across Asia

• Identify opportunities to align and optimize FX and IRR hedging practice across regions

Group Accounting and Reporting (local assignment)

• Deepen your knowledge of foreign currency accounting, including gaining a detailed understanding of the MCA (Multi-Currency Accounting) module of SAP

• Develop an understanding of the FX translation process (OCI translations) and the impact of net investment hedges on the FX mix of capital

• Collaborate with the Group Accounting team responsible for the disclosure of FX, IRR and hedge accounting in the annual financial statements

YOUR PROFILE

• Master's degree from a university or university of applied sciences with above-average grades in Financial Accounting and Reporting and Economics (graduation max. 12 months ago)

• Initial practical experience at a financial institution or corporate treasury and with accounting skills

• Passion for wealth management and a desire to create value beyond wealth

• A global mindset, excellent interpersonal skills, and a strong appetite for learning

• Fluency in English, with additional languages being a plus

• Eligibility to work in the country where you apply for the position

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Commencer votre carrière avec le programme d'études supérieures de Julius Baer, avril 2027

Êtes-vous sur le point de terminer votre master ou récemment diplômé et prêt à transformer l'ambition en impact ? Chez Julius Baer, nous autorisons les diplômés à façonner l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Notre programme d'études supérieures de 18 mois est conçu pour libérer votre potentiel grâce à trois rotations dynamiques, y compris une affectation internationale. Vous allez acquérir une expérience pratique, construire un réseau mondial et jeter les bases d'une carrière florissante dans la gestion de la richesse.

Votre équipe

Dans le cadre de l'unité CFO, vous rejoindrez la Treasury Corporate FX et l'équipe de couverture, qui joue un rôle clé dans la gestion du risque FX et la comptabilité de couverture pour la banque.

Qu'y a-t-il dedans pour vous ?

- Carrière adaptée : Développer l'expertise dans votre domaine choisi tout en développant personnellement et professionnellement
- Perspective mondiale : acquérir une expérience internationale et travailler avec diverses équipes
- Communauté et mentorat : apprendre des leaders et des pairs de l'industrie et bâtir un réseau solide
- Travail efficace: contribuer à des projets qui font une réelle différence depuis le premier jour

Votre défi
Pendant le programme, vous devrez :

• Préparer le rapport de position de la macro-haie FX quotidien, en obtenant une exposition directe à la façon dont la banque gère son risque FX

• Bâtir une expertise pratique en couverture FX auprès d'une institution financière internationale en aidant à tester un nouvel outil de gestion des risques FX, en intégrant vos conclusions directement dans son développement

• Soutenir les processus de clôture en fin de mois pour la comptabilité de couverture des risques de taux d'intérêt (RIR), en assurant une information financière exacte et opportune

• Aide à l'établissement et au maintien de relations de couverture IRR

• Soutenir activement la mise en œuvre de Murex MX.3, une plateforme de comptabilité de couverture leader et développer l'automatisation des processus de comptabilité de couverture

Trésorerie Singapour (affectation internationale)

• Préparer les positions quotidiennes FX à réserver à Zurich

• Bâtir une compréhension détaillée des flux de devises à travers l'Asie

• Identifier les possibilités d'harmoniser et d'optimiser les pratiques de couverture FX et IRR dans les régions

Comptabilité et rapports de groupe (affectation locale)

• Approfondissement de votre connaissance de la comptabilité en devises, y compris l'acquisition d'une compréhension détaillée du module MCA (Comptabilité en devises multiples) de SAP

• Développer une compréhension du processus de traduction FX (traductions OCI) et de l'impact des couvertures nettes d'investissement sur le mélange FX du capital

• Collaborer avec l'équipe de comptabilité du groupe chargée de la divulgation des données FX, IRR et Hedge Comptabilité dans les états financiers annuels

VOTRE PROFIL

• Maîtrise d'une université ou d'une université de sciences appliquées avec des notes supérieures à la moyenne en comptabilité financière et rapports et en économie (gradation max. 12 mois)

• Expérience pratique initiale dans une institution financière ou une trésorerie d'entreprise et avec des compétences en comptabilité

• Passion pour la gestion de la richesse et désir de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse

• Un état d'esprit global, d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et un fort appétit pour l'apprentissage

• Connaissance de l'anglais, les langues supplémentaires étant un plus

• Admissibilité au travail dans le pays où vous postulez au poste

Inizia la tua carriera con Julius Baer’s Graduate Programme – aprile 2027

Stai per completare il tuo master o recentemente laureato e pronto a trasformare l'ambizione in impatto? A Julius Baer, possiamo permettere ai laureati di plasmare il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Il nostro programma di laurea di 18 mesi è progettato per scatenare il vostro potenziale attraverso tre rotazioni dinamiche, tra cui un incarico internazionale. Avrai esperienza pratica, costruirai una rete globale, e getterà le basi per una carriera prospera nella gestione della ricchezza.

La tua squadra
Nell’ambito dei Servizi di Operazioni Globali si unirà a Global Network Management, che svolge un ruolo chiave responsabile per la gestione e la strategia dei rapporti depositari e corrispondenti in denaro di Bank Julius Baer. In qualità di Global Network Management Specialist, sarete responsabili della gestione di questa rete di Agent Banks e avrete punti di contatto in tutta l'organizzazione globale e un impatto significativo sul successo dell'azienda.

Cosa c'è dentro per te?
• percorso di carriera: sviluppare competenze nel vostro campo scelto, crescendo personalmente e professionalmente
•Prospettive globali: Ottieni esperienza internazionale e lavora con diverse squadre
•Comunità & mentorship: Imparare dai leader del settore e coetanei e costruire una rete forte
•Ottimo lavoro: contribuire a progetti che fanno una vera differenza dal primo giorno
•Opportunità di sviluppare la comprensione dei processi di custodia e pagamento
•Esposizione di guadagno a molte aree della banca e la custodia interbanca e banca corrispondente in contanti

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Durante il programma, si:

• Svolgere un ruolo chiave nella gestione attiva dei servizi delle relazioni di Agent Bank, conducendo riunioni di servizio regolari, recensioni di servizi, due diligence, il monitoraggio attivo e la gestione della fornitura di servizi a Bank Julius Baer

• Sostegno alla negoziazione e alla gestione delle tasse, assicurando la comprensione dei costi, dell'evoluzione, nonché la generazione di idee e l'implementazione per raggiungere ottimizzazioni dei costi

• Sviluppare la supervisione dei contratti, la negoziazione e l'attuazione della documentazione necessaria per queste relazioni

• Collabora con gli stakeholder per identificare e fornire l'ottimizzazione continua del processo Front to Back in tutta la rete

• Costruire la comprensione degli sviluppi del mercato e degli agenti, le tendenze e le opportunità per Bank Julius Baer e la diffusione alle parti interessate

• Acquisire la comprensione delle regole di custodia e una forte capacità di applicare le conoscenze per sostenere con consulenza interna / consulenza per sostenere le esigenze aziendali e dei clienti

• Lavorare nel team per supportare i colleghi con mercati e compiti come e quando necessario

• Implementare le misure necessarie con colleghi interni ed esterni per rimediare a qualsiasi problema identificato per garantire la conformità del mercato

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea magistrale da un'università o università di scienze applicate con gradi superiori alla media in Business Management, Banking, e qualsiasi altro campo (graduazione max. 12 mesi fa)

• Esperienza pratica iniziale nel settore bancario, di consulenza o IT e con competenze di ottimizzazione dei processi

• Passione per la gestione della ricchezza e il desiderio di creare valore oltre la ricchezza

• Una mentalità globale, eccellenti competenze interpersonali, e un forte appetito per imparare

• Fluency in inglese e, con altre lingue essere un plus

• Ammissibilità di lavorare nel paese in cui si applica per la posizione

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Kick-start your career with Julius Baer’s Graduate Programme – April 2027

Are you about to complete your bachelor’s or master’s degree or recently graduated and ready to turn ambition into impact? At Julius Baer, we empower graduates to shape the future of wealth management.

Our 18-month Graduate Programme is designed to unleash your potential through three dynamic rotations, including an international assignment. You’ll gain hands-on experience, build a global network, and lay the foundation for a thriving career in wealth management.

Your team:

As part of Central Compliance you will join the Investment Controlling and Monitoring & Control teams which play a key role in ensuring regulatory compliance, effective investment oversight and strong control framework execution, with a focus on specific risk types.

What’s in it for you?

• Tailored career path: Develop expertise in your chosen field while growing personally and professionally
• Global perspective: Gain international experience and work with diverse teams
• Community & mentorship: Learn from industry leaders and peers and build a strong network
• Impactful work: Contribute to projects that make a real difference from day one

YOUR CHALLENGE
During the programme, you will rotate across three specialised control functions, gaining comprehensive insights into Custody Bank Control, Fund Control and Monitoring and Control Execution in Switzerland and Spain.

Custody Bank Control (Zurich)

• Contribute to oversight and control activities for Swiss collective investment schemes in the role of Custodian Bank, supporting compliance with CISA/KAG, applicable regulations, and fund-specific requirements

• Support the monitoring and review of investment activities and fund operations, helping to ensure compliance with investment restrictions and the accuracy of NAV calculations, distributions, transactions, and fund records.

• Gain exposure to governance reporting and stakeholder interactions while collaborating across teams to support effective fund governance and regulatory compliance.

Fund Control (Madrid)

• Support the monitoring of investment guidelines and regulatory requirements by reviewing fund restrictions, assessing breaches and exceptions, and collaborating with portfolio managers and other stakeholders on their resolution.

Monitoring and Control Execution (Zurich)

• Design & Assessment: Support the design, assessment, and enhancement of 2LoD controls covering key compliance risks, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and business practices

• Control Execution: Execute recurring compliance controls in a timely and accurate manner, with a primary focus on client suitability assessments, while gaining exposure to pricing practices, intermediary frameworks, and other defined risk areas

• Deficiency Management: Collaborate with Client-Facing Units to support the identification and remediation of control deficiencies, leveraging structured workflows and tracking actions through to completion

• Reporting & Analysis: Analyze, validate, and interpret control results and exception reports, contributing to management reporting and continuous improvement initiatives

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a university or university of applied sciences with above-average grades in Finance, Economics, Law or Business Information Technology or a related field (graduation max. 12 months ago)

• Initial practical experience through internships, working student positions or other relevant activities in Compliance, Risk Management, Fund Services or Asset Management combined with strong analytical skills and attention to detail

• Passion for wealth management and a desire to create value beyond wealth

• A global mindset, excellent interpersonal skills, and a strong appetite for learning

• Fluency in English and German, with additional languages being a plus

• Basic computer skills (Microsoft Office and common business applications) and an interest in data analysis and automation. Initial experience with Python, VBA, or SQL (e.g., through studies, personal projects, or professional experience) is desirable

• Eligibility to work in the country where you apply for the position

Commencer votre carrière avec le programme d'études supérieures de Julius Baer, avril 2027

Êtes-vous sur le point de terminer votre baccalauréat ou maîtrise ou récemment diplômé et prêt à transformer l'ambition en impact? Chez Julius Baer, nous autorisons les diplômés à façonner l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Dans le cadre de Central Compliance, vous rejoindrez les équipes de contrôle et de contrôle des investissements qui jouent un rôle clé dans la conformité réglementaire, la surveillance des investissements et l'exécution d'un cadre de contrôle solide, en mettant l'accent sur des types de risques spécifiques.

Votre défi
Au cours du programme, vous ferez pivoter trois fonctions de contrôle spécialisées, en obtenant un aperçu complet du contrôle de la Custody Bank, du contrôle des fonds et de la surveillance et de l'exécution du contrôle en Suisse et en Espagne.

Contrôle bancaire de la garde (Zurich)

• Contribuer aux activités de surveillance et de contrôle des systèmes suisses de placement collectif dans le rôle de la Banque dépositaire, en appuyant le respect de la CISA/KAG, des règlements applicables et des exigences propres aux fonds

• Appuyer la surveillance et l'examen des activités d'investissement et des opérations de fonds, en aidant à assurer le respect des restrictions en matière d'investissement et l'exactitude des calculs, des distributions, des transactions et des dossiers de fonds de NAV.

• Faire connaître les rapports sur la gouvernance et les interactions avec les intervenants tout en collaborant entre les équipes pour appuyer la gouvernance efficace des fonds et la conformité à la réglementation.

Contrôle des fonds (Madrid)

Contrôle et exécution (Zurich)

• Rapports et analyses : Analyser, valider et interpréter les résultats des contrôles et les rapports d'exception, contribuant ainsi aux rapports de gestion et aux initiatives d'amélioration continue

VOTRE PROFIL

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise d'une université ou d'une université de sciences appliquées avec des notes supérieures à la moyenne en finance, économie, droit ou technologie de l'information des affaires ou un domaine connexe (gradation max. 12 mois)

You’ll also have regular opportunities to build expertise in cutting-edge areas such as artificial intelligence, scalable data systems, and responsible innovation

What’s in it for you?

• Contribute to the development and validation of AI/ML models that enhance client experience and operational efficiency in a regulated banking environment

• Work on real-world use cases such as natural language processing, predictive analytics, and personalization, while ensuring compliance with strict data privacy and security standards

• Collaborate with ML engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into robust, production-ready solutions

• Analyze large, high-quality financial datasets to uncover insights and improve model performance, accuracy, and fairness — including visualization and interpretation of model outputs

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Démarrez votre carrière avec le programme d'études supérieures de Julius Baer, avril 2027

Êtes-vous sur le point de terminer votre master ou récemment diplômé et prêt à transformer l'ambition en impact ? Chez Julius Baer, nous autorisons les diplômés à façonner l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Notre programme d'études supérieures de 18 mois est conçu pour libérer votre potentiel grâce à trois rotations dynamiques, y compris une affectation internationale. Vous allez acquérir une expérience pratique, construire un réseau mondial et jeter les bases d'une carrière florissante dans la gestion de la richesse.

Votre équipe
Rejoignez la division COO et devenez membre de l'IA & ML ART (Agile Release Train) de Julius Baer et rejoignez une ou plusieurs équipes telles que les opérations d'apprentissage automatique (p. ex., des modèles de déploiement/train sur nos grappes GPU), l'IA embarquée (automatisant par l'IA), Source de richesse ou JAI (notre solution interne de chat AI) et travaillez sur des sujets d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA de pointe.

En ce sens, vous aurez l'occasion de jouer un rôle central dans l'avancement de la transformation des affaires et du numérique de Julius Baer en appliquant la science des données et l'apprentissage automatique aux défis bancaires du monde réel en participant directement à des projets d'analyse de bout en bout, vous travaillerez tout au long du cycle de vie - de l'idée et de l'analyse exploratoire au développement de modèles, au déploiement et aux opérations en cours.

Vous n'avez gagné qu'à construire des modèles — vous les verrez déployés dans la production et surveillés activement dans des environnements vivants et vous acquerrez une expérience pratique avec l'infrastructure moderne et la pile technologique Julius Baer (JB), permettant des solutions d'IA évolutives et fiables.

Et vous travaillerez dans un environnement simple et agile, vous collaborerez avec des collègues expérimentés qui soutiennent l'apprentissage et la croissance continus. Vous aurez aussi régulièrement l'occasion de développer des compétences dans des domaines de pointe comme l'intelligence artificielle, les systèmes de données évolutives et l'innovation responsable.

Qu'y a-t-il dedans pour vous ?
•Tailored parcours de carrière: Développer l'expertise dans votre domaine choisi tout en développant personnellement et professionnellement
•Perspective mondiale: acquérir une expérience internationale et travailler avec diverses équipes
•Communauté et mentorat: apprendre des dirigeants et des pairs de l'industrie et bâtir un réseau solide
•Un travail efficace: contribuer à des projets qui font une réelle différence depuis le premier jour

Votre défi
Pendant le programme, vous devrez :

• Identifier les possibilités pour l'IA et la science des données de stimuler les innovations fondées sur les données dans la gestion de la richesse

• Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la validation de modèles d'IA/ML qui améliorent l'expérience client et l'efficacité opérationnelle dans un environnement bancaire réglementé

• Travailler sur des cas d'utilisation dans le monde réel tels que le traitement en langage naturel, l'analyse prédictive et la personnalisation, tout en assurant le respect des normes strictes de confidentialité et de sécurité des données

• Collaborer avec les ingénieurs ML, les data scientists et les intervenants commerciaux pour traduire des exigences complexes en solutions robustes et prêtes à la production

• Analyser de grands ensembles de données financières de haute qualité pour découvrir des idées et améliorer la performance, l'exactitude et l'équité des modèles, y compris la visualisation et l'interprétation des extrants des modèles

• Participer à l'ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions d'apprentissage automatique, y compris le déploiement, la surveillance et les opérations en cours (MLOps), en assurant la fiabilité et l'évolutivité dans les environnements vivants

• S'engager avec une infrastructure de données moderne et la pile technologique Julius Baer (JB) pour construire et maintenir des pipelines d'analyse sûrs et efficaces

• Appuyer la gestion des risques par le biais d'une documentation exhaustive, de tests d'hypothèses et du respect des attentes réglementaires en matière de transparence et d'explicabilité

• Restez en avance sur les nouvelles tendances de l'IA/ML et appliquez des techniques innovantes de manière responsable dans les limites des réglementations bancaires

• Aider à favoriser une culture axée sur les données dans l'ensemble de l'organisation en partageant les connaissances et en favorisant les pratiques exemplaires en matière d'analyse et d'IA

VOTRE PROFIL

• Maîtrise d'une université ou d'une université de sciences appliquées avec des notes supérieures à la moyenne en AI, Data Science, Statistiques, Mathématiques, Physique, Informatique, ou un domaine quantitatif connexe (gradation max. 12 mois)

• L'expérience pratique initiale dans le secteur financier et l'expertise dans les produits bancaires et les marchés financiers sont un atout

• Passion pour la gestion de la richesse et désir de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse

• Un état d'esprit global, d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et un fort appétit pour l'apprentissage

• Connaissance de l'anglais et de l'allemand, les langues supplémentaires étant un plus

• Admissibilité au travail dans le pays où vous postulez au poste

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète par l'intermédiaire de notre outil d'application en ligne. D'autres possibilités d'emploi intéressantes se trouvent sur notre site de carrière.
Ce n'est pas tout à fait ce que vous cherchez ? Configurez une alerte d'emploi en créant un compte candidat ici.

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Kick-start your career with Julius Baer’s Graduate Programme – April 2027

Are you about to complete your master’s degree or recently graduated and ready to turn ambition into impact? At Julius Baer, we empower graduates to shape the future of wealth management.

Our 18-month Graduate Programme is designed to unleash your potential through three dynamic rotations, including an international assignment. You’ll gain hands-on experience, build a global network, and lay the foundation for a thriving career in wealth management.

Your team:

The Portfolio Reviews Specialist Team is responsible for providing scalable support to improve portfolio advisory quality and support recurring revenues.

He or she will be responsible for:
• Providing inputs from an asset allocation perspective
• Reviewing individual positions to identify risks and opportunities reflecting the view of the Global Asset Class Specialists, leveraging the value chain
• Helping scale portfolio action based on Global Asset Class Specialists’ recommendations
• Providing a more standardised advisory experience for Advice Premium clients, and helping retain and grow their assets with the Bank

What’s in it for you?

• Tailored career path: Develop expertise in your chosen field while growing personally and professionally
• Global perspective: Gain international experience and work with diverse teams
• Community & mentorship: Learn from industry leaders and peers and build a strong network
• Impactful work: Contribute to projects that make a real difference from day one

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Work collaboratively with the Global Asset Class Specialists and Relationship Managers to review and rebalance Advice Premium client portfolios

• Develop a scalable process to analyse Advice Premium client portfolios efficiently

• Develop and maintain a database of conviction ‘Buy’ ideas, as well as “Sell” recommendations

• Keep updated on changes in the Bank’s Research and CIO views

• Generate presentation materials (supplementary information, charts, tables, etc.) for Relationship Managers to discuss with their client

YOUR PROFILE

• Master's degree from a university or university of applied sciences with above-average grades in Banking & Finance (graduation max. 12 months ago)

• Initial practical experience in an Asset Class/ Product or Portfolio Management

• Passion for wealth management and a desire to create value beyond wealth

• A global mindset, excellent interpersonal skills, and a strong appetite for learning

• Fluency in English and German, with additional languages being a plus

• Eligibility to work in the country where you apply for the position
