jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Lead and develop the Enterprise Collaboration & Voice Solution team, ensuring the
reliable, secure, and cost-effective delivery of collaboration and communication services for the group (global responsibility).

Accountable for people leadership, service excellence, budget planning, vendor and contract management, and the strategic evolution of platforms including Microsoft Exchange, secure e-mail and journaling solutions, Cisco call manager, trader telephony, voice recording, Webex, and Confluence, and Microsoft SQL server environments.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers, fostering a high-performance and collaborative culture

• Ensure stable, secure, and efficient operation of global collaboration and voice services

• Own service delivery and continuous improvement for Microsoft Exchange, secure e-mail and journaling platforms, Cisco call manager, trader telephony, voice recording solutions, Webex, and Confluence, and Microsoft SQL server environments

• Define team priorities, allocate resources, and manage capacity to meet business objectives and service levels

• Support budget planning, cost control, and financial forecasting for assigned services and products

• Manage vendor relationships, software and service contracts, and license compliance

• Drive technology lifecycle management, including upgrades, risk mitigation, and strategic roadmap planning

• Ensure compliance with regulatory, security, and operational requirements

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and external partners to deliver reliable and innovative communication solutions

• Support incident, problem, and change management processes and act as an escalation point for critical issues

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is an advantage

• Several years of experience in IT infrastructure operations and service delivery, including experience in a leadership or supervisory role

• Good general technical infrastructure know-how with a focus on Microsoft Exchange, secure e-mail and journaling solutions, Cisco unified communications manager, trading telephony, voice recording platforms, Webex, Confluence, and Microsoft SQL Server

• Experience managing business-critical collaboration, communication, and database services in a complex enterprise environment

• Knowledge of IT service management frameworks (ITIL) and operational best practices

• Experience with budget planning, financial management, vendor management, and contract administration

• Good understanding of IT security, regulatory, risk, and compliance requirements

• Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and conflict resolution skills

• Proven ability to drive service improvements, technology lifecycle management, and organizational change

• Fluent in German and English

• Proven leadership and people management skills, with the ability to coach, motivate, and develop technical teams

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across business, IT, and external partners

• Solid understanding of enterprise collaboration, voice, and database technologies, including Exchange, Cisco Unified Communications, Webex, Confluence, Microsoft SQL Server, and related services

• Strong service management mindset with experience in ITIL-based processes and operational excellence

• Financial acumen with experience supporting budget planning, cost optimization, and resource management

• Contract and vendor management skills, including negotiation and performance management

• Strategic thinking with the ability to translate business needs into technology roadmaps and service improvements

• Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and prioritization capabilities in complex environments

• Risk, security, and compliance awareness for business-critical IT services

• Ability to lead organizational and technology change initiatives in a regulated enterprise environment

• Prova capacità di guidare miglioramenti del servizio, gestione del ciclo di vita della tecnologia e cambiamento organizzativo

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are looking for a Sales Development Manager, to support our Co-Heads of Global Asset Class Specialists (GACS), within our Global Products & Solutions unit (GPS). The GACS team is home for the sales and solutions experts (structured products, alternatives, FICC, OTC, FX, and cross-assets), working directly with our internal and external clients.

Acting as a sparring partner to the GACS Co-Heads, the role contributes to strategic priorities, cross-asset initiatives, and the ongoing development of the GACS organization. This role exercises leadership through influence, coordination, and execution in a global environment.

The Sales Development Manager plays a central role in driving and enhancing sales effectiveness, initiatives, and strategic projects, across all asset classes.
This role requires top notch stakeholder management and the capacity to steer internal coordination, sales management, and commercial enablement, ensuring that sales teams are equipped with the appropriate tools, insights, and frameworks to effectively position and distribute investment solutions.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Sales Enablement & Support

• Act as a central coordination and enablement function for sales teams across all asset classes

• Drive enhancements of sales processes, tools, and workflows to improve efficiency and effectiveness

• Develop and maintain sales materials, pitch frameworks, and product positioning in collaboration with GACS units

• Facilitate knowledge sharing and promote best practices across sales teams

GACS Partnerships & Coordination

• Serve as a key partner to GACS teams, ensuring alignment between asset class strategies and sales execution

• Act as a sparring partner to the GACS Co-Heads on strategic priorities, planning, and operational execution

• Coordinate cross-asset initiatives, thematic campaigns, and internal communication

• Translate asset class strategies into actionable sales guidance and frameworks

Sales Initiatives & Projects

• Drive and contribute to strategic sales, business, and platform development initiatives (e.g., growth initiatives, market entry strategies, efficiency improvements) on behalf of GACS

• Collaborate closely with GPS Strategy & Business Development and Front Management teams on cross-functional and bank’s strategic projects

• Design and implementation of new distribution approaches, campaigns, and client engagement models

• Drive innovation in sales practices, processes, and commercial frameworks

Stakeholder Management & Governance

• Ensure clear communication and alignment across all relevant stakeholders within the bank

• Engage with senior stakeholders and management committees to support decision-making and alignment

• Prepare high-quality management updates, presentations, and decision-making materials for GACS leadership

Reporting & Performance Steering

• Provide insights on sales performance, pipeline trends, and campaign outcomes

• Translate performance data into actionable recommendations for GACS leadership team

• Support business reviews and reporting processes in collaboration with GPS Business Management

Representation & Culture

• Represent GACS in internal committees, working groups, and senior management forums

• Act as a role model for integrity, professionalism, and client-centric behaviour

• Provide guidance, mentoring, and coaching to junior colleagues and project team members where appropriate

• Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement

YOUR PROFILE

• Proven experience in sales, business development, product, or strategy-related roles within financial services with a focus on investment solutions

• Strong exposure to multi-asset environments and sales organizations

• Strong understanding of cross-assets solutions and knowledge about the competitive landscape and revenues drivers

• Deep understanding of sales environments, KPI and distribution dynamics

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across seniority levels and functions

• Demonstrated leadership experience, including matrix leadership, cross-functional coordination, or team mentoring

• Proactive, ownership driven and execution focused

• Collaborative and able to navigate complex organisational structures across locations and cultures

• Client centric mindset with long term value creation focus

• Strong strategic thinking combined with sound commercial acumen

• High degree of integrity, regulatory awareness, and risk consciousness

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information and support decision-making

• Structured, solution-oriented, and resilient working style in a fast-paced environment

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Stiamo cercando un Sales Development Manager, per supportare i nostri Co-Heads di Global Asset Class Specialists (GACS), all'interno della nostra Global Products & Solutions (GPS). Il team GACS è sede di esperti di vendita e soluzioni (prodotti strutturati, alternative, FICC, OTC, FX e cross-asset), lavorando direttamente con i nostri clienti interni ed esterni.

Agendo come partner sparring per i Co-Heads GACS, il ruolo contribuisce alle priorità strategiche, alle iniziative di cross-asset e allo sviluppo continuo dell'organizzazione GACS. Questo ruolo esercita la leadership attraverso l'influenza, il coordinamento e l'esecuzione in un ambiente globale.

Il Sales Development Manager svolge un ruolo centrale nella guida e nel miglioramento dell'efficacia delle vendite, delle iniziative e dei progetti strategici, in tutte le classi di asset.
Questo ruolo richiede la gestione dei principali stakeholder e la capacità di guidare il coordinamento interno, la gestione delle vendite e l’attivazione commerciale, assicurando che i team di vendita siano dotati degli strumenti, delle conoscenze e dei framework appropriati per posizionare e distribuire efficacemente le soluzioni di investimento.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Vendita Attivazione e supporto

• Atto come coordinamento centrale e funzione di attivazione per i team di vendita in tutte le classi di asset

• Miglioramento dei processi di vendita, degli strumenti e dei flussi di lavoro per migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia

• Sviluppare e mantenere materiali di vendita, strutture di pitch e posizionamento dei prodotti in collaborazione con le unità GACS

• Facilita la condivisione delle conoscenze e promuove le migliori pratiche tra i team di vendita

GACS Partnerships & Coordinamento

• Servire come partner chiave per i team GACS, garantendo l'allineamento tra le strategie di asset class e l'esecuzione delle vendite

• Agire come partner sparring per i Co-Heads GACS su priorità strategiche, pianificazione e esecuzione operativa

• Coordinare iniziative di cross-asset, campagne tematiche e comunicazione interna

• Tradurre strategie di asset class in linee guida e framework di vendita attuabili

Iniziative di vendita e progetti

• Guidare e contribuire a iniziative strategiche di vendita, business e sviluppo di piattaforme (ad esempio, iniziative di crescita, strategie di entrata di mercato, miglioramenti dell'efficienza) per conto di GACS

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team GPS Strategy & Business Development e Front Management sui progetti strategici trasversali e bancari

• Progettazione e implementazione di nuovi approcci di distribuzione, campagne e modelli di coinvolgimento dei clienti

• Guidare l'innovazione nelle pratiche di vendita, nei processi e nei quadri commerciali

Gestione e governance degli stakeholder

• Assicurare una comunicazione chiara e un allineamento su tutti gli stakeholder rilevanti all'interno della banca

• Impegnarsi con gli stakeholder senior e i comitati di gestione per sostenere il processo decisionale e l'allineamento

• Preparare aggiornamenti di gestione di alta qualità, presentazioni e materiali decisionali per la leadership GACS

Reporting & Performance Steering

• Fornire informazioni sulle prestazioni di vendita, le tendenze pipeline e i risultati della campagna

• Tradurre i dati delle prestazioni in raccomandazioni attuabili per il team di leadership GACS

• Supporta recensioni aziendali e processi di reportistica in collaborazione con GPS Business Management

Rappresentanza e cultura

• Rappresentare GACS in comitati interni, gruppi di lavoro e forum di gestione senior

• Atto come modello di ruolo per l'integrità, la professionalità e il comportamento client-centric

• Fornire guida, mentoring e coaching ai colleghi junior e ai membri del team di progetto, se del caso

• Promuovere una cultura di collaborazione, responsabilità e miglioramento continuo

Il tuo progetto

• Esperienza comprovata nei ruoli di vendita, sviluppo aziendale, prodotto o strategia all'interno dei servizi finanziari con un focus sulle soluzioni di investimento

• Forte esposizione a ambienti multi-asset e organizzazioni di vendita

• Forte comprensione delle soluzioni di cross-assets e della conoscenza del paesaggio competitivo e dei driver di ricavi

• Profonda comprensione degli ambienti di vendita, KPI e dinamiche di distribuzione

• Eccellente capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder attraverso livelli e funzioni di seniority

• Esperienza di leadership dimostrata, tra cui leadership matrice, coordinamento interfunzionale, o mentoring di squadra

• Proattiva, guidata dalla proprietà e messa a fuoco

• Collaborativo e in grado di navigare in strutture organizzative complesse in luoghi e culture

• Mindset centrico client con focus sulla creazione di valore a lungo termine

• Forte pensiero strategico combinato con acume commerciale

• Alto grado di integrità, consapevolezza delle normative e coscienza del rischio

• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di sintetizzare informazioni complesse e sostenere il processo decisionale

• Strutturato, orientato alla soluzione e stile di lavoro resiliente in un ambiente veloce

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completa attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro si possono trovare sul nostro sito Career.
Non è questo che stai cercando? Impostare un avviso di lavoro creando un account candidato qui.

Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Wir suchen einen Sales Development Manager, der unsere Co-Heads of Global Asset Class Specialists (GACS) innerhalb unserer Global Products & Solutions Unit (GPS) unterstützt. Das GACS-Team ist die Heimat der Vertriebs- und Lösungsexperten (strukturierte Produkte, Alternativen, FICC, OTC, FX und Cross-Assets), die direkt mit unseren internen und externen Kunden zusammenarbeiten.

Als Sparringspartner der GACS Co-Heads trägt die Rolle zu strategischen Prioritäten, vermögensübergreifenden Initiativen und der Weiterentwicklung der GACS-Organisation bei. Diese Rolle übt Führung durch Einfluss, Koordination und Ausführung in einem globalen Umfeld aus.

Der Sales Development Manager spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung und Verbesserung der Vertriebseffektivität, Initiativen und strategischen Projekten in allen Anlageklassen.
Diese Rolle erfordert ein erstklassiges Stakeholder-Management und die Fähigkeit, die interne Koordination, das Vertriebsmanagement und die kommerzielle Unterstützung zu steuern, um sicherzustellen, dass die Vertriebsteams mit den geeigneten Tools, Erkenntnissen und Frameworks ausgestattet sind, um Anlagelösungen effektiv zu positionieren und zu verteilen.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNGEN
Sales Enablement & Support

• Handeln als zentrale Koordinations- und Enablement-Funktion für Vertriebsteams über alle Anlageklassen hinweg

• Verbesserung von Verkaufsprozessen, Tools und Workflows zur Verbesserung von Effizienz und Effektivität

• Entwicklung und Pflege von Verkaufsmaterialien, Pitch-Frameworks und Produktpositionierung in Zusammenarbeit mit GACS-Einheiten

• Erleichterung des Wissensaustauschs und Förderung von Best Practices in allen Verkaufsteams

GACS Partnerschaften & Koordination

• Dienen Sie als wichtiger Partner für GACS-Teams und gewährleisten Sie die Abstimmung zwischen Anlageklassenstrategien und Vertriebsausführung

• Handeln Sie als Sparringspartner der GACS Co-Heads zu strategischen Prioritäten, Planung und operativer Umsetzung

• Koordination von Asset-übergreifenden Initiativen, thematischen Kampagnen und interner Kommunikation

• Übersetzen von Anlageklassenstrategien in umsetzbare Verkaufsleitlinien und Frameworks

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit GPS Strategy & Business Development und Front Management Teams bei funktionsübergreifenden und strategischen Projekten der Bank

• Design und Implementierung neuer Vertriebsansätze, Kampagnen und Kundenbindungsmodelle

• Förderung von Innovationen in Vertriebspraktiken, -prozessen und kommerziellen Rahmenbedingungen

Stakeholder Management & Governance

• Gewährleistung einer klaren Kommunikation und Abstimmung zwischen allen relevanten Stakeholdern innerhalb der Bank

• Engagieren Sie sich mit hochrangigen Stakeholdern und Managementausschüssen, um Entscheidungsfindung und Abstimmung zu unterstützen

• Bereiten Sie hochwertige Management-Updates, Präsentationen und Entscheidungsunterlagen für die GACS-Führung vor

Reporting & Performance Steering

• Übersetzen von Leistungsdaten in umsetzbare Empfehlungen für das GACS-Führungsteam

• Unterstützung von Geschäftsbewertungen und Berichtsprozessen in Zusammenarbeit mit GPS Business Management

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un responsable du développement des ventes, pour soutenir nos co-chefs de Global Asset Class Specialists (GACS), au sein de notre unité Produits et Solutions Global (GPS). L'équipe GACS est la maison des experts en ventes et solutions (produits structurés, alternatives, FICC, OTC, FX, et multi-actifs), travaillant directement avec nos clients internes et externes.

En tant que partenaire principal des cochefs du GACS, ce rôle contribue aux priorités stratégiques, aux initiatives interentreprises et au développement continu de l'organisation du GACS. Ce rôle exerce un leadership par l'influence, la coordination et l'exécution dans un environnement mondial.

Le directeur du développement des ventes joue un rôle central dans la conduite et l'amélioration de l'efficacité des ventes, des initiatives et des projets stratégiques, dans toutes les catégories d'actifs.
Ce rôle exige la gestion des principaux intervenants et la capacité de diriger la coordination interne, la gestion des ventes et l'habilitation commerciale, en veillant à ce que les équipes de vente soient équipées des outils, des idées et des cadres appropriés pour positionner et distribuer efficacement les solutions d'investissement.

VOTRE DÉFIS
Activement et support des ventes

• Agir comme fonction centrale de coordination et d'habilitation pour les équipes de vente de toutes les catégories d'actifs

• Développer et entretenir les matériaux de vente, les cadres de tangage et le positionnement des produits en collaboration avec les unités GACS

• Traduire les stratégies de classe d'actifs en orientations et cadres de vente réalisables

Initiatives et projets de vente

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de la stratégie GPS et du développement des affaires et de la gestion avant sur des projets stratégiques interfonctionnels et bancaires

• Conception et mise en oeuvre de nouvelles approches de distribution, campagnes et modèles d'engagement des clients

• Favoriser l'innovation dans les pratiques de vente, les processus et les cadres commerciaux

Gestion et gouvernance des intervenants

• Assurer une communication et un alignement clairs entre toutes les parties prenantes concernées au sein de la banque

• Faire appel aux principaux intervenants et aux comités de gestion pour appuyer la prise de décisions et l'harmonisation

• Fournir des renseignements sur la performance des ventes, les tendances des pipelines et les résultats de la campagne

Représentation et culture

• Représenter le GACS dans les comités internes, les groupes de travail et les forums de la haute direction

• Agir comme modèle d'intégrité, de professionnalisme et de comportement axé sur le client

• Fournir une orientation, un mentorat et un encadrement aux collègues subalternes et aux membres de l'équipe de projet, le cas échéant.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

For our Employee Compliance Team within Central Compliance, we are looking for a Junior Compliance Specialist to join our team. The team is responsible for the Conduct Framework, monitoring and promoting effective governance and ensuring highest standards of Compliance across our operations.

YOUR CHALLENGE

YOUR PROFILE

• Academic background in Banking, Financials Law or Business Administration, or a related field

• Solid understanding of banking operations, gained through prior experience in private banking, compliance, or audit in financial services

• Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power Query and data analysis; experienced in structuring, cleaning, and interpreting datasets

• Strong competence in PowerPoint: ability to translate complex information into clear, visually compelling slides and summaries

• Proficiency in Tableau and Power BI is highly desirable

• Experience in reporting, process coordination, or compliance support roles is highly desirable

• Exceptional organisational skills, precision in execution, and strong attention to detail

• Natural collaborator with a can-do attitude, capable of thriving in a matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders

• Eager to learn quickly, take initiative, and grow within a purpose-driven compliance function

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In this role you will support the GPS Platform Transformation programme, focusing on Client Relationship Management (CRM) capabilities across Sales and Trading. The role will bridge business and technology teams to improve client data management, CRM processes and system integrations, ensuring high-quality and scalable client data solutions.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyse and document requirements, translating business needs into technology solutions

• Analyse, structure and model client, contact, legal entity and relationship data to support CRM and Sales processes

• Define business data requirements, data ownership and quality controls for client and relationship information

• Perform data mapping and source-to-target analysis across CRM platforms and related front-office systems

• Improve the accuracy, consistency and usability of client data, client hierarchies and business partner relationships

• Produce business requirements, user stories, process flows and functional specifications

• Collaborate with architects and developers to deliver CRM enhancements, integrations and data solutions

• Support testing, implementation and adoption of CRM capabilities

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance or a related discipline

• 7+ years of business analysis experience within banking or financial services

• Strong experience with CRM platforms and client relationship management processes

• Proven experience in client data management, data modelling and relationship modelling

• Hands-on experience with data mapping, source-to-target mapping and data migration activities

• Understanding of Customer Master Data / Golden Source concepts, data governance and data quality frameworks

• Experience with business partner structures, client hierarchies and legal entity data

• Experience integrating CRM platforms with upstream and downstream systems via APIs and interfaces

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications

• Knowledge of Client Onboarding, Sales, Client Coverage or Wealth Management processes is advantageous

• Communicates clearly across functions and cultures, influences decisions without formal authority, and navigates complex organisations to drive outcomes

• Quickly troubleshoots issues, applies sound judgement in controlled environments, and remains focused on delivery despite ambiguity or changing priorities

• Works independently and proactively in global teams, contributes to collaborative Agile ways of working, and maintains a team-first mindset to achieve shared goals

• Fluency in English; German is an advantage

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Account Manager (AM) is mainly responsible for servicing the clients (Employees of the Bank) in the day-to-day work and takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration. She/he will be part of a team responsible to execute trades and this entails dealing with routine enquiries and transactions as well as documentation to meet regulatory requirements without the involvement of a Relationship Manager. She/he demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients. The AM ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently and provides clients with relevant information. The AM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion, and Excellence). Professionalism and responsiveness are key. The AM shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Clients support

• Service clients in the day-to-day work and handle the full account management of a client on an execution-only basis (no investment advice provided) without the involvement of a Relationship Manager

• Attend incoming calls and e-mails and ensures efficient and prompt handling of orders, trades, transactions, deposits, loans etc.

• Handles the account openings for new clients as well as account changes to existing clients, ensures that accurate and high-quality client relationship documentation formalities are met and maintained to a high standard at all times including client identification documentation (CDB), account opening forms and other relevant legal forms

• Interacts with clients globally in an independent and professional manner in all aspects of account management

• Ensures efficient and prompt handling of orders, trades, transactions, etc.

• Proactively takes the lead in client relationship and all related tasks (systems, applications, processes, documents etc.), with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

Business Development

• Manages the internal projects, which impact the account relationships, directly solving the administrative issues that arise and ensuring that all relevant systems are maintained and updated and all documentation collected as necessary

• Organises herself/himself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her own work at all times shares relevant information, ideas, findings and research with colleagues to improve processes and to increase productivity and quality

• Become a subject matter expert on our business products, processes and operations, and remain up-to-date

YOUR PROFILE
Personal and Social

• Very good inter-personal skills, open and approachable, extraordinary Team player

• Systematic, independent, proactive, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform exceedingly well under pressure

• Exceptional communication skills and always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner as well as an excellent situational adaptability

• Takes on extra responsibilities at own initiative, aims for excellence by finding ways to do things smarter, faster, better and is also not afraid to question a status quo

• Positive “can do” attitude and approaches challenges with an open mind

Professional and Technical

• Either at least 5 years of experience as Assistant RM or 3 years of experience as A(R)M and job related higher degree

• Excellent written and oral skills in German, English; additional languages e.g. Italian or French a plus

• In-depth knowledge in banking and client servicing and pronounced knowledge in all asset classes in a portfolio context

• Experience as Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) or Account Manager (AM)

Fixed-Term contract start date: 1 February 2027 - 30 September 2027

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

Il Account Manager (AM) è principalmente responsabile della manutenzione dei clienti ( Dipendenti della Banca) nel lavoro quotidiano e prende possesso dell'amministrazione del conto, delle formalità di documentazione e delle attività nelle operazioni quotidiane e dei progetti che influiscono sull'amministrazione del conto. Sarà parte di un team responsabile dell'esecuzione degli scambi e ciò comporta la gestione di indagini e transazioni di routine, nonché la documentazione per soddisfare i requisiti normativi senza il coinvolgimento di un Responsabile Relazioni. Lei / lui dimostra eccellenti competenze professionali, personali e sociali quando si legano con i clienti. L'AM garantisce la gestione dell'account client operativo e interagisce con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni in modo indipendente e fornisce ai clienti informazioni rilevanti. L'AM agisce come modello di ruolo nel portare la migliore qualità del servizio ai clienti in modo veloce, professionale e amichevole, vivendo sempre i valori di Julius Baer (Care, Passione ed Eccellenza). Professionalità e reattività sono fondamentali. L'AM mostra l'impegno professionale per garantire un'ottima amministrazione del conto, per i clienti e per la Banca ed è disposto ad andare il miglio in più.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Supporto clienti

• Clienti di servizio nel lavoro quotidiano e gestire la gestione completa del conto di un cliente su una base esecutiva (nessuna consulenza di investimento fornita) senza il coinvolgimento di un Responsabile Relazioni

• Partecipa alle chiamate e alle e-mail in arrivo e garantisce una gestione efficiente e rapida degli ordini, degli scambi, delle transazioni, dei depositi, dei prestiti ecc.

• Mantiene le aperture dell'account per i nuovi clienti e le modifiche dell'account ai clienti esistenti, assicura che le formalità accurate e di alta qualità della documentazione della relazione cliente siano soddisfatte e mantenute ad un alto standard in ogni momento, tra cui la documentazione di identificazione del cliente (CDB), i moduli di apertura del conto e altre forme legali pertinenti

• Interagisce con i clienti a livello globale in modo indipendente e professionale in tutti gli aspetti della gestione del conto

• Garantisce una gestione efficiente e rapida di ordini, scambi, transazioni, ecc.

• Proattivamente prende il comando del rapporto cliente e di tutte le attività connesse (sistemi, applicazioni, processi, documenti ecc.), con alta qualità, precisione e tempestiva reattività.

Sviluppo delle imprese

• Gestisce i progetti interni, che influiscono sulle relazioni dell'account, risolvendo direttamente le questioni amministrative che si presentano e assicurando che tutti i sistemi pertinenti siano mantenuti e aggiornati e tutta la documentazione raccolta come necessario

• Organizza se stessa in modo efficiente e conforme e garantisce informazioni tempestive e appropriate del superiore

• Conduce recensioni, piani avanti e documenta il proprio lavoro in ogni momento condivide informazioni, idee, risultati e ricerche rilevanti con i colleghi per migliorare i processi e aumentare la produttività e la qualità

• Diventa un esperto di materia tematica sui nostri prodotti, processi e operazioni aziendali e rimani aggiornato

Il tuo progetto
Personale e Sociale

• Molto buone abilità interpersonali, aperta e accessibile, straordinario giocatore di squadra

• Sistematico, indipendente, proattivo, preciso e diligente stile di lavoro e la capacità di eseguire molto bene sotto pressione

• Capacità di comunicazione eccezionale e comunica sempre in modo amichevole, competente e professionale, nonché un'ottima adattabilità situazionele

• Prende su responsabilità extra di propria iniziativa, mira all'eccellenza trovando modi per fare le cose più intelligenti, più veloci, migliori e non ha anche paura di mettere in discussione uno status quo

• Positivo atteggiamento “può fare” e affronta le sfide con una mente aperta

Professionale e tecnico

• O almeno 5 anni di esperienza come Assistente RM o 3 anni di esperienza come A(R)M e di livello superiore

• Competenze scritte e orali eccellenti in tedesco, inglese; lingue aggiuntive come l'italiano o il francese

• Conoscenza approfondita nel settore bancario e assistenza clienti e conoscenza pronunciata in tutte le classi di asset in un contesto di portafoglio

• Esperienza come Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) o Account Manager (AM)

Data di inizio del contratto fisso: 1 febbraio 2027 - 30 settembre 2027

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completa attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro si possono trovare sul nostro sito Career.
Non è questo che stai cercando? Impostare un avviso di lavoro creando un account candidato qui.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Der Account Manager (AM) ist hauptsächlich für die Betreuung der Kunden (Mitarbeiter der Bank) in der täglichen Arbeit verantwortlich und übernimmt die Verantwortung für die Kontoverwaltung, Dokumentationsformalitäten und Aufgaben im täglichen Betrieb und Projekte, die sich auf die Kontoverwaltung auswirken. Sie / er wird Teil eines Teams sein, das für die Ausführung von Trades verantwortlich ist, und dies beinhaltet den Umgang mit Routineanfragen und Transaktionen sowie die Dokumentation, um die regulatorischen Anforderungen ohne die Beteiligung eines Relationship Managers zu erfüllen. Sie / er zeigt hervorragende berufliche, persönliche sowie soziale Fähigkeiten bei der Verbindung mit Kunden. Der AM sorgt für die operative Kundenkontoverwaltung und interagiert unabhängig mit internen sowie externen Stakeholdern und stellt den Kunden relevante Informationen zur Verfügung. Der AM fungiert als Vorbild, um den Kunden schnell, professionell und freundlich die beste Servicequalität zu bieten und dabei stets die Werte von Julius Bär (Pflege, Leidenschaft und Exzellenz) zu leben. Professionalität und Reaktionsfähigkeit sind der Schlüssel. Der AM zeigt professionelles Engagement für eine hervorragende Verwaltung des Kontos, für Kunden sowie für die Bank und ist bereit, die extra Meile zu gehen.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG
Kundenunterstützung

• Service-Clients in der täglichen Arbeit und übernehmen die vollständige Account-Verwaltung eines Kunden nur auf Ausführungsbasis (keine Anlageberatung) ohne Einbeziehung eines Relationship Managers

• Nehmen Sie an eingehenden Anrufen und E-Mails teil und gewährleisten Sie eine effiziente und zeitnahe Abwicklung von Bestellungen, Trades, Transaktionen, Einlagen, Darlehen usw.

• Verwaltet die Kontoeröffnungen für neue Kunden sowie Kontoänderungen für bestehende Kunden und stellt sicher, dass genaue und qualitativ hochwertige Dokumentationsformalitäten für Kundenbeziehungen eingehalten und jederzeit auf einem hohen Standard gehalten werden, einschließlich Kundenidentifikationsdokumentation (CDB), Kontoeröffnungsformulare und andere relevante Rechtsformen

• Interagiert mit Kunden weltweit in einer unabhängigen und professionellen Art und Weise in allen Aspekten der Kontoverwaltung

• Gewährleistung einer effizienten und zeitnahen Abwicklung von Aufträgen, Trades, Transaktionen usw.

• Proaktiv übernimmt die Führung in der Kundenbeziehung und allen damit verbundenen Aufgaben (Systeme, Anwendungen, Prozesse, Dokumente usw.) mit hoher Qualität, Präzision und zeitnaher Reaktionsfähigkeit

Geschäftsentwicklung

• Verwaltet die internen Projekte, die sich auf die Kontobeziehungen auswirken, löst direkt die auftretenden administrativen Probleme und stellt sicher, dass alle relevanten Systeme gepflegt und aktualisiert und alle erforderlichen Dokumentationen gesammelt werden

• Organisiert sich effizient und konform und sorgt für rechtzeitige und angemessene Informationen des Vorgesetzten

• Führt jederzeit Überprüfungen durch, plant und dokumentiert seine eigene Arbeit und teilt relevante Informationen, Ideen, Erkenntnisse und Forschung mit Kollegen, um Prozesse zu verbessern und Produktivität und Qualität zu steigern.

• Werden Sie Experte für unsere Geschäftsprodukte, Prozesse und Abläufe und bleiben Sie auf dem neuesten Stand

IHR PROFIL
Persönlich und sozial

• Sehr gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, offen und zugänglich, außergewöhnlicher Teamplayer

• Systematischer, unabhängiger, proaktiver, präziser und sorgfältiger Arbeitsstil und die Fähigkeit, unter Druck überaus gut zu arbeiten

• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kommuniziert immer freundlich, kompetent und professionell sowie eine hervorragende situative Anpassungsfähigkeit

• Übernimmt aus eigener Initiative zusätzliche Verantwortung, strebt Exzellenz an, indem es Wege findet, Dinge intelligenter, schneller und besser zu machen, und hat auch keine Angst, einen Status quo in Frage zu stellen

• Positive "Can Do" -Haltung und nähert sich Herausforderungen mit einem offenen Geist

Professionell und technisch

• Entweder mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Assistant RM oder 3 Jahre Erfahrung als A(R)M und berufsbezogener Hochschulabschluss

• Hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Fähigkeiten in Deutsch, Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen z.B. Italienisch oder Französisch ein Plus

• Tiefe Kenntnisse im Bank- und Kundenservice und ausgeprägte Kenntnisse in allen Anlageklassen im Portfoliokontext

• Erfahrung als Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) oder Account Manager (AM)

Befristeter Vertragsbeginn: 1. Februar 2027 - 30. September 2027

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Le gestionnaire de compte (AM) est principalement chargé de fournir des services aux clients (employés de la Banque) dans le cadre du travail quotidien et prend en charge l'administration du compte, les formalités de documentation et les tâches dans le cadre des opérations quotidiennes et des projets ayant une incidence sur l'administration du compte. Elle fera partie d'une équipe responsable de l'exécution des métiers, ce qui implique de traiter les demandes de renseignements et les transactions courantes ainsi que la documentation pour satisfaire aux exigences réglementaires sans la participation d'un gestionnaire des relations. Elle fait preuve d'excellentes compétences professionnelles, personnelles et sociales en liaison avec ses clients. Elle assure la gestion opérationnelle du compte client et interagit de façon indépendante avec les intervenants internes et externes et fournit aux clients des renseignements pertinents. L'AM sert de modèle en apportant la meilleure qualité de service aux clients de manière rapide, professionnelle et amicale, en vivant toujours les valeurs de Julius Baer (Care, Passion, Excellence). Le professionnalisme et la réactivité sont essentiels. L'AM fait preuve d'un engagement professionnel à assurer une excellente administration du compte, aux clients ainsi qu'à la Banque et est prêt à aller au-delà.

Votre défi
Soutien aux clients

• Les clients de services dans le travail quotidien et de gérer la gestion complète du compte d'un client sur une base d'exécution seulement (aucun conseil d'investissement fourni) sans la participation d'un gestionnaire de relations

• Assister aux appels et aux courriels entrants et assurer un traitement efficace et rapide des commandes, des transactions, des dépôts, des prêts, etc.

• S'occupe des ouvertures de compte pour les nouveaux clients ainsi que des changements de compte pour les clients existants, veille à ce que les formalités de documentation de la relation client soient respectées et maintenues à un niveau élevé en tout temps, y compris la documentation d'identification du client (DBC), les formulaires d'ouverture de compte et d'autres formulaires juridiques pertinents

• Interagit avec les clients du monde entier de manière indépendante et professionnelle dans tous les aspects de la gestion des comptes

• Assurer un traitement efficace et rapide des commandes, des transactions, etc.

• Prise proactive en charge de la relation client et de toutes les tâches connexes (systèmes, applications, processus, documents, etc.), avec une grande qualité, précision et réactivité en temps opportun

Développement des entreprises

• Gère les projets internes qui influent sur les relations de compte, résolvent directement les problèmes administratifs qui se posent et veillent à ce que tous les systèmes pertinents soient maintenus et mis à jour et à ce que toute la documentation recueillie au besoin

• S'organise de manière efficace et conforme et assure l'information opportune et appropriée du supérieur

• Examine, planifie et documente en tout temps ses propres travaux en partageant des informations, des idées, des constatations et des recherches pertinentes avec des collègues afin d'améliorer les processus et d'accroître la productivité et la qualité.

• Devenez un expert en matière de produits, de procédés et d'opérations commerciaux, et restez à jour

VOTRE PROFIL
Personnel et social

• Très bonnes compétences interpersonnelles, ouvertes et accessibles, joueur d'équipe extraordinaire

• Style de travail systématique, indépendant, proactif, précis et diligent et capacité à effectuer des performances extrêmement bonnes sous pression

• Compétences de communication exceptionnelles et communication toujours amicale, compétente et professionnelle ainsi qu'une excellente adaptabilité situationnelle

• Prend des responsabilités supplémentaires de sa propre initiative, vise l'excellence en trouvant des façons de faire les choses plus intelligentes, plus rapides, mieux et n'a pas peur de remettre en question un statu quo

• L'attitude positive peut faire et approche les défis avec un esprit ouvert

Professionnel et technique

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant qu'adjoint RM ou 3 ans d'expérience en tant que MA et grade supérieur lié à l'emploi

• Excellente maîtrise de l'écrit et de l'oral en allemand, anglais; langues supplémentaires, par exemple l'italien ou le français a plus

• Connaissance approfondie des services bancaires et des services à la clientèle et connaissance prononcée de toutes les classes d'actifs dans un contexte de portefeuille

• Expérience en tant que gestionnaire de relations adjoint (ARM) ou gestionnaire de comptes (AM)

Date de début du contrat à durée déterminée : 1er février 2027 - 30 septembre 2027

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète par l'intermédiaire de notre outil d'application en ligne. D'autres possibilités d'emploi intéressantes se trouvent sur notre site de carrière.
Ce n'est pas tout à fait ce que vous cherchez ? Configurez une alerte d'emploi en créant un compte candidat ici.

Il Account Manager (AM) è principalmente responsabile della manutenzione dei clienti ( Dipendenti della Banca) nel lavoro quotidiano e prende possesso dell'amministrazione del conto, delle formalità di documentazione e delle attività nelle operazioni quotidiane e dei progetti che influiscono sull'amministrazione del conto. Sarà parte di un team responsabile dell'esecuzione degli scambi e ciò comporta la gestione di indagini e transazioni di routine, nonché la documentazione per soddisfare i requisiti normativi senza il coinvolgimento di un Responsabile Relazioni. Lei / lui dimostra eccellenti competenze professionali, personali e sociali quando si legano con i clienti. L'AM garantisce la gestione dell'account client operativo e interagisce con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni in modo indipendente e fornisce ai clienti informazioni rilevanti. L'AM agisce come modello di ruolo nel portare la migliore qualità del servizio ai clienti in modo veloce, professionale e amichevole, vivendo sempre i valori di Julius Baer (Care, Passione ed Eccellenza). Professionalità e reattività sono fondamentali. L'AM mostra l'impegno professionale per garantire un'ottima amministrazione del conto, per i clienti e per la Banca ed è disposto ad andare il miglio in più.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Supporto clienti

• Clienti di servizio nel lavoro quotidiano e gestire la gestione completa del conto di un cliente su una base esecutiva (nessuna consulenza di investimento fornita) senza il coinvolgimento di un Responsabile Relazioni

• Partecipa alle chiamate e alle e-mail in arrivo e garantisce una gestione efficiente e rapida degli ordini, degli scambi, delle transazioni, dei depositi, dei prestiti ecc.

• Mantiene le aperture dell'account per i nuovi clienti e le modifiche dell'account ai clienti esistenti, assicura che le formalità accurate e di alta qualità della documentazione della relazione cliente siano soddisfatte e mantenute ad un alto standard in ogni momento, tra cui la documentazione di identificazione del cliente (CDB), i moduli di apertura del conto e altre forme legali pertinenti

• Interagisce con i clienti a livello globale in modo indipendente e professionale in tutti gli aspetti della gestione del conto

• Garantisce una gestione efficiente e rapida di ordini, scambi, transazioni, ecc.

• Proattivamente prende il comando del rapporto cliente e di tutte le attività connesse (sistemi, applicazioni, processi, documenti ecc.), con alta qualità, precisione e tempestiva reattività.

Sviluppo delle imprese

• Gestisce i progetti interni, che influiscono sulle relazioni dell'account, risolvendo direttamente le questioni amministrative che si presentano e assicurando che tutti i sistemi pertinenti siano mantenuti e aggiornati e tutta la documentazione raccolta come necessario

• Organizza se stessa in modo efficiente e conforme e garantisce informazioni tempestive e appropriate del superiore

• Conduce recensioni, piani avanti e documenta il proprio lavoro in ogni momento condivide informazioni, idee, risultati e ricerche rilevanti con i colleghi per migliorare i processi e aumentare la produttività e la qualità

• Diventa un esperto di materia tematica sui nostri prodotti, processi e operazioni aziendali e rimani aggiornato

Il tuo progetto
Personale e Sociale

• Molto buone abilità interpersonali, aperta e accessibile, straordinario giocatore di squadra

• Sistematico, indipendente, proattivo, preciso e diligente stile di lavoro e la capacità di eseguire molto bene sotto pressione

• Capacità di comunicazione eccezionale e comunica sempre in modo amichevole, competente e professionale, nonché un'ottima adattabilità situazionele

• Prende su responsabilità extra di propria iniziativa, mira all'eccellenza trovando modi per fare le cose più intelligenti, più veloci, migliori e non ha anche paura di mettere in discussione uno status quo

• Positivo atteggiamento “può fare” e affronta le sfide con una mente aperta

Professionale e tecnico

• O almeno 5 anni di esperienza come Assistente RM o 3 anni di esperienza come A(R)M e di livello superiore

• Competenze scritte e orali eccellenti in tedesco, inglese; lingue aggiuntive come l'italiano o il francese

• Conoscenza approfondita nel settore bancario e assistenza clienti e conoscenza pronunciata in tutte le classi di asset in un contesto di portafoglio

• Esperienza come Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) o Account Manager (AM)

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Account Manager (AM) is mainly responsible for servicing the clients (Employees of the Bank) in the day-to-day work and takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration. She/he will be part of a team responsible to execute trades and this entails dealing with routine enquiries and transactions as well as documentation to meet regulatory requirements without the involvement of a Relationship Manager. She/he demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients. The AM ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently and provides clients with relevant information. The AM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion, and Excellence). Professionalism and responsiveness are key. The AM shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Clients support

• Service clients in the day-to-day work and handle the full account management of a client on an execution-only basis (no investment advice provided) without the involvement of a Relationship Manager

• Attend incoming calls and e-mails and ensures efficient and prompt handling of orders, trades, transactions, deposits, loans etc.

• Handles the account openings for new clients as well as account changes to existing clients, ensures that accurate and high-quality client relationship documentation formalities are met and maintained to a high standard at all times including client identification documentation (CDB), account opening forms and other relevant legal forms

• Interacts with clients globally in an independent and professional manner in all aspects of account management

• Ensures efficient and prompt handling of orders, trades, transactions, etc.

• Proactively takes the lead in client relationship and all related tasks (systems, applications, processes, documents etc.), with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

Business Development

• Manages the internal projects, which impact the account relationships, directly solving the administrative issues that arise and ensuring that all relevant systems are maintained and updated and all documentation collected as necessary

• Organises herself/himself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her own work at all times shares relevant information, ideas, findings and research with colleagues to improve processes and to increase productivity and quality

• Become a subject matter expert on our business products, processes and operations, and remain up-to-date

YOUR PROFILE
Personal and Social

• Very good inter-personal skills, open and approachable, extraordinary Team player

• Systematic, independent, proactive, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform exceedingly well under pressure

• Exceptional communication skills and always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner as well as an excellent situational adaptability

• Takes on extra responsibilities at own initiative, aims for excellence by finding ways to do things smarter, faster, better and is also not afraid to question a status quo

• Positive “can do” attitude and approaches challenges with an open mind

Professional and Technical

• Either at least 5 years of experience as Assistant RM or 3 years of experience as A(R)M and job related higher degree

• Excellent written and oral skills in German, English; additional languages e.g. Italian or French a plus

• In-depth knowledge in banking and client servicing and pronounced knowledge in all asset classes in a portfolio context

• Experience as Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) or Account Manager (AM)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Der Account Manager (AM) ist hauptsächlich für die Betreuung der Kunden (Mitarbeiter der Bank) in der täglichen Arbeit verantwortlich und übernimmt die Verantwortung für die Kontoverwaltung, Dokumentationsformalitäten und Aufgaben im täglichen Betrieb und Projekte, die sich auf die Kontoverwaltung auswirken. Sie / er wird Teil eines Teams sein, das für die Ausführung von Trades verantwortlich ist, und dies beinhaltet den Umgang mit Routineanfragen und Transaktionen sowie die Dokumentation, um die regulatorischen Anforderungen ohne die Beteiligung eines Relationship Managers zu erfüllen. Sie / er zeigt hervorragende berufliche, persönliche sowie soziale Fähigkeiten bei der Verbindung mit Kunden. Der AM sorgt für die operative Kundenkontoverwaltung und interagiert unabhängig mit internen sowie externen Stakeholdern und stellt den Kunden relevante Informationen zur Verfügung. Der AM fungiert als Vorbild, um den Kunden schnell, professionell und freundlich die beste Servicequalität zu bieten und dabei stets die Werte von Julius Bär (Pflege, Leidenschaft und Exzellenz) zu leben. Professionalität und Reaktionsfähigkeit sind der Schlüssel. Der AM zeigt professionelles Engagement für eine hervorragende Verwaltung des Kontos, für Kunden sowie für die Bank und ist bereit, die extra Meile zu gehen.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG
Kundenunterstützung

• Service-Clients in der täglichen Arbeit und übernehmen die vollständige Account-Verwaltung eines Kunden nur auf Ausführungsbasis (keine Anlageberatung) ohne Einbeziehung eines Relationship Managers

• Nehmen Sie an eingehenden Anrufen und E-Mails teil und gewährleisten Sie eine effiziente und zeitnahe Abwicklung von Bestellungen, Trades, Transaktionen, Einlagen, Darlehen usw.

• Verwaltet die Kontoeröffnungen für neue Kunden sowie Kontoänderungen für bestehende Kunden und stellt sicher, dass genaue und qualitativ hochwertige Dokumentationsformalitäten für Kundenbeziehungen eingehalten und jederzeit auf einem hohen Standard gehalten werden, einschließlich Kundenidentifikationsdokumentation (CDB), Kontoeröffnungsformulare und andere relevante Rechtsformen

• Interagiert mit Kunden weltweit in einer unabhängigen und professionellen Art und Weise in allen Aspekten der Kontoverwaltung

• Gewährleistung einer effizienten und zeitnahen Abwicklung von Aufträgen, Trades, Transaktionen usw.

• Proaktiv übernimmt die Führung in der Kundenbeziehung und allen damit verbundenen Aufgaben (Systeme, Anwendungen, Prozesse, Dokumente usw.) mit hoher Qualität, Präzision und zeitnaher Reaktionsfähigkeit

Geschäftsentwicklung

• Verwaltet die internen Projekte, die sich auf die Kontobeziehungen auswirken, löst direkt die auftretenden administrativen Probleme und stellt sicher, dass alle relevanten Systeme gepflegt und aktualisiert und alle erforderlichen Dokumentationen gesammelt werden

• Organisiert sich effizient und konform und sorgt für rechtzeitige und angemessene Informationen des Vorgesetzten

• Führt jederzeit Überprüfungen durch, plant und dokumentiert seine eigene Arbeit und teilt relevante Informationen, Ideen, Erkenntnisse und Forschung mit Kollegen, um Prozesse zu verbessern und Produktivität und Qualität zu steigern.

• Werden Sie Experte für unsere Geschäftsprodukte, Prozesse und Abläufe und bleiben Sie auf dem neuesten Stand

IHR PROFIL
Persönlich und sozial

• Sehr gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, offen und zugänglich, außergewöhnlicher Teamplayer

• Systematischer, unabhängiger, proaktiver, präziser und sorgfältiger Arbeitsstil und die Fähigkeit, unter Druck überaus gut zu arbeiten

• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kommuniziert immer freundlich, kompetent und professionell sowie eine hervorragende situative Anpassungsfähigkeit

• Übernimmt aus eigener Initiative zusätzliche Verantwortung, strebt Exzellenz an, indem es Wege findet, Dinge intelligenter, schneller und besser zu machen, und hat auch keine Angst, einen Status quo in Frage zu stellen

• Positive "Can Do" -Haltung und nähert sich Herausforderungen mit einem offenen Geist

Professionell und technisch

• Entweder mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Assistant RM oder 3 Jahre Erfahrung als A(R)M und berufsbezogener Hochschulabschluss

• Hervorragende schriftliche und mündliche Fähigkeiten in Deutsch, Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen z.B. Italienisch oder Französisch ein Plus

• Tiefe Kenntnisse im Bank- und Kundenservice und ausgeprägte Kenntnisse in allen Anlageklassen im Portfoliokontext

• Erfahrung als Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) oder Account Manager (AM)

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Le gestionnaire de compte (AM) est principalement chargé de fournir des services aux clients (employés de la Banque) dans le cadre du travail quotidien et prend en charge l'administration du compte, les formalités de documentation et les tâches dans le cadre des opérations quotidiennes et des projets ayant une incidence sur l'administration du compte. Elle fera partie d'une équipe responsable de l'exécution des métiers, ce qui implique de traiter les demandes de renseignements et les transactions courantes ainsi que la documentation pour satisfaire aux exigences réglementaires sans la participation d'un gestionnaire des relations. Elle fait preuve d'excellentes compétences professionnelles, personnelles et sociales en liaison avec ses clients. Elle assure la gestion opérationnelle du compte client et interagit de façon indépendante avec les intervenants internes et externes et fournit aux clients des renseignements pertinents. L'AM sert de modèle en apportant la meilleure qualité de service aux clients de manière rapide, professionnelle et amicale, en vivant toujours les valeurs de Julius Baer (Care, Passion, Excellence). Le professionnalisme et la réactivité sont essentiels. L'AM fait preuve d'un engagement professionnel à assurer une excellente administration du compte, aux clients ainsi qu'à la Banque et est prêt à aller au-delà.

Votre défi
Soutien aux clients

• Les clients de services dans le travail quotidien et de gérer la gestion complète du compte d'un client sur une base d'exécution seulement (aucun conseil d'investissement fourni) sans la participation d'un gestionnaire de relations

• Assister aux appels et aux courriels entrants et assurer un traitement efficace et rapide des commandes, des transactions, des dépôts, des prêts, etc.

• S'occupe des ouvertures de compte pour les nouveaux clients ainsi que des changements de compte pour les clients existants, veille à ce que les formalités de documentation de la relation client soient respectées et maintenues à un niveau élevé en tout temps, y compris la documentation d'identification du client (DBC), les formulaires d'ouverture de compte et d'autres formulaires juridiques pertinents

• Interagit avec les clients du monde entier de manière indépendante et professionnelle dans tous les aspects de la gestion des comptes

• Assurer un traitement efficace et rapide des commandes, des transactions, etc.

• Prise proactive en charge de la relation client et de toutes les tâches connexes (systèmes, applications, processus, documents, etc.), avec une grande qualité, précision et réactivité en temps opportun

Développement des entreprises

• Gère les projets internes qui influent sur les relations de compte, résolvent directement les problèmes administratifs qui se posent et veillent à ce que tous les systèmes pertinents soient maintenus et mis à jour et à ce que toute la documentation recueillie au besoin

• S'organise de manière efficace et conforme et assure l'information opportune et appropriée du supérieur

• Examine, planifie et documente en tout temps ses propres travaux en partageant des informations, des idées, des constatations et des recherches pertinentes avec des collègues afin d'améliorer les processus et d'accroître la productivité et la qualité.

• Devenez un expert en matière de produits, de procédés et d'opérations commerciaux, et restez à jour

VOTRE PROFIL
Personnel et social

• Très bonnes compétences interpersonnelles, ouvertes et accessibles, joueur d'équipe extraordinaire

• Style de travail systématique, indépendant, proactif, précis et diligent et capacité à effectuer des performances extrêmement bonnes sous pression

• Compétences de communication exceptionnelles et communication toujours amicale, compétente et professionnelle ainsi qu'une excellente adaptabilité situationnelle

• Prend des responsabilités supplémentaires de sa propre initiative, vise l'excellence en trouvant des façons de faire les choses plus intelligentes, plus rapides, mieux et n'a pas peur de remettre en question un statu quo

• L'attitude positive peut faire et approche les défis avec un esprit ouvert

Professionnel et technique

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant qu'adjoint RM ou 3 ans d'expérience en tant que MA et grade supérieur lié à l'emploi

• Excellente maîtrise de l'écrit et de l'oral en allemand, anglais; langues supplémentaires, par exemple l'italien ou le français a plus

• Connaissance approfondie des services bancaires et des services à la clientèle et connaissance prononcée de toutes les classes d'actifs dans un contexte de portefeuille

• Expérience en tant que gestionnaire de relations adjoint (ARM) ou gestionnaire de comptes (AM)

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète par l'intermédiaire de notre outil d'application en ligne. D'autres possibilités d'emploi intéressantes se trouvent sur notre site de carrière.
Ce n'est pas tout à fait ce que vous cherchez ? Configurez une alerte d'emploi en créant un compte candidat ici.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

For our Governance & Policies team within the Central Compliance Department based in Zurich, we are looking for a Compliance Officer to join the team. Our team acts as central hub for policies and standards and is responsible for maintaining a robust Compliance Risk Framework which is essential for upholding regulatory request, promoting effective governance and ensuring highest  standards of compliance across our operations.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Handle third-party due diligence requests incl. the development and implementation of solutions to support continuous improvement of related processes and procedures

• Support Risk Type Owners in Compliance with the implementation of regulatory developments and industry best practices into internal policies and standards

• Support the enhancement and implementation of global Compliance standards

• Participate in key initiatives to set up new methodologies & standards

• Maintenance of the Compliance Risk Management Framework incl. coordination of the Global Compliance Program and regulatory and/or external audits

• Opportunity to interact with senior stakeholders within Compliance and Business and as well as with the Group’s international locations

• Collaborate with partners across all three Lines of Defence and domestic and foreign Group affiliates

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree or equivalent (preferably in law, compliance, banking & finance, business administration)

• Minimum 3 years of banking industry experience with a focus on conceptional work in a compliance, risk management, legal or audit function in the area of Private Banking. Experience with Policies and Governance is a plus

• Strong analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills in approaching tasks, team-player, proactive attitude, in addition to attention to detail

• Stress-resistant, ability to cope with tight deadlines and deliver independently under time pressure

• Good communication skills, ability to build and maintain sound relationship with stakeholders

• Fluent in written and spoken English, other languages are an advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

• Forte capacità analitiche, concettuali e di problem solving nell'avvicinarsi a compiti, team-player, atteggiamento proattivo, oltre ad attenzione ai dettagli

Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Für unser Governance & Policies-Team in der Central Compliance-Abteilung mit Sitz in Zürich suchen wir einen Compliance Officer, der sich dem Team anschließt. Unser Team fungiert als zentrale Drehscheibe für Richtlinien und Standards und ist für die Aufrechterhaltung eines robusten Compliance-Risiko-Rahmens verantwortlich, der für die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen, die Förderung einer effektiven Governance und die Gewährleistung höchster Compliance-Standards in unseren Betrieben unerlässlich ist.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG

• Bearbeitung von Due-Diligence-Anfragen von Drittanbietern inkl. Entwicklung und Implementierung von Lösungen zur Unterstützung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der damit verbundenen Prozesse und Verfahren

• Unterstützung von Risikotyp-Eigentümern bei der Umsetzung von regulatorischen Entwicklungen und Best Practices in interne Richtlinien und Standards

• Unterstützung der Verbesserung und Umsetzung globaler Compliance-Standards

• Teilnahme an wichtigen Initiativen zur Einrichtung neuer Methoden und Standards

• Pflege des Compliance Risk Management Frameworks inkl. Koordination des Global Compliance Programms und regulatorischer und/oder externer Audits

• Gelegenheit zur Interaktion mit hochrangigen Stakeholdern innerhalb von Compliance und Business sowie mit den internationalen Standorten der Gruppe

• Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern in allen drei Verteidigungslinien sowie in- und ausländischen Konzerngesellschaften

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Performance- & Initiative Manager 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.
We are looking for a highly motivated Financial Analyst, Performance- & Initiative Manager who is passionate about driving finance related projects and create impact on profitability, performance and cost management topics for Julius Baer’s private banking business in Western Markets & Switzerland.
You will be joining a dynamic and experienced team of Finance experts who act as sparring partners to the regional senior management, supporting them in achieving their objectives and anticipating trends in the financial performance at an early stage.
In this challenging and exciting role, you will be part of the CFO Western Markets & Switzerland team, and report to the Head of Performance Management, Business Partnering & Initiatives

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Drive & perform in-depth quantitative analyses (using Management Information System) to identify Front Office trends & insights at an early stage with respect to P&L impact and the use of Balance Sheet products and define actionable measures to drive & improve respective performance

• Lead & coordinate initiatives that trigger improvement of front office P&L performance – incl. conceptualization, implementation and rollout with reporting & progress tracking (e.g. revenue / profitability initiatives etc.), for the biggest Region within the Bank’s global business

• Prepare concise, insightful & visually appealing presentations on various finance topics for management meetings

• Act as a sparring partner to the Front in the context of Finance topics, with direct exposure to senior management and key stakeholders across the bank (e.g. Accounting, Treasury, Capital Management, Credit)

• Run business case assessments and market strategy reviews on a regular basis and derive conclusions for decision-making

• Enhance Performance Management and reporting landscape to enable tracking of Julius Baer's long term business strategy execution

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong academic record: University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or comparable field of study with above-average grades

• At least 2-3 years of experience in a comparable finance or related function within banking / financial industry or in management consulting with focus on banking

• Good knowledge and understanding of the Private Banking business and global financial markets

• Excellent slide writing skills with ability to prepare ‘target audience specific’ communication

• Advanced Excel and data handling skills paired with affinity to derive in-depth quantitative analyses

• Further knowledge of data analytics & visualization applications (e.g. Tableau) are an advantage

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multiple senior stakeholders

• Strong analytical, conceptual skills, fast thinker and outstanding team player

• Capital / balance sheet management knowledge (incl. implications of interest rate development) is a plus

• Strong personal drive with good organizational and multi-tasking skills as well as ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

• Highly motivated, independent, pro-active and meticulous work method with a results-oriented mindset and problem-solving attitude

• Fluent in German & English (spoken and written), other languages are an advantage

• Eligibility to work in the country where you apply for the position

Ti unirai a un team dinamico ed esperto di esperti di finanza che agiscono come partner risparmiatore per la gestione senior regionale, supportandoli nel raggiungimento dei loro obiettivi e anticipando le tendenze delle prestazioni finanziarie in una fase iniziale.
In questo ruolo stimolante ed emozionante, sarete parte del team CFO Western Markets & Switzerland e riferirete al responsabile della gestione delle prestazioni, Business Partnering & Initiatives

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Drive & esegue analisi quantitative approfondite (utilizzando Management Information System) per identificare le tendenze e le intuizioni di Front Office in una fase iniziale rispetto all'impatto P&L e all'uso dei prodotti Balance Sheet e definire misure attuabili per guidare e migliorare le rispettive prestazioni

• Lead & coordinate iniziative che innescano il miglioramento delle prestazioni P&L di front office – incl. concettualizzazione, implementazione e rollout con reporting & progress tracking (ad esempio entrate / iniziative di redditività ecc), per la più grande Regione all’interno del business globale della Banca

• Preparare presentazioni concise, intuitive e visivamente accattivanti su vari argomenti di finanza per riunioni di gestione

• Agire come partner sparring al fronte nel contesto di argomenti di finanza, con esposizione diretta a senior management e stakeholder chiave in tutta la banca (ad esempio contabilità, tesoreria, gestione del capitale, credito)

• Eseguire le valutazioni dei casi aziendali e le recensioni di strategia di mercato regolarmente e trarre conclusioni per il processo decisionale

• Migliorare la gestione delle prestazioni e il paesaggio di reportistica per consentire il tracciamento dell'esecuzione di strategia aziendale a lungo termine di Julius Baer

Il tuo progetto

• Forte record accademico: laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Economia o campo di studio comparabile con gradi superiori alla media

• Almeno 2-3 anni di esperienza in una finanza comparabile o funzione correlata all'interno del settore bancario / finanziario o in consulenza di gestione con attenzione al settore bancario

• Buona conoscenza e comprensione del business Private Banking e dei mercati finanziari globali

• Eccellente capacità di scrittura dello slide con la capacità di preparare la comunicazione 'target audience specific'

• Avanzate Excel e capacità di gestione dei dati abbinate all'affinità per ricavare approfondite analisi quantitative

• Ulteriori conoscenze sulle applicazioni di analisi e visualizzazione dei dati (ad esempio Tableau) sono un vantaggio

• Forte comunicazione e competenze interpersonali per collaborare con più stakeholder senior

• Forte capacità analitiche, concettuali, pensiero veloce e giocatore di squadra eccezionale

• La conoscenza della gestione del bilancio (incluse le implicazioni dello sviluppo dei tassi di interesse) è un plus

• Forte unità personale con buone capacità organizzative e multi-tasking così come la capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e soddisfare scadenze strette

• Metodo di lavoro altamente motivato, indipendente, proattivo e meticoloso con una mentalità orientata ai risultati e un atteggiamento di problem solving

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese (spoken e scritto), altre lingue sono un vantaggio

• Ammissibilità di lavorare nel paese in cui si applica per la posizione
