descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

At Julius Baer, we are committed to empowering our teams through a DevOps-driven approach. To achieve this, we are focused on developing scalable platforms that enable our product teams to self-serve their infrastructure and resource needs. As our application landscape evolves, we're investing in the expansion of our infrastructure automation capabilities - with Crossplane and Kubernetes-native control planes at the core of that strategy.

Join our team as a Platform Engineer and play a key role in designing and delivering automation solutions that drive efficiency across the organization by replacing manual processes with automated self-service offerings.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Lead the design, development, and implementation of Kubernetes-native control planes using Crossplane, building providers and functions in Golang following the Kubernetes Operator pattern

• Design and extend self-service infrastructure offerings that let product teams provision and manage their own resources reliably and at scale

• Build and maintain workflow automation on our orchestration platform, including writing and reviewing the underlying business logic in JavaScript and other scripting languages (we're also evaluating and migrating toward a new automation tooling stack, so adaptability here matters)

• Enable and coach product teams on how to build and extend their own automations on top of the platform, through documentation, workshops, and hands-on guidance - supporting our self-service strategy beyond just building the platform itself

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with business objectives and technical strategies

• Contribute technical expertise to the team and help shape technical roadmaps and strategic direction for our automation platforms

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across the control plane and automation tooling, and recommend improvements

• Stay up to date with the latest trends in cloud-native computing, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation, and apply this knowledge to continuously improve our solutions

• Contribute to technical documentation, including design documents, implementation guides, and operational procedures

• Ensure compliance with industry standards, best practices, and organisational policies

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 3 years of experience developing and operating Kubernetes Operators, ideally using Golang and the Crossplane framework, to provision and continuously reconcile resources

• Experience building or extending workflow automation tooling including writing business logic in JavaScript, Python, PowerShell, or similar - deep expertise in any specific vendor tool is not required, as we understand tools change over time

• Expert knowledge of Kubernetes and the cloud-native computing ecosystem

• Strong understanding of software development processes, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tooling

• Experience with Golang and at least one scripting language such as JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python

• Experience with Git and agile development methodologies

• Understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure (Windows, Linux, networking, virtualisation, cloud) is a big plus

• Proven experience delivering technical projects independently, and collaborating effectively with multiple technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Experience teaching, coaching, or enabling other teams or engineers to adopt new tools and ways of working (e.g. through workshops, documentation, or pairing), even without formal people-management responsibility

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities and deadlines

• Ability to quickly grasp complex requirements, fast learner, highly proactive

• Proven track record in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

• Fluent in English, German is a plus

• Maintenance of master data for forms.

• LEI (Legal Entity Identifier) Management – application / renewal

• Support Clean-Up excercises

YOUR PROFILE

• Banking apprenticeship and/or higher education

• At least 3 years of professional experience in the client documentation service

• Knowledge of banking regulatory requirements regarding due diligence (CDB)

• Experience handling client database systems such as CRM, CLM, Know your client (KYC) tool

• Experience within a financial institution and sound knowledge of banking practices

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and structured thinking

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills English and German, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and professionally

• Proactive, solution-driven mindset with a strong willingness to learn and contribute

Il tuo progetto

• Apprendistato bancario e/o istruzione superiore

• Conoscenza dei requisiti di regolamentazione in materia di due diligence (CDB)

• Gestione dell'esperienza sistemi di database client come CRM, CLM, Conosci il tuo strumento client (KYC)

• Esperienza all'interno di un istituto finanziario e solida conoscenza delle pratiche bancarie

• Capacità di gestire le priorità concorrenti sotto pressione, lavorare collaborativamente in team, e adattarsi rapidamente ad un ambiente dinamico e veloce

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

A Julius Baer, siamo orgogliosi di fornire servizi bancari privati eccezionali ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Promuoviamo una cultura di eccellenza, innovazione e sviluppo continuo, creando opportunità per professionisti di talento per crescere e fare un impatto significativo.

Per rafforzare ulteriormente il nostro principale franchising mutuo svizzero, stiamo cercando un responsabile di eccellenza operativa proattivo e guidato dai risultati per unirsi al nostro nuovo COO Real Estate Team. Questo ruolo fondamentale offre l'opportunità di modellare il futuro delle nostre operazioni ipotecarie nazionali, migliorare il processo di guida e fornire servizi di alta qualità in tutto il ciclo di vita del mutuo.

Il vostro ruolo – Efficienza di guida, Qualità & innovazione
Come membro chiave dell'unità operativa di Real Estate, vi assicurerete l'amministrazione liscia e conforme del portafoglio mutuo svizzero di Julius Baer dall'origine alla maturità. Combinando la precisione con il pensiero strategico, gestirai flussi di lavoro operativi critici, mantieni rigorosi standard di controllo e fornisci informazioni attuabili che consentano il processo decisionale informato in tutta l'organizzazione. Equilibrete l'esecuzione pratica con i contributi previsionali alle iniziative di trasformazione, aiutandoci ad alzare la barra nella resilienza operativa, nella digitalizzazione e nell'eccellenza del servizio clienti.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Gestione del ciclo di vita

• Controllare il percorso amministrativo completo delle strutture ipotecarie — dalla prenotazione iniziale e modifiche al rinnovo, il rimborso anticipato, e la risoluzione finale.

• Eseguire attività transazionali con precisione e tempestività, inclusi nuovi prestiti, modifiche, rifinanziamento e aggiornamenti di sistema.

• Assicurare l'integrità dei dati coerente attraverso il core banking e sistemi immobiliari, servendo come fonte attendibile di verità.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con Front Office, Mortgage Advisory, Credit Risk, Legal e partner esterni per garantire esperienze client senza soluzione di continuità e agilità operativa.

Controlli, conformità e integrità del processo

• Condurre controlli operativi giornalieri, riconciliazione e monitoraggio delle eccezioni per salvaguardare l'accuratezza dei dati e l'affidabilità del processo.

• Sostenere l'adesione alle politiche interne e i requisiti normativi in evoluzione (comprese le iniziative FINMA oversight, SNB).

• Identificare, escalare e risolvere i rischi operativi e gli elementi in sospeso per mantenere la disponibilità di audit.

• Contribuire a raffinare le SOP, i quadri di controllo e le misure di mitigazione dei rischi.

Iniziative strategiche e trasformazione aziendale

• Agire come partner operativo in progetti multifunzionali focalizzati sull'automazione, la digitalizzazione e il miglioramento del customer journey.

• Identificare inefficienze e soluzioni scalabili co-design che elevano produttività e qualità dei servizi.

• Assistere nella definizione di processi futuri-stato, integrazioni tecnologiche e rollout di gestione dei cambiamenti.

Il tuo progetto

• Completata l'istruzione terziaria — una laurea universitaria o una qualifica commerciale (EFZ) con relativa formazione ulteriore

• 3-5 anni di solida esperienza nelle operazioni ipotecarie svizzere o nell'amministrazione dei prestiti, idealmente all'interno di istituti finanziari privati o al dettaglio

• Conoscenza approfondita del ciclo di vita mutuo svizzero, tipi di prodotto, gestione collaterale e relativi flussi di lavoro operativi

• Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione dei dati, nel reporting e nei controlli operativi — la familiarità con le aspettative normative è un vantaggio distinto

• Forte capacità analitiche e un interesse naturale per l'ottimizzazione dei processi, sia nei compiti quotidiani che nelle trasformazioni su larga scala

• Gode di lavoro basato sul progetto; automotivato per prendere l'iniziativa e vedere gli sforzi attraverso il completamento di successo

• Confortevole funzionamento autonomo mentre la costruzione di relazioni efficaci tra dipartimenti e gerarchie

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese (scritto e parlato); la competenza in francese o italiano è un bene significativo

• Avanzato utente di Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint); esperienza precedente con piattaforme di core banking o sistemi CRM/loan è vantaggioso

Bei Julius Bär sind wir stolz darauf, unseren Kunden weltweit außergewöhnliche Private-Banking-Dienstleistungen zu bieten. Wir fördern eine Kultur der Exzellenz, Innovation und kontinuierlicher Entwicklung und schaffen Möglichkeiten für talentierte Fachleute, zu wachsen und eine sinnvolle Wirkung zu erzielen.

Um unser führendes Schweizer Hypotheken-Franchise weiter zu stärken, suchen wir einen proaktiven und ergebnisorientierten Operational Excellence Officer, der sich unserem neu gegründeten COO Real Estate Team anschließt. Als wichtiges Mitglied der Real Estate Operations Unit sorgen Sie für eine reibungslose und konforme Verwaltung des Schweizer Hypothekenportfolios von Julius Bär von der Entstehung bis zur Fälligkeit. Durch die Kombination von Präzision und strategischem Denken verwalten Sie kritische operative Workflows, halten strenge Kontrollstandards ein und liefern umsetzbare Erkenntnisse, die eine fundierte Entscheidungsfindung im gesamten Unternehmen ermöglichen. End-to-End Mortgage Operations & Lifecycle Management

Chez Julius Baer, nous sommes fiers de fournir des services bancaires privés exceptionnels à nos clients dans le monde entier. Nous favorisons une culture d'excellence, d'innovation et de développement continu, créant des occasions pour les professionnels talentueux de croître et d'avoir un impact significatif.

Pour renforcer encore notre franchise hypothécaire suisse, nous cherchons un agent d'excellence opérationnelle proactif et axé sur les résultats pour rejoindre notre équipe immobilière COO nouvellement créée. Ce rôle central offre l'occasion de façonner l'avenir de nos opérations hypothécaires nationales, d'améliorer les processus et de fournir des services de haute qualité tout au long du cycle de vie des prêts hypothécaires.

Votre rôle – Diriger l'efficacité, la qualité et l'innovation
En tant que membre clé de l'unité d'opérations immobilières, vous assurerez la bonne administration et la conformité du portefeuille hypothécaire suisse Julius Baer. Combinant précision et pensée stratégique, vous gérerez les flux de travail opérationnels critiques, respecterez des normes de contrôle rigoureuses et fournirez des informations pratiques qui permettent une prise de décision éclairée dans toute l'organisation. Vous équilibrerez l'exécution pratique avec des contributions tournées vers l'avenir à des initiatives de transformation, nous aidant à relever la barre dans la résilience opérationnelle, la numérisation et l'excellence du service à la clientèle.

Opérations hypothécaires de bout en bout et gestion du cycle de vie

• Appuyer le respect des politiques internes et l'évolution des exigences réglementaires (y compris la surveillance de la FINMA, les initiatives de la BNS).

• Déterminer, intensifier et résoudre les risques opérationnels et les éléments en attente afin de maintenir la capacité de vérification.

• Contribuer à raffiner les PNE, les cadres de contrôle et les mesures d'atténuation des risques.

Initiatives stratégiques et transformation opérationnelle

• Agir en tant que partenaire opérationnel dans les projets interfonctionnels axés sur l'automatisation, la numérisation et l'amélioration du parcours client.

• Identifier les inefficacités et co-concevoir des solutions évolutives qui augmentent la productivité et la qualité du service.

• Aider à façonner les processus futurs, les intégrations technologiques et les déploiements de gestion du changement.

VOTRE PROFIL

• 3–5 ans d'expérience solide dans les opérations hypothécaires suisses ou l'administration de prêts, idéalement au sein de banques privées ou d'institutions financières de détail

• Connaissance approfondie du cycle de vie des prêts hypothécaires suisses, des types de produits, du traitement des garanties et des flux de travail opérationnels connexes

• Expérience démontrée en matière de gestion des données, de rapports et de contrôles opérationnels — la connaissance des attentes réglementaires constitue un avantage distinct

• Fortes capacités d'analyse et un intérêt naturel pour l'optimisation des processus, que ce soit dans les tâches quotidiennes ou les transformations à grande échelle

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a strong Java engineer to develop and maintain a High-Performance Computing (HPC) cluster comprising hundreds of servers (on-premises and augmented by Microsoft Azure). This cluster provides critical computing power to a modern trading floor.

The cluster scheduling and control systems are primarily built in Java, with Apache Ignite as the clustering layer. Jobs are received from internal clients via legacy HTTP and ActiveMQ interfaces, while modern clients use an in-house API developed in Java and Python. System statistics are collected in MongoDB and Elastic/Kibana.

This role requires ensuring high availability for a mission-critical resource, developing a deep understanding of a large existing codebase, and proposing improvements. You will also maintain and enhance multiple monitoring systems for both infrastructure and client job submissions.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Future-proof and maintain Java-based cluster scheduling and control systems

• Ensure high availability and reliability of HPC resources

• Maintain and improve monitoring systems for infrastructure and client submissions

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to balance resource allocation with business requirements

• Troubleshoot and optimize performance across on-prem and Azure-augmented environments

• Ensure compliance with banking regulatory requirements

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong Java multithreaded development expertise ​(core and enterprise-level)

Experience with:

• Distributed Execution Engines.

• NoSQL Databases

• ActiveMQ (messaging)

• Front-end Web Technologies (legacy UI maintenance)

• Python (for API and tooling)

Familiarity with:

• Azure Portal and Azure SDK for Java

• Red Hat Linux

• Understanding of banking systems and regulatory requirements

• Language: Fluent English; German is a plus

Bonus Skills:

• Scala and C++

• Kubernetes (container orchestration)

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a strong Java engineer to develop and maintain a High-Performance Computing (HPC) cluster comprising hundreds of servers (on-premises and augmented by Microsoft Azure). This cluster provides critical computing power to a modern trading floor.

The cluster scheduling and control systems are primarily built in Java, with Apache Ignite as the clustering layer. Jobs are received from internal clients via legacy HTTP and ActiveMQ interfaces, while modern clients use an in-house API developed in Java and Python. System statistics are collected in MongoDB and Elastic/Kibana.

This role requires ensuring high availability for a mission-critical resource, developing a deep understanding of a large existing codebase, and proposing improvements. You will also maintain and enhance multiple monitoring systems for both infrastructure and client job submissions.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to balance resource allocation with business requirements

• Troubleshoot and optimize performance across on-prem and Azure-augmented environments

• Ensure compliance with banking regulatory requirements

YOUR PROFILE

Experience with:

• Distributed Execution Engines.

jobs.title: Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) to join our global security engineering team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you possess deep expertise in secure remote access technologies, strong authentication and identity integration skills, and hands-on experience operating enterprise-grade remote connectivity platforms within a regulated financial services environment. You are comfortable working across infrastructure, security, endpoint, and identity domains, ensuring that employees, contractors, and approved third parties can securely access corporate resources.

Your primary responsibilities will involve architecting, operating, and continuously improving the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, integrating and maintaining multi-factor authentication solutions, enforcing secure access and conditional access policies, and ensuring the resilience, security, and compliance of the Bank’s remote access services.

In addition, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and operationalisation of the Bank’s future Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform and support the evolution of the remote access landscape towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architecture. Working closely with IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations, and Global IT teams, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and scalable remote connectivity aligned with regulatory requirements and the Bank’s strategic security roadmap.

Beyond the remote access domain, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to and gain hands-on experience with other security services managed by the team, including Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Secure Mail Gateway solutions. This provides an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to broaden their expertise across multiple security domains and further develop their security engineering career within a collaborative and highly skilled team.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated security engineering team, administer, configure, and continuously improve the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience across primary and disaster recovery environments

• Manage and maintain SSL-VPN and clientless access services, including virtual server configurations, authentication policies, rewrite rules, responder policies, and traffic steering mechanisms

• Design, implement, and maintain secure authentication and conditional access policies based on user identity, device type, network location, and contextual risk factors

• Participate in the design, implementation, and rollout of the Bank’s Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform, supporting the transition towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access architecture and contributing to technical design, testing, integration, and operational readiness activities

• Develop and maintain expertise across both Citrix NetScaler Gateway and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) technologies, supporting the Bank’s strategic remote access roadmap and ensuring secure, seamless connectivity across multiple access platforms

• Plan, coordinate, and execute infrastructure upgrades, security patches, policy changes, and platform enhancements in accordance with established change management processes within a regulated financial environment

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support for the Bank’s remote access platforms, acting as an escalation point for complex incidents and participating in a shared 24/7 on-call rotation for critical services

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of independently assessing, prioritising, and resolving complex technical challenges in a structured and efficient manner

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills with a high level of attention to detail, particularly when working within business-critical and highly regulated environments

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and expand expertise across multiple security domains, contributing to the continuous evolution of the Bank’s security services

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT Security or Infrastructure Engineering, with a strong focus on secure remote access, identity management, authentication technologies, and endpoint security

• In-depth expertise in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including hands-on experience with AAA policies, virtual server configuration, SSL-VPN services, high-availability deployments, authentication flows, and troubleshooting via both GUI and CLI

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts and architectures; experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) or comparable ZTNA technologies is considered an advantage

• Practical scripting and automation skills using one or more of PowerShell, Python, or Bash, including automation of certificate validation, health checks, log analysis, and operational tasks through REST APIs, Citrix Nitro API, or comparable interfaces

• Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid identity environments

• Proven experience integrating remote access platforms with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions and modern identity providers

• Strong understanding of endpoint compliance validation, device trust concepts, BYOD access models, and modern remote access security architectures

• Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries, with a solid understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements

• Experience supporting and operating business-critical infrastructure platforms with a focus on availability, resilience, performance, and security

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)

Come candidato ideale, possedete una profonda esperienza in tecnologie di accesso remoto sicuro, forti abilità di autenticazione e integrazione dell'identità e un'esperienza pratica nell'esercizio di piattaforme di connettività remota di livello enterprise all'interno di un ambiente di servizi finanziari regolamentati. Siete a vostro agio a lavorare attraverso infrastrutture, sicurezza, endpoint e domini di identità, assicurando che dipendenti, appaltatori e terze parti approvate possano accedere in modo sicuro alle risorse aziendali. Inoltre, contribuirete alla progettazione, implementazione e implementazione della futura piattaforma Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) e supportate l'evoluzione del paesaggio di accesso remoto verso una moderna architettura Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). Lavorando a stretto contatto con IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations e Global IT team, contribuirete a fornire connettività remota sicura, affidabile e scalabile in linea con i requisiti normativi e la tabella di marcia strategica della Banca per la sicurezza. Oltre al dominio di accesso remoto, avrete anche la possibilità di contribuire e acquisire esperienza pratica con altri servizi di sicurezza gestiti dal team, tra cui Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), e Secure Mail Gateway soluzioni. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) to join our global security engineering team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you possess deep expertise in secure remote access technologies, strong authentication and identity integration skills, and hands-on experience operating enterprise-grade remote connectivity platforms within a regulated financial services environment. You are comfortable working across infrastructure, security, endpoint, and identity domains, ensuring that employees, contractors, and approved third parties can securely access corporate resources.

Your primary responsibilities will involve architecting, operating, and continuously improving the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, integrating and maintaining multi-factor authentication solutions, enforcing secure access and conditional access policies, and ensuring the resilience, security, and compliance of the Bank’s remote access services.

In addition, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and operationalisation of the Bank’s future Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform and support the evolution of the remote access landscape towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architecture. Working closely with IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations, and Global IT teams, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and scalable remote connectivity aligned with regulatory requirements and the Bank’s strategic security roadmap.

Beyond the remote access domain, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to and gain hands-on experience with other security services managed by the team, including Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Secure Mail Gateway solutions. This provides an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to broaden their expertise across multiple security domains and further develop their security engineering career within a collaborative and highly skilled team.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated security engineering team, administer, configure, and continuously improve the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience across primary and disaster recovery environments

• Manage and maintain SSL-VPN and clientless access services, including virtual server configurations, authentication policies, rewrite rules, responder policies, and traffic steering mechanisms

• Design, implement, and maintain secure authentication and conditional access policies based on user identity, device type, network location, and contextual risk factors

• Participate in the design, implementation, and rollout of the Bank’s Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform, supporting the transition towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access architecture and contributing to technical design, testing, integration, and operational readiness activities

• Develop and maintain expertise across both Citrix NetScaler Gateway and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) technologies, supporting the Bank’s strategic remote access roadmap and ensuring secure, seamless connectivity across multiple access platforms

• Plan, coordinate, and execute infrastructure upgrades, security patches, policy changes, and platform enhancements in accordance with established change management processes within a regulated financial environment

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support for the Bank’s remote access platforms, acting as an escalation point for complex incidents and participating in a shared 24/7 on-call rotation for critical services

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of independently assessing, prioritising, and resolving complex technical challenges in a structured and efficient manner

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills with a high level of attention to detail, particularly when working within business-critical and highly regulated environments

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and expand expertise across multiple security domains, contributing to the continuous evolution of the Bank’s security services

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT Security or Infrastructure Engineering, with a strong focus on secure remote access, identity management, authentication technologies, and endpoint security

• In-depth expertise in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including hands-on experience with AAA policies, virtual server configuration, SSL-VPN services, high-availability deployments, authentication flows, and troubleshooting via both GUI and CLI

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts and architectures; experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) or comparable ZTNA technologies is considered an advantage

• Practical scripting and automation skills using one or more of PowerShell, Python, or Bash, including automation of certificate validation, health checks, log analysis, and operational tasks through REST APIs, Citrix Nitro API, or comparable interfaces

• Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid identity environments

• Proven experience integrating remote access platforms with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions and modern identity providers

• Strong understanding of endpoint compliance validation, device trust concepts, BYOD access models, and modern remote access security architectures

• Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries, with a solid understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements

• Experience supporting and operating business-critical infrastructure platforms with a focus on availability, resilience, performance, and security

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Business Manager Intermediaries will serve as a fully integrated role bridging central coordination and on-site operational support across the Market Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas. Combining the strategic and tactical responsibilities, this position ensures efficient execution of global initiatives while providing responsive, market-level support to front-line leaders and stakeholders.

Acting as a two-way conduit between Internal Units and the respective Intermediaries Market, the Business Manager Intermediaries drives alignment, enhances communication, and supports sustainable business growth through structured coordination and operational excellence.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Front-Line Operational Support

• Provide direct assistance to the Market Head Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas, as well as ad-hoc support to Group Heads and Relationship Managers

• Organize and coordinate Management Committees, regular business reviews and strategy sessions

• Track action items etc.; ensure accountability and follow-through

Strategic Coordination & Governance

• Serve as primary liaison between the Intermediaries segment, in particular Market Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas, and central/global functions (e.g., Compliance, IT, Marketing, Operations), facilitating smooth exchange of information and requirements

• Coordinate the implementation of bank-wide projects, initiatives, and regulatory changes at the market level, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards

• Represent the Intermediaries segment in cross-functional working groups; contribute market-relevant perspectives to shaping strategies and solutions

Top-Down Execution

• Receive, evaluate, and prepare centrally driven topics for local adaptation and distribution

• Disseminate approved directives, guidelines, and campaign materials to front-line units

• Monitor execution progress, identify roadblocks, and report outcomes back to central stakeholders

Bottom-Up Escalation

• Act as first point of contact for front-line inputs, feedback, and proposals; conduct initial assessment and prioritization

• Consolidate, refine, and forward relevant market-generated content to central bodies for consideration or action

• Advocate for practical adjustments based on real-world constraints or client needs

Project & Process Management

• Develop presentations, briefing notes, status updates, and decision dossiers for senior management

• Identify recurring inefficiencies and propose structural improvements

• Lead or co-manage workstreams

Deputy Function

• Step in to handle key business management tasks when needed, ensuring smooth operations during absences or busy periods

YOUR PROFILE
Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline (Master’s degree considered advantageous)

• Minimum of 5 years’ professional experience within private banking, wealth management, or financial services, with demonstrated exposure to both operational support and strategic coordination

• Prior experience in a business management, executive support, or intermediary-facing role strongly preferred

• Solid understanding of Swiss banking practices, regulatory expectations, and front-office workflows

Required Skills & Competencies

• Exceptional enthusiasm, with excellent organizational and time-management abilities with keen attention to detail

• Strong analytical skills with proficiency in synthesizing complex information into clear summaries

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in French and English (additional fluency in Spanish and/or German is highly beneficial)

• High level of autonomy combined with teamwork orientation and service-mindedness

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Business Manager Intermediaries will serve as a fully integrated role bridging central coordination and on-site operational support across the Market Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas. Combining the strategic and tactical responsibilities, this position ensures efficient execution of global initiatives while providing responsive, market-level support to front-line leaders and stakeholders.

Acting as a two-way conduit between Internal Units and the respective Intermediaries Market, the Business Manager Intermediaries drives alignment, enhances communication, and supports sustainable business growth through structured coordination and operational excellence.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Front-Line Operational Support

• Provide direct assistance to the Market Head Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas, as well as ad-hoc support to Group Heads and Relationship Managers

• Organize and coordinate Management Committees, regular business reviews and strategy sessions

• Track action items etc.; ensure accountability and follow-through

Strategic Coordination & Governance

• Serve as primary liaison between the Intermediaries segment, in particular Market Intermediaries Western Switzerland & Americas, and central/global functions (e.g., Compliance, IT, Marketing, Operations), facilitating smooth exchange of information and requirements

• Coordinate the implementation of bank-wide projects, initiatives, and regulatory changes at the market level, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards

• Represent the Intermediaries segment in cross-functional working groups; contribute market-relevant perspectives to shaping strategies and solutions

Top-Down Execution

• Receive, evaluate, and prepare centrally driven topics for local adaptation and distribution

• Disseminate approved directives, guidelines, and campaign materials to front-line units

• Monitor execution progress, identify roadblocks, and report outcomes back to central stakeholders

Bottom-Up Escalation

• Act as first point of contact for front-line inputs, feedback, and proposals; conduct initial assessment and prioritization

• Consolidate, refine, and forward relevant market-generated content to central bodies for consideration or action

• Advocate for practical adjustments based on real-world constraints or client needs

Project & Process Management

• Develop presentations, briefing notes, status updates, and decision dossiers for senior management

• Identify recurring inefficiencies and propose structural improvements

• Lead or co-manage workstreams

Deputy Function

• Step in to handle key business management tasks when needed, ensuring smooth operations during absences or busy periods

YOUR PROFILE
Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline (Master’s degree considered advantageous)

• Minimum of 5 years’ professional experience within private banking, wealth management, or financial services, with demonstrated exposure to both operational support and strategic coordination

• Prior experience in a business management, executive support, or intermediary-facing role strongly preferred

• Solid understanding of Swiss banking practices, regulatory expectations, and front-office workflows

Required Skills & Competencies

• Exceptional enthusiasm, with excellent organizational and time-management abilities with keen attention to detail

• Strong analytical skills with proficiency in synthesizing complex information into clear summaries

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in French and English (additional fluency in Spanish and/or German is highly beneficial)

• High level of autonomy combined with teamwork orientation and service-mindedness

Le Business Manager Intermediaries jouera un rôle pleinement intégré qui reliera la coordination centrale et le soutien opérationnel sur place dans les intermédiaires du marché de la Suisse occidentale et des Amériques. Combinant les responsabilités stratégiques et tactiques, ce poste assure l'exécution efficace des initiatives mondiales tout en fournissant un soutien adapté au niveau du marché aux dirigeants de première ligne et aux intervenants.

Agissant comme un canal bidirectionnel entre les unités internes et le marché des intermédiaires, le Business Manager Intermediaries stimule l'alignement, améliore la communication et soutient la croissance durable des entreprises par une coordination structurée et l'excellence opérationnelle.

Votre défi
Soutien opérationnel de première ligne

• Fournir une assistance directe aux intermédiaires du marché Suisse occidentale et Amériques, ainsi qu'un soutien ad hoc aux chefs de groupe et aux gestionnaires de relations

• Organiser et coordonner des comités de gestion, des examens réguliers des activités et des séances de stratégie

• Suivre les mesures à prendre, etc.; assurer la responsabilisation et le suivi

Coordination stratégique et gouvernance

• Servir de liaison principale entre le segment des intermédiaires, en particulier les intermédiaires du marché de la Suisse occidentale et des Amériques, et les fonctions centrales et mondiales (p. ex., conformité, TI, marketing, opérations), en facilitant l'échange d'informations et les exigences

• Coordonner la mise en oeuvre de projets, d'initiatives et de changements réglementaires à l'échelle de la banque au niveau du marché, en veillant au respect des délais et des normes de qualité

• Représenter le segment des intermédiaires dans les groupes de travail interfonctionnels; contribuer à l'élaboration de stratégies et de solutions en fonction du marché

Exécution de haut niveau

• Reçoit, évalue et prépare des thèmes centralisés pour l'adaptation et la distribution locales

• Diffuser les directives, lignes directrices et matériel de campagne approuvés aux unités de première ligne

• Surveiller les progrès de l'exécution, identifier les barrages routiers et rendre compte des résultats aux intervenants centraux

Escalade ascendante

• Agir comme premier point de contact pour les contributions, les commentaires et les propositions de première ligne; procéder à une évaluation initiale et établir des priorités

• Consolider, affiner et transmettre le contenu pertinent généré par le marché aux organes centraux pour examen ou action

• Plaidoyer pour des ajustements pratiques basés sur les contraintes réelles ou les besoins des clients

Gestion de projet et de processus

• Élaborer des présentations, des notes d'information, des mises à jour et des dossiers de décision pour la haute direction

• Identifier les inefficacités récurrentes et proposer des améliorations structurelles

• Secteurs de travail du plomb ou de la cogestion

Fonction adjointe

• Étape dans la gestion des tâches clés de gestion d'entreprise au besoin, en assurant des opérations en douceur pendant les absences ou les périodes occupées

VOTRE PROFIL
Qualifications et expérience

• Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances, économie, ou une discipline connexe (diplôme de maîtrise considéré comme avantageux)

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle au sein de la banque privée, de la gestion de patrimoine ou des services financiers, avec une exposition démontrée au soutien opérationnel et à la coordination stratégique

• Expérience antérieure dans un rôle de gestion d'entreprise, de soutien aux cadres ou d'intermédiaire fortement préféré

• Une bonne compréhension des pratiques bancaires suisses, des attentes en matière de réglementation et des flux de travail de première ligne

Compétences requises

• Un enthousiasme exceptionnel, avec d'excellentes capacités organisationnelles et de gestion du temps avec une attention particulière aux détails

• Fortes compétences analytiques en synthèse d'informations complexes

• Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite en français et en anglais (une maîtrise supplémentaire en espagnol et/ou en allemand est très bénéfique)

• Niveau élevé d'autonomie associé à l'orientation du travail d'équipe et à l'esprit de service

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

This is a challenging and interesting role as a legal counsel with a focus on legal and regulatory matters in relation to the provision of financial services (advisory and discretionary management) as well wealth planning solutions within the team Legal Investment Solutions & Distribution.

The team consists of highly qualified lawyers located at the Head Office in Zurich. The team is part of the General Counsel Wealth Management sub-division and provides legal advice to our stakeholders, including senior management from the Division Global Products & Solutions (GPS) of Bank Julius Baer & Co. Ltd. Our work is truly international as we closely collaborate with other teams around the globe with the aim to provide tailor-made solutions with a hands-on approach. We are a dynamic, highly motivated team and pride ourselves in our excellent team spirit and supportive atmosphere.

This global role has a multijurisdictional scope, allows you to work on a wide variety of contractual and regulatory topics in relation to onshore and cross-border financial and wealth planning services. From the very beginning, you will handle your own portfolio of tasks. You therefore have a direct impact on Julius Baer’s legal affairs and business. You will also have a close working relationship with compliance, front office and front risk management.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Act as legal expert for financial and wealth planning services (including advisory and discretionary mandate services, as well as trust, pension and life insurance solutions)

• Assess and review B2B documentation and agreements, particularly with external partners and providers, in relation to wealth planning services

• Provide guidance to senior management and internal stakeholders on projects and initiatives

• Monitor legal and regulatory developments in Switzerland and assess potential risks related to cross-border service provision (incl. civil liability and regulatory risks)

• Support legal colleagues participating in internal committees by providing wealth planning expertise

• Contribute to strategic projects and deliver ad-hoc legal support, offering efficient, client-oriented solutions related to FinSA and MiFID

YOUR PROFILE

• Master’s degree in law (preferably from a Swiss University) and admission to the bar; additional qualifications such as an LL.M. are an asset

• 1-3 years of professional experience, preferably in a law firm, financial institution of consulting firm

• Profound understanding of Swiss banking and contract law as well as the Swiss regulatory landscape

• Analytical, structured and solution orientated with a proactive approach and capable of translating legal requirements into business-oriented solutions

• A proactive and solution-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently and as a team-player in groups

• Ability to perform under pressure and efficiently handle different competing tasks and priorities

• Good communication skills and a natural capacity to convincingly share ideas

• Excellent proficiency in English and German, knowledge of additional languages is considered an advantage

Il team è composto da avvocati altamente qualificati situati presso la sede centrale di Zurigo. Il team fa parte della divisione General Counsel Wealth Management e fornisce consulenza legale ai nostri stakeholder, tra cui la gestione senior della Division Global Products & Solutions (GPS) di Bank Julius Baer & Co. Ltd. Il nostro lavoro è veramente internazionale mentre collaboriamo a stretto contatto con altre squadre in tutto il mondo con l'obiettivo di fornire soluzioni su misura con un approccio pratico. Siamo un team dinamico e altamente motivato e siamo orgogliosi del nostro eccellente spirito di squadra e dell'atmosfera di supporto.

Questo ruolo globale ha una portata multigiurisdizionale, consente di lavorare su una vasta gamma di argomenti contrattuali e regolamentari in relazione ai servizi di pianificazione finanziaria e patrimoniale onshore e transfrontaliera. Fin dall'inizio, gestirai il tuo portafoglio di compiti. Avete quindi un impatto diretto sugli affari legali e gli affari di Julius Baer. Avrete anche una stretta relazione di lavoro con la conformità, l'ufficio frontale e la gestione del rischio anteriore.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Atto come esperto legale per i servizi di pianificazione finanziaria e patrimoniale (inclusi servizi di consulenza e mandato discrezionale, così come soluzioni di fiducia, pensione e assicurazione sulla vita)

• Fornire una guida alla gestione senior e agli stakeholder interni su progetti e iniziative

• Monitorare gli sviluppi legali e normativi in Svizzera e valutare i potenziali rischi legati alla fornitura di servizi transfrontalieri (incl. responsabilità civile e rischi normativi)

• Sostenere i colleghi legali che partecipano ai comitati interni fornendo competenze di pianificazione della ricchezza

• Contribuire a progetti strategici e fornire supporto giuridico ad-hoc, offrendo soluzioni efficienti e orientate al cliente relative a FinSA e MiFID

Il tuo progetto

• Laurea magistrale in diritto (preferibilmente presso un'Università Svizzera) e ammissione al bar; qualifiche aggiuntive come un LL.M. sono un bene

• 1-3 anni di esperienza professionale, preferibilmente in uno studio legale, istituzione finanziaria di società di consulenza

• Una profonda comprensione del diritto bancario e contrattuale svizzero e del paesaggio normativo svizzero

• Analitico, strutturato e soluzione orientato con un approccio proattivo e capace di tradurre i requisiti legali in soluzioni orientate al business

• Una mentalità proattiva e orientata alla soluzione con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come giocatore di squadra in gruppi

• Capacità di eseguire sotto pressione e gestire in modo efficiente diversi compiti e priorità concorrenti

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e una capacità naturale di condividere con convinzione idee

• Ottima competenza in inglese e tedesco, la conoscenza delle lingue aggiuntive è considerata un vantaggio

Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Dies ist eine herausfordernde und interessante Rolle als Rechtsberater mit Schwerpunkt auf rechtlichen und regulatorischen Fragen in Bezug auf die Bereitstellung von Finanzdienstleistungen (Beratungs- und Ermessensmanagement) sowie Vermögensplanungslösungen im Team Legal Investment Solutions & Distribution.

Das Team besteht aus hochqualifizierten Juristen am Hauptsitz in Zürich. Das Team ist Teil des Unterbereichs General Counsel Wealth Management und bietet Rechtsberatung für unsere Stakeholder, einschließlich der Geschäftsleitung der Division Global Products & Solutions (GPS) der Bank Julius Bär & Co. Ltd. Unsere Arbeit ist wirklich international, da wir eng mit anderen Teams auf der ganzen Welt zusammenarbeiten, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen mit einem praktischen Ansatz anzubieten. Wir sind ein dynamisches, hochmotiviertes Team und stolz auf unseren exzellenten Teamgeist und unsere unterstützende Atmosphäre.

Diese globale Rolle hat einen multijurisdiktionalen Umfang und ermöglicht es Ihnen, an einer Vielzahl von vertraglichen und regulatorischen Themen in Bezug auf Onshore- und grenzüberschreitende Finanz- und Vermögensplanungsdienste zu arbeiten. Von Anfang an übernehmen Sie Ihr eigenes Aufgabenportfolio. Sie haben somit direkten Einfluss auf die rechtlichen Angelegenheiten und Geschäfte von Julius Bär. Sie haben auch eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit Compliance, Front Office und Front-Risikomanagement.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG

• Tätigkeit als Rechtsexperte für Finanz- und Vermögensplanungsdienstleistungen (einschließlich beratender und diskretionärer Mandatsdienstleistungen sowie Treuhand-, Renten- und Lebensversicherungslösungen)

• Bewertung und Überprüfung der B2B-Dokumentation und -Vereinbarungen, insbesondere mit externen Partnern und Anbietern, in Bezug auf Vermögensplanungsleistungen

• Beratung der Geschäftsleitung und internen Stakeholder bei Projekten und Initiativen

• Überwachung der rechtlichen und regulatorischen Entwicklungen in der Schweiz und Bewertung potenzieller Risiken im Zusammenhang mit der grenzüberschreitenden Erbringung von Dienstleistungen (einschließlich zivilrechtlicher und regulatorischer Risiken)

• Unterstützung von Rechtskollegen, die an internen Ausschüssen teilnehmen, durch die Bereitstellung von Vermögensplanungsexpertise

• Tragen Sie zu strategischen Projekten bei und bieten Sie Ad-hoc-rechtliche Unterstützung, indem Sie effiziente, kundenorientierte Lösungen im Zusammenhang mit FinSA und MiFID anbieten

IHR PROFIL

• Connaissance approfondie du droit bancaire et du droit des contrats suisses ainsi que du paysage réglementaire suisse

jobs.title: Data Platform Responsible 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As a Data Platform Responsible (PR) you are responsible for the end-to-end technical leadership and lifecycle management of a global data platform (datalake house) ensuring alignment with business needs, architecture standards, and operational resilience. Working closely with Product Owners, Platform Owner, System Architects, and IT Service Owners, the Platform Responsible supports technical decision-making, oversees solution design and drives technical decision-making, responsible for successful development execution, and ensures production readiness and release planning within defined frameworks. The role combines hands-on technical oversight with supplier management, risk assessment, quality assurance, and deep involvement in agile delivery and incident support.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• You are key technical stakeholder in the technical design of a Global Platform based on a modern infrastructure

• You are part of the agile setup and support development team

• Lead the technical design, development, and operational performance of the platform, ensuring full lifecycle management and compliance with corporate standards

• Contribute to platforms technical roadmap, including technology changes, modernisation, and decommissioning, in alignment with business and architectural strategies

• Own and contribute to key deliverables including Solution Design, Security Concept, and Interface Agreements; ensure adherence to architecture standards in collaboration with the System Architect

• Plan and coordinate application releases in line with Change- and Release Management processes, jointly deciding on production go-live with the Product Owner, Platform Owner and ITSO

• Supervise platform infrastructure and data development activities, promote “shift-left” practices (automation, unit testing, CI/CD), and ensure robust implementation of functional and non-functional requirements

• Provide 3rd level support, serve as master data custodian in JBAR, and lead supplier management for third-party applications, including performance and delivery oversight

• Estimate effort for changes, advise on technical risks and mitigation, support budgeting, and ensure technical requirements are properly validated and tested prior to release

• You feel responsible for the global data platform which serves global data for different analytics use cases and ensure a running and stable environment

• Support the System Architect in the raising and maintenance of technical debts

• Support Business Responsible and IT Product Owner in shaping platform service and its execution

• Collaboration with support teams in Asia to ensure enhanced support hours

YOUR PROFILE

• At least 8 years of experience in Data Platforms / Data Lakes / Data Lake houses (Kubernetes, Kafka, Distributed Storage like S3/HDFS) – preferably On prem.

• Several years of work experience in a similar capacity in the financial industry

• Experience in leading technical direction of data platforms, keeping up to date with the modern possibilities of tooling, formats, concepts.

• Experience in managing the full platform lifecycle, from concept and design through development, testing, deployment, operation, and eventual retirement, including responsibility for master data, incident support, and release coordination

• VM setup and scaling (pods), K8S scaling, managing Docker with Harbor, pushing Images through CI/CD together with development team

• Higher Education in Computer Science (University, University of Applied Sciences or equivalent diploma)

• Very strong communication and planning / coordination skills

• Willingness to bring in new ideas and initiate changes and sees themselves as proactive, reliable and solution driven

• Good English language skills (written and verbal), German a plus

• Strong team player

• Customer oriented with focus to support an organisation in providing solutions

• Very good understanding of data technology and its operational management

• Very high level on self-motivation to drive initiatives and initiating changes

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements. Als Data Platform Responsible (PR) sind Sie für die durchgängige technische Führung und das Lifecycle-Management einer globalen Datenplattform (Datalake House) verantwortlich, die die Ausrichtung auf Geschäftsanforderungen, Architekturstandards und operative Belastbarkeit gewährleistet. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Product Ownern, Platform Owner, Systemarchitekten und IT-Service-Eigentümern unterstützt der Platform Responsible die technische Entscheidungsfindung, überwacht das Lösungsdesign und treibt die technische Entscheidungsfindung voran, ist für die erfolgreiche Ausführung der Entwicklung verantwortlich und stellt die Produktionsbereitschaft und Release-Planung innerhalb definierter Frameworks sicher. Die Rolle kombiniert praktische technische Aufsicht mit Lieferantenmanagement, Risikobeurteilung, Qualitätssicherung und einer umfassenden Beteiligung an agiler Liefer- und Incident-Unterstützung. IHRE HINWEISE
• Sie sind wichtiger technischer Stakeholder beim technischen Design einer globalen Plattform auf Basis einer modernen Infrastruktur
• Sie sind Teil des agilen Setup- und Support-Entwicklungsteams
• Führen Sie das technische Design, die Entwicklung und die operative Leistung der Plattform, um ein vollständiges Lebenszyklusmanagement und die Einhaltung der Unternehmensstandards zu gewährleisten
• Beitrag zur technischen Roadmap der Plattformen, einschließlich Technologieänderungen, Modernisierung und Stilllegung in Übereinstimmung mit Geschäfts- und Architekturstrategien
• Eigenverantwortung und Beitrag zu wichtigen Leistungen, einschließlich Solution Design, Security Concept und Interface Agreements; Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Architekturstandards in Zusammenarbeit mit dem System Architect
• Planen und koordinieren Sie Anwendungs-Releases im Einklang mit Change- und Release-Management-Prozessen und entscheiden gemeinsam mit Product Owner, Platform Owner und ITSO über den Produktions-Go-Live
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Plattforminfrastruktur und Datenentwicklungsaktivitäten, fördern Sie "Shift-left" -Praktiken (Automatisierung, Unit Testing, CI / CD) und gewährleisten Sie eine robuste Implementierung funktionaler und nicht funktionaler Anforderungen
• Bereitstellung von 3rd-Level-Support, als Master Data Custodian in JBAR und Leitung des Lieferantenmanagements für Anwendungen von Drittanbietern, einschließlich Leistungs- und Lieferaufsicht
• Schätzen Sie den Aufwand für Änderungen, beraten Sie zu technischen Risiken und Minderung, unterstützen Sie die Budgetierung und stellen Sie sicher, dass die technischen Anforderungen vor der Veröffentlichung ordnungsgemäß validiert und getestet werden
• Sie fühlen sich verantwortlich für die globale Datenplattform, die globale Daten für verschiedene Analyse-Anwendungsfälle bereitstellt und eine laufende und stabile Umgebung gewährleistet.
• Unterstützen Sie den Systemarchitekten bei der Erhebung und Aufrechterhaltung technischer Schulden
• Unterstützen Sie Business Responsible und IT Product Owner bei der Gestaltung des Plattformdienstes und seiner Ausführung
• Zusammenarbeit mit Supportteams in Asien, um verbesserte Supportzeiten zu gewährleisten IHR PROFIL
• Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung in Data Platforms / Data Lakes / Data Lake Häusern (Kubernetes, Kafka, Distributed Storage wie S3/HDFS) – vorzugsweise On prem.
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in ähnlicher Funktion in der Finanzbranche
• Erfahrung in der führenden technischen Leitung von Datenplattformen, auf dem neuesten Stand der modernen Möglichkeiten der Werkzeuge, Formate, Konzepte.
• Erfahrung in der Verwaltung des gesamten Plattformlebenszyklus, von Konzept und Design über Entwicklung, Test, Bereitstellung, Betrieb und eventuellen Ruhestand, einschließlich der Verantwortung für Stammdaten, Incident-Support und Release-Koordination
• VM-Einrichtung und -Skalierung (Pods), K8S-Skalierung, Verwaltung von Docker mit Harbor, Pushing von Images durch CI/CD zusammen mit dem Entwicklungsteam
• Hochschulbildung in Informatik (Universität, Fachhochschule oder gleichwertiges Diplom)
• Sehr starke Kommunikations- und Planungs-/Koordinationsfähigkeiten
• Bereitschaft, neue Ideen einzubringen und Veränderungen anzustoßen und versteht sich als proaktiv, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert
• Gute Englischkenntnisse (schriftlich und mündlich), Deutsch ein Plus
• Starker Teamplayer
• Kundenorientiert mit Fokus auf Unterstützung einer Organisation bei der Bereitstellung von Lösungen
• Sehr gutes Verständnis der Datentechnologie und ihrer Betriebsführung
• Sehr hohes Niveau an Selbstmotivation, um Initiativen voranzutreiben und Veränderungen einzuleiten Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständige Bewerbung über unser Online-Bewerbungstool. jobs.title: Wealth Planner Key Clients & Family Office Services, Zürich, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We seek a highly skilled Wealth Planner to join Julius Baer (JB) Wealth Planning based in Zurich, Switzerland. Wealth Planning, a unit of Global Products & Solutions (GPS), is a core offering of the JB Group and provides specialist wealth planning to support Relationship Managers (RMs) in acquiring, maintaining, and retaining private client relationships. Your main responsibility will be to provide wealth planning guidance and introduce wealth planning products and solutions to meet the needs of our private clients.

The successful candidate will stand out for their ability to deliver excellence in two key areas. The first is as subject matter expert in Latin American markets where agility in wealth planning topics including philanthropy, relocation, succession planning, taxation and wealth structuring will be needed. (Proven experience in Mexico, but not only, will be a distinct advantage.) The second is in relation to our key client and ultra-high net worth segment, which is more universal and less country-specific in nature. Here, experience in family governance topics and harmonizing these with the wealth structures needed will distinguish the ideal profile.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Provide strategic wealth planning guidance to RMs and their clients, actively coordinating the wealth planning process by leveraging internal and external experts as needed

• Implement suitable solutions, such as private insurance, private trusts, private foundations or private companies in collaboration with internal and external providers

• Serve as a subject matter specialist in client-facing interactions, following the JB Advisory Process which includes fact-finding, analysis, discussion of principles, evaluation of concepts, proposal of solutions/services, implementation and follow-up

• Support the Wealth Planning Key Clients & Family Office Services (FOS) Team in delivering services to UHNW prospects and clients, by applying WP’s offering, with focus on Family Roadmap, Family Purpose (including Philanthropy Advisory) and Family Governance, amongst others

• Stay up to date with industry, legal, regulatory and taxation changes, and inform clients and internal stakeholders accordingly

Cerchiamo un altamente qualificato Wealth Planner per aderire Julius Baer (JB) Wealth Planning con sede a Zurigo, Svizzera. Wealth Planning, un'unità di Global Products & Solutions (GPS), è un'offerta di base del Gruppo JB e fornisce una pianificazione di ricchezza specializzata per supportare Relationship Managers (RM) nell'acquisizione, mantenimento e mantenimento di relazioni con i clienti privati. La vostra responsabilità principale sarà quella di fornire una guida alla pianificazione della ricchezza e introdurre prodotti e soluzioni per la pianificazione della ricchezza per soddisfare le esigenze dei nostri clienti privati.

Il primo è come esperto di materia tematica nei mercati latinoamericani dove sarà necessaria l'agilità nei temi della pianificazione della ricchezza, tra cui filantropia, trasferimento, pianificazione della successione, tassazione e strutturazione della ricchezza. Il tuo progetto
Qualifiche professionali & Istruzione

• Minimo di 10 anni di esperienza professionale nei settori dei servizi finanziari rilevanti o simili pratiche dei clienti privati (ad esempio banca privata, pratica legale, consulente fiscale, società fiduciaria)

• Laurea in Giurisprudenza (una qualifica di paese latinoamericano), master in imposta o un campo correlato è un must. Ulteriori qualifiche sulla governance familiare e l'esperienza nel servire i clienti privati sarebbero di vantaggio. Ulteriori corsi legati all'area di competenza, come l'accreditamento STEP, sono preferiti

Esperienza e competenze

• L'approccio client-centrico. Passione per la pianificazione della ricchezza consigli per privati HNW e UHNW individui

• Impegnare la personalità con la capacità di lavorare in modo efficace con i clienti ad alto valore di rete, garantendo le loro esigenze e obiettivi sono soddisfatti

• Il viaggio per vincere, mantenere e mantenere i clienti sarà richiesto su base ad hoc, tra cui in America Latina

• Forte capacità organizzative e attenzione ai dettagli. Forte etica del lavoro, essere un giocatore di squadra e collaborare con diversi stakeholder come parte di un team internazionale di professionisti della pianificazione della ricchezza

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborare efficacemente all'interno di un team nazionale e globale, sia di persona che in formati virtuali

• Self-starter con una mentalità orientata alla soluzione

• Altoparlante nativo spagnolo. Fluente in inglese. Ulteriori competenze linguistiche europee, tra cui il tedesco sono un vantaggio distinto

Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Wir suchen einen hochqualifizierten Wealth Planer für Julius Bär (JB) Wealth Planning mit Sitz in Zürich, Schweiz. Wealth Planning, eine Einheit von Global Products & Solutions (GPS), ist ein Kernangebot der JB Group und bietet spezialisierte Vermögensplanung zur Unterstützung von Relationship Managern (RMs) bei der Akquisition, Pflege und Pflege privater Kundenbeziehungen. Ihre Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, eine Orientierung für die Vermögensplanung zu bieten und Produkte und Lösungen für die Vermögensplanung einzuführen, die den Bedürfnissen unserer Privatkunden entsprechen.

Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird sich durch seine Fähigkeit auszeichnen, Exzellenz in zwei Schlüsselbereichen zu liefern. Die erste ist als Fachexperte in lateinamerikanischen Märkten, in denen Agilität in Vermögensplanungsthemen wie Philanthropie, Umsiedlung, Nachfolgeplanung, Besteuerung und Vermögensstrukturierung erforderlich sind. (Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Mexiko, aber nicht nur, wird ein deutlicher Vorteil sein.) Die zweite bezieht sich auf unser Hauptkunden- und Ultra-High-Net-Value-Segment, das universeller und weniger länderspezifisch ist. Hier wird durch Erfahrung in Family Governance-Themen und deren Harmonisierung mit den benötigten Vermögensstrukturen das ideale Profil unterschieden.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG

• Strategische Wealth-Planing-Beratung für RMs und ihre Kunden, indem sie den Wealth-Planungsprozess aktiv koordinieren, indem sie bei Bedarf interne und externe Experten einsetzen

• Implementieren Sie geeignete Lösungen wie private Versicherungen, private Trusts, private Stiftungen oder private Unternehmen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Anbietern

• Als Fachspezialist für Kundeninteraktionen dienen, nach dem JB-Beratungsprozess, der Faktenfindung, Analyse, Diskussion von Prinzipien, Bewertung von Konzepten, Vorschlag von Lösungen / Dienstleistungen, Implementierung und Follow-up umfasst

• Unterstützen Sie das Wealth Planning Key Clients & Family Office Services (FOS) Team bei der Bereitstellung von Dienstleistungen für UHNW-Perspektiven und -Kunden, indem Sie das Angebot von WP anwenden, unter anderem mit Schwerpunkt auf Family Roadmap, Family Purpose (einschließlich Philanthropy Advisory) und Family Governance.

• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über Branchen-, Rechts-, Regulierungs- und Steueränderungen und informieren Sie Kunden und interne Stakeholder entsprechend

• Unterstützung von RMs und anderen Stakeholdern durch Schulungen, Wissenstransfer und Unterstützung zu Themen der Vermögensplanung und Dienstleistungen/Produkten

IHR PROFIL
Berufsqualifikationen & Ausbildung

• Mindestens 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung in relevanten Finanzdienstleistungssektoren oder vergleichbaren Privatkundenpraktiken (z. B. Privatbank, Rechtspraxis, Steuerberater, Treuhandgesellschaft)

• Universitätsabschluss in Rechtswissenschaften (eine lateinamerikanische Länderqualifikation), Master in Steuer oder einem verwandten Bereich ist ein Muss. Zusätzliche Qualifikationen in Bezug auf Family Governance und Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Privatkunden wären von Vorteil. Zusätzliche Kurse, die mit dem Fachgebiet verbunden sind, wie die STEP-Akkreditierung, werden bevorzugt

Erfahrung & Kompetenzen

• Kundenzentrierter Ansatz. Leidenschaft für Wealth Planning Beratung für private HNW und UHNW Einzelpersonen

• Persönlichkeit mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit vermögenden Kunden zu arbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass ihre Bedürfnisse und Ziele erfüllt werden

• Reisen, um Kunden zu gewinnen, zu pflegen und zu behalten, sind auf Ad-hoc-Basis erforderlich, auch nach Lateinamerika

• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Liebe zum Detail. Starke Arbeitsmoral, Teamplayer zu sein und mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern als Teil eines internationalen Teams von Vermögensplanungsexperten zusammenzuarbeiten

• Hervorragende schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Fähigkeit, unabhängig und effektiv in einem nationalen und globalen Team zu arbeiten, sowohl persönlich als auch in virtuellen Formaten

• Selbststarter mit lösungsorientiertem Mindset

• Spanischer Muttersprachler. fließend in Englisch. Zusätzliche europäische Sprachkenntnisse, darunter Deutsch, sind ein deutlicher Vorteil

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

Nous recherchons un planificateur de patrimoine hautement qualifié pour rejoindre Julius Baer (JB) Wealth Planning basé à Zurich, Suisse. Wealth Planning, une unité de Global Products & Solutions (GPS), est une offre de base du Groupe JB et fournit une planification de patrimoine spécialisée pour soutenir les gestionnaires de relations (RM) dans l'acquisition, le maintien et le maintien de relations client privées. Votre responsabilité principale sera de fournir des conseils en planification de patrimoine et d'introduire des produits et des solutions de planification de patrimoine pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients privés.

La candidate reçue se démarquera pour sa capacité à atteindre l'excellence dans deux domaines clés. Le premier est en tant qu'expert sur les marchés latino-américains où l'agilité dans les sujets de planification de la richesse, y compris la philanthropie, la délocalisation, la planification de la succession, la fiscalité et la structuration de la richesse, sera nécessaire. (L'expérience éprouvée au Mexique, mais pas seulement, sera un avantage distinct.) La deuxième concerne notre principal client et notre segment de valeur nette ultra-haute, qui est plus universel et de nature moins spécifique au pays. Ici, l'expérience en matière de gouvernance familiale et l'harmonisation avec les structures de richesse nécessaires distingueront le profil idéal.

Votre défi

• Fournir des conseils stratégiques en matière de planification de la richesse aux GR et à leurs clients, en coordonnant activement le processus de planification de la richesse en faisant appel à des experts internes et externes au besoin.

• Mettre en œuvre des solutions appropriées, telles que les assurances privées, les fiducies privées, les fondations privées ou les entreprises privées en collaboration avec des fournisseurs internes et externes

• Servir de spécialiste des interactions avec les clients, à la suite du processus consultatif du BJ, qui comprend l'établissement des faits, l'analyse, la discussion des principes, l'évaluation des concepts, la proposition de solutions/services, la mise en oeuvre et le suivi

• Soutenir l'équipe de planification de patrimoine des clients clés et des services de bureau à la famille (SFO) dans la prestation de services aux perspectives et aux clients de l'UHNW, en appliquant l'offre du WP, en mettant l'accent sur la feuille de route familiale, l'objectif familial (y compris l'avis de philanthropie) et la gouvernance familiale, entre autres

• Restez à jour avec l'industrie, les changements juridiques, réglementaires et fiscaux et informez les clients et les intervenants internes en conséquence

• Soutenir les RM et les autres parties prenantes en offrant formation, transfert de connaissances et assistance sur des sujets et des services/produits de planification du patrimoine

VOTRE PROFIL
Qualifications professionnelles et formation

• Minimum de 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les secteurs pertinents des services financiers ou des pratiques comparables des clients privés (p. ex. banque privée, pratique juridique, conseiller fiscal, société fiduciaire)

• Diplôme universitaire en droit (un diplôme de pays d'Amérique latine), maîtrise en fiscalité ou un domaine connexe est un must. Des qualifications supplémentaires sur la gouvernance familiale et l'expérience du service à la clientèle privée seraient avantageuses. D'autres cours liés au domaine d'expertise, comme l'accréditation STEP, sont préférés.

Expérience et compétences

• Approche axée sur le client. Passion pour les conseils de planification de patrimoine pour les particuliers HNW et UHNW

• Mobiliser la personnalité avec la capacité de travailler efficacement avec des clients de grande valeur, en veillant à ce que leurs besoins et objectifs soient atteints

• Les voyages pour gagner, maintenir et retenir les clients seront nécessaires au cas par cas, y compris en Amérique latine.

• Fortes compétences organisationnelles et attention aux détails. Forte éthique du travail, être un acteur d'équipe et collaborer avec différentes parties prenantes dans le cadre d'une équipe internationale de professionnels de la planification de patrimoine

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et de collaborer efficacement au sein d'une équipe nationale et mondiale, tant en personne qu'en format virtuel

• Auto-démarrage avec un état d'esprit orienté solution

• Locuteur natif espagnol. En anglais. D'autres compétences linguistiques européennes, dont l'allemand, constituent un avantage distinct.

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète par l'intermédiaire de notre outil d'application en ligne. D'autres possibilités d'emploi intéressantes se trouvent sur notre site de carrière.
