jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Valuation Control is part of Product Control which is focused on the trading and treasury activities of Julius Baer. Independent compilations of profit and loss figures allow for a transparent and save business environment ensuring accurate financial reporting. Front to back reconciliations of positions, cash accounts and profit and loss statements ensure data integrity across systems.

Valuation Control collaborates with Finance, Risk, and Front Office functions to support transparent financial reporting and meets regulatory and audit obligations. Operating independently, Valuation Control provides a crucial second-line-of-defence oversight to safeguard the reliability of the Bank’s financial statements. Its function ensures the accuracy and integrity of fair value measurements for financial instruments, primarily under IFRS 13 requirements. It performs independent price verification, identifying and resolving discrepancies. The team oversees the classification of instruments within the fair value hierarchy (Levels 1–3) and monitors the use of pricing models, especially for illiquid or complex products.

Moreover, Valuation Control is responsible for the calculation of various additional valuation adjustments under Prudent Valuation regulations. As such the team ensures a robust valuation governance framework to enhance the credibility and reliability of financial reporting by reflecting realistic market conditions, thereby strengthening investor confidence, supporting regulatory compliance, and mitigating the risk of future losses or restatements.

The successful candidate will be a senior valuation control professional with strong technical expertise across financial instruments, valuation methodologies, valuation uncertainty and regulatory expectations. The role requires strong leadership, provides independent challenge to Front valuations and partners across Finance, Product Control, Market Risk, Model Validation, Front Office, Regulatory Reporting and Technology. The role will provide senior ownership of valuation governance, independent price verification, valuation adjustments, fair value control, prudent valuation adjustments and related control processes.

YOUR CHALLENGE
The role of the Head of Valuation Control includes:

• Lead Valuation Control within Product Control, overseeing valuation governance, independent price verification (IPV), valuation adjustments, and fair value controls

• Defining and implementing the target operating model for prudent valuation adjustments (PVA), including methodology, governance, controls, data requirements, systems, reporting and senior management oversight

• Lead development and governance of additional valuation adjustments (AVA), covering market price uncertainty, close-out costs, funding & investing costs, unearned credit spreads, concentrated positions, future administrative costs and early termination

• Enhancement of the Bank’s valuation control framework

• Assessing new products in the new product approval process

• Develop a comprehensive fair value levelling framework

• Provide senior-level oversight of valuations for trading and treasury products, including derivatives, fixed income, rates, credit, FX, and structured instruments

• Ensure robust independent price verification through price testing, adjustments, valuation challenge, and escalation

• Deliver independent challenge to Front Office pricing, models, assumptions, and methodologies

• Establish strong governance via methodology reviews, control standards, documentation, approvals, and senior reporting

• Present valuation control insights to senior management, risk committees, auditors, and regulators

• Ensure valuation processes are underpinned by reliable data, systems, controls, and auditability

• Support internal/external audits and regulatory reviews on fair value and valuation control matters

• Drive automation, process improvements, and control enhancements for greater efficiency and scalability

• Lead and develop a high-performing team of valuation control specialists, fostering technical excellence and career growth

YOUR PROFILE

• Degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a quantitative field

• Extensive experience in Risk or Finance (10+ years) of which at least 5-year experience in Valuation Control, Market Risk, or related banking control functions

• Proven leadership track record within valuation or product control environments

• Leading the Bank’s PVA agenda within Product Control / Valuation Control

• Deep technical expertise in fair value governance, IPV, valuation reserves, and PVA, including market price uncertainty, model risk, and close-out costs

• Strong knowledge of financial instruments across rates, credit, FX, derivatives, fixed income, and structured products

• Experienced in challenging valuation models, assumptions, inputs, and outputs in collaboration with Front Office and Model Validation

• Thorough understanding of regulatory requirements (IFRS 13, Basel, EBA) relating to fair value and valuation control

• Skilled in designing and enhancing valuation control frameworks, governance, reporting, and system-driven controls

• Strong data and technology awareness, with ability to drive automation and control improvements

• Programming skills (Python, SQL or alike) desirabl

• Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills—effective at engaging senior leaders, auditors, and regulators

• Capable of leading teams and delivering results in complex, highly regulated environments

• Professional qualification (e.g., CFA, FRM, ACA/ACCA, CPA) desirable

• Business fluency in English required, German an advantage

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza. Valuation Control fa parte del Product Control che si concentra sulle attività di trading e di tesoreria di Julius Baer. Le compilazioni indipendenti di dati di profitto e di perdita permettono un ambiente di business trasparente e sicuro, assicurando un report finanziario accurato. Le conciliazioni di posizioni, conti in contanti e dichiarazioni di profitto e di perdita assicurano l'integrità dei dati attraverso i sistemi. Valuation Control collabora con le funzioni Finance, Risk e Front Office per supportare la reportistica finanziaria trasparente e soddisfare gli obblighi normativi e di audit. Operando in modo indipendente, Valuation Control fornisce una fondamentale supervisione di seconda linea di difesa per salvaguardare l’affidabilità del bilancio della Banca. La sua funzione garantisce l'accuratezza e l'integrità delle misure di fair value per gli strumenti finanziari, principalmente sotto i requisiti IFRS 13. Esegue la verifica dei prezzi indipendente, l'identificazione e la risoluzione delle discrepanze. Il team supervisiona la classificazione degli strumenti all'interno della gerarchia del fair value (Levels 1–3) e monitora l'utilizzo dei modelli di prezzi, soprattutto per prodotti illiquidi o complessi. Inoltre, Valuation Control è responsabile per il calcolo di varie regolazioni di valutazione aggiuntive in base alle normative di Prudent Valuation. In quanto tale il team assicura un quadro di governance di valutazione robusto per migliorare la credibilità e l'affidabilità del reporting finanziario riflettendo le condizioni di mercato realistiche, rafforzando così la fiducia degli investitori, sostenendo la conformità normativa, e mitigando il rischio di future perdite o risarcimenti. Il candidato di successo sarà un professionista di controllo di valutazione senior con una forte competenza tecnica tra strumenti finanziari, metodologie di valutazione, incertezza di valutazione e aspettative di regolamentazione. Il ruolo richiede una forte leadership, fornisce una sfida indipendente alle valutazioni frontali e ai partner tra Finanza, Controllo prodotti, Rischio di mercato, Convalida dei modelli, Front Office, Resoconto Regolamentare e Tecnologia. Il ruolo fornirà la proprietà senior della governance della valutazione, la verifica dei prezzi indipendente, le regolazioni di valutazione, il controllo del fair value, le regolazioni di valutazione prudente e i relativi processi di controllo. LA TUA SICUREZZA Il ruolo del capo del controllo della valutazione comprende:
• Lead Valuation Control all'interno del Product Control, supervisionando la governance della valutazione, la verifica dei prezzi indipendente (IPV), le regolazioni di valutazione e i controlli del fair value
• Definire e implementare il modello operativo target per gli aggiustamenti di valutazione prudente (PVA), tra cui metodologia, governance, controlli, requisiti di dati, sistemi, reporting e supervisione senior management
• Sviluppo del piombo e governance di ulteriori aggiustamenti di valutazione (AVA), che coprono l'incertezza dei prezzi di mercato, i costi di chiusura, i costi di finanziamento e di investimento, gli spread di credito non recuperati, le posizioni concentrate, i costi amministrativi futuri e la risoluzione anticipata
• Miglioramento del quadro di controllo della valutazione della Banca
• Valutare nuovi prodotti nel nuovo processo di approvazione del prodotto
• Sviluppare un quadro globale di livellamento del fair value
• Fornire la supervisione di livello superiore delle valutazioni per i prodotti di trading e di tesoreria, compresi derivati, reddito fisso, tassi, credito, FX e strumenti strutturati
• Assicurare una robusta verifica dei prezzi indipendente tramite test dei prezzi, regolazioni, sfida di valutazione e escalation
• Fornire una sfida indipendente ai prezzi, modelli, ipotesi e metodologie di Front Office
• Stabilire una forte governance attraverso valutazioni metodologiche, standard di controllo, documentazione, approvazioni e report senior
• Intuizioni di controllo della valutazione attuali per la gestione senior, comitati di rischio, revisori e regolatori
• Assicurarsi che i processi di valutazione siano sostenuti da dati affidabili, sistemi, controlli e verificabilità
• Sostenere gli audit interni/esterni e le revisioni regolamentari su questioni di fair value e controllo della valutazione
• Automazione dell'azionamento, miglioramenti del processo e miglioramenti di controllo per una maggiore efficienza e scalabilità
• Guidare e sviluppare un team di esperti specialisti del controllo della valutazione, promuovendo l'eccellenza tecnica e la crescita della carriera Il tuo progetto
• Laurea in finanza, economia, matematica, ingegneria o un campo quantitativo
• Ampia esperienza in Rischio o Finanza (10+ anni) di cui almeno 5 anni di esperienza in Valuation Control, Market Risk, o relative funzioni di controllo bancario
• Provato record di leadership negli ambienti di valutazione o controllo dei prodotti
• Conducendo l’agenda PVA della Banca all’interno del Product Control / Valuation Control
• Profonda competenza tecnica nella governance del fair value, IPV, riserve di valutazione e PVA, tra cui incertezza dei prezzi di mercato, rischio di modello e costi di chiusura
• Forte conoscenza degli strumenti finanziari tra tassi, credito, FX, derivati, reddito fisso e prodotti strutturati
• Esperienza in modelli di valutazione impegnativi, assunzioni, ingressi e uscite in collaborazione con Front Office e Model Validation
• Competente comprensione dei requisiti normativi (IFRS 13, Basilea, EBA) relativi al controllo equo del valore e della valutazione
• Abilitato nella progettazione e valorizzazione dei quadri di controllo della valutazione, governance, reporting e controlli basati su sistemi
• Forte consapevolezza dei dati e della tecnologia, con la capacità di guidare i miglioramenti dell'automazione e del controllo
• Capacità di programmazione (Python, SQL o simili) desirabl
• Eccellente analitica, comunicazione e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder—efficace nell'impegnare leader senior, revisori e regolatori
• Capacità di team leader e risultati in ambienti complessi e altamente regolamentati
• qualificazione professionale (ad esempio, CFA, FRM, ACA/ACCA, CPA) auspicabile

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements. Valuation Control ist Teil der Produktkontrolle, die sich auf die Handels- und Treasury-Aktivitäten von Julius Bär konzentriert. Unabhängige Zusammenstellungen von Gewinn- und Verlustzahlen ermöglichen ein transparentes und sicheres Geschäftsumfeld, das eine genaue Finanzberichterstattung gewährleistet. Front-to-back-Abgleiche von Positionen, Geldkonten und Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen gewährleisten die Datenintegrität über alle Systeme hinweg. Valuation Control arbeitet mit Finanz-, Risiko- und Front Office-Funktionen zusammen, um eine transparente Finanzberichterstattung zu unterstützen und die regulatorischen und Prüfungspflichten zu erfüllen. Unabhängig tätig, bietet Valuation Control eine entscheidende Second-Line-of-Defence-Aufsicht, um die Zuverlässigkeit der Finanzausweise der Bank zu gewährleisten. Seine Funktion gewährleistet die Genauigkeit und Integrität der Bemessung des beizulegenden Zeitwerts von Finanzinstrumenten, vor allem nach den IFRS 13-Anforderungen. Es führt eine unabhängige Preisüberprüfung durch, identifiziert und löst Diskrepanzen. Das Team überwacht die Klassifizierung von Instrumenten innerhalb der Fair-Value-Hierarchie (Stufen 1–3) und überwacht die Verwendung von Preismodellen, insbesondere für illiquide oder komplexe Produkte. Darüber hinaus ist Valuation Control für die Berechnung verschiedener zusätzlicher Bewertungsanpassungen gemäß den Prudent Valuation-Vorschriften verantwortlich. Als solches stellt das Team einen robusten Bewertungs-Governance-Rahmen sicher, um die Glaubwürdigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit der Finanzberichterstattung zu verbessern, indem es realistische Marktbedingungen widerspiegelt, wodurch das Vertrauen der Anleger gestärkt, die Einhaltung der Vorschriften unterstützt und das Risiko zukünftiger Verluste oder Anpassungen verringert wird. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird ein leitender Experte für Bewertungskontrolle mit starkem technischem Fachwissen über Finanzinstrumente, Bewertungsmethoden, Bewertungsunsicherheit und regulatorische Erwartungen sein. Die Rolle erfordert eine starke Führung, stellt Front-Bewertungen und Partnern in den Bereichen Finanzen, Produktkontrolle, Marktrisiko, Modellvalidierung, Front Office, regulatorische Berichterstattung und Technologie eine unabhängige Herausforderung dar. Durch die Rolle wird eine Führungsrolle in Bezug auf die Governance von Bewertungen, eine unabhängige Preisüberprüfung, Bewertungsanpassungen, die Kontrolle des beizulegenden Zeitwerts, vorsichtige Bewertungsanpassungen und damit verbundene Kontrollprozesse übernommen. IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG Die Rolle des Head of Valuation Control umfasst:
• Lead Valuation Control innerhalb der Produktkontrolle, Überwachung der Bewertungs-Governance, unabhängiger Preisüberprüfung (IPV), Bewertungsanpassungen und Fair-Value-Kontrollen
• Festlegung und Umsetzung des Zielbetriebsmodells für vorsichtige Bewertungsanpassungen (PVA), einschließlich Methodik, Governance, Kontrollen, Datenanforderungen, Systeme, Berichterstattung und Aufsicht der Geschäftsleitung
• Leitende Entwicklung und Steuerung zusätzlicher Bewertungsanpassungen (AVA), einschließlich Marktpreisunsicherheit, Close-Out-Kosten, Finanzierungs- und Investitionskosten, unverdiente Kreditspreads, konzentrierte Positionen, zukünftige Verwaltungskosten und vorzeitige Kündigung
• Verbesserung des Bewertungskontrollrahmens der Bank
• Bewertung neuer Produkte im neuen Produktgenehmigungsprozess
• Entwicklung eines umfassenden Rahmens für die Angleichung des beizulegenden Zeitwerts
• Bereitstellung einer Aufsicht auf höherer Ebene über Bewertungen für Handels- und Treasury-Produkte, einschließlich Derivate, Fixed Income, Rates, Credit, FX und strukturierte Instrumente
• Gewährleistung einer robusten unabhängigen Preisüberprüfung durch Preisprüfung, Anpassungen, Bewertungsherausforderung und Eskalation

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Le contrôle de l'évaluation fait partie du contrôle des produits qui est axé sur les activités de négociation et de trésorerie de Julius Baer. Des compilations indépendantes de chiffres de profits et pertes permettent de créer un environnement commercial transparent et économisant garantissant une information financière précise. Les rapprochements des positions, des comptes de caisse et des états des profits et pertes font en sorte que les données sont intégrées dans tous les systèmes. Le contrôle de l'évaluation collabore avec les fonctions Finances, Risques et Front Office pour appuyer la transparence des rapports financiers et respecter les obligations réglementaires et de vérification. Fonctionnant de façon indépendante, le Contrôle de l'évaluation assure une surveillance de deuxième ligne de défense essentielle pour préserver la fiabilité des états financiers de la Banque. Sa fonction garantit l'exactitude et l'intégrité des mesures de la juste valeur des instruments financiers, principalement selon les exigences d'IFRS 13. Il effectue une vérification indépendante des prix, identifie et résout les écarts. L'équipe supervise la classification des instruments dans la hiérarchie de la juste valeur (niveaux 1 à 3) et surveille l'utilisation des modèles de tarification, en particulier pour les produits non liquides ou complexes. De plus, le contrôle d'évaluation est responsable du calcul de divers rajustements d'évaluation supplémentaires en vertu des règlements sur l'évaluation prudente. À ce titre, l'équipe assure un cadre solide de gouvernance de l'évaluation pour accroître la crédibilité et la fiabilité de l'information financière en tenant compte des conditions réalistes du marché, renforçant ainsi la confiance des investisseurs, appuyant la conformité à la réglementation et atténuant le risque de pertes ou de reformulations futures. Le candidat retenu sera un professionnel principal du contrôle de l'évaluation ayant une solide expertise technique dans les instruments financiers, les méthodes d'évaluation, l'incertitude en matière d'évaluation et les attentes réglementaires. Ce rôle exige un leadership solide, constitue un défi indépendant pour les évaluateurs et les partenaires du secteur des finances, du contrôle des produits, du risque de marché, de la validation des modèles, de l'administration centrale, des rapports réglementaires et de la technologie. Ce rôle assurera la propriété principale de la gouvernance de l'évaluation, de la vérification indépendante des prix, des ajustements d'évaluation, du contrôle de la juste valeur, des ajustements d'évaluation prudents et des processus de contrôle connexes. Votre défi Le rôle du chef du contrôle de l'évaluation comprend :
• Contrôle de l'évaluation du plomb au sein du contrôle des produits, supervision de la gouvernance de l'évaluation, vérification indépendante des prix (VPI), ajustements d'évaluation et contrôles de la juste valeur
• Définition et mise en œuvre du modèle opérationnel cible pour les ajustements prudents en matière d'évaluation, y compris la méthodologie, la gouvernance, les contrôles, les exigences en matière de données, les systèmes, les rapports et la surveillance de la haute direction
• Diriger le développement et la gouvernance des ajustements d'évaluation supplémentaires (AVA), couvrant l'incertitude des prix du marché, les coûts de clôture, les coûts de financement et d'investissement, les écarts de crédit non gagnés, les positions concentrées, les coûts administratifs futurs et la résiliation anticipée
• Amélioration du cadre de contrôle de l'évaluation de la Banque
• Évaluation des nouveaux produits dans le nouveau processus d'approbation des produits
• Élaborer un cadre global de nivelage de la juste valeur
• Superviser de haut niveau les évaluations des produits de négociation et de trésorerie, y compris les produits dérivés, les produits à revenu fixe, les taux, le crédit, les instruments financiers et les instruments structurés
• Assurer une solide vérification indépendante des prix grâce à des tests de prix, des ajustements, un défi d'évaluation et une escalade
• Offrir un défi indépendant aux prix, aux modèles, aux hypothèses et aux méthodologies de Front Office
• Établir une gouvernance solide au moyen d'examens méthodologiques, de normes de contrôle, de documents, d'approbations et de rapports de haut niveau
• Présenter des renseignements sur le contrôle de l'évaluation à la haute direction, aux comités des risques, aux vérificateurs et aux organismes de réglementation
• Veiller à ce que les processus d'évaluation soient étayés par des données, des systèmes, des contrôles fiables et une vérification des comptes
• Appuyer les vérifications internes/externes et les examens réglementaires sur les questions de juste valeur et de contrôle de l'évaluation
• Automatisation de la conduite, améliorations des processus et améliorations de contrôle pour une plus grande efficacité et évolutivité
• Diriger et développer une équipe de spécialistes du contrôle de l'évaluation hautement performante, favorisant l'excellence technique et la croissance de carrière VOTRE PROFIL
• Diplôme en finance, économie, mathématiques, ingénierie ou domaine quantitatif
• Expérience approfondie en matière de risques ou de finances (10+ années) dont au moins 5 ans d'expérience en contrôle d'évaluation, risque de marché ou fonctions connexes de contrôle bancaire
• Expérience de leadership éprouvée dans les environnements d'évaluation ou de contrôle des produits
• Diriger le programme d'AVP de la Banque dans le contrôle des produits / contrôle de l'évaluation
• Expertise technique approfondie en matière de gouvernance de la juste valeur, de VPI, de réserves d'évaluation et de VAP, y compris l'incertitude des prix du marché, le risque de modèle et les coûts de clôture
• Forte connaissance des instruments financiers selon les taux, crédit, FX, produits dérivés, à revenu fixe et produits structurés
• Expérience des modèles d'évaluation, des hypothèses, des intrants et des produits difficiles, en collaboration avec Front Office et Model Validation
• Compréhension approfondie des exigences réglementaires (IFRS 13, Bâle, EBA) relatives à la juste valeur et au contrôle de l'évaluation
• Compétence pour concevoir et améliorer les cadres de contrôle de l'évaluation, la gouvernance, l'établissement de rapports et les contrôles axés sur le système
• Forte sensibilisation aux données et à la technologie, capable de conduire des améliorations en matière d'automatisation et de contrôle
• Compétences en programmation (Python, SQL ou similaire)
• Excellentes compétences en matière d'analyse, de communication et de gestion des intervenants – efficaces pour mobiliser les dirigeants, les vérificateurs et les organismes de réglementation
• Capable de diriger des équipes et de produire des résultats dans des environnements complexes et hautement réglementés
• Qualification professionnelle (p. ex. CFA, FRM, ACA/ACCA, CPA) souhaitable

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Join Our Team as Financial Accountant!
At Julius Baer, we are committed to excellence in wealth management. As a Financial Accountant, you will play a key role in managing accounting activities for both domestic and international entities, contributing directly to the integrity and efficiency of our financial operations.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Manage accounting and financial reporting for Bank Julius Baer and affiliated domestic and international entities

• Prepare monthly financial statements and business reports, including VAT returns in accordance with local regulations

• Ensure compliance with internal control systems (ICS)

• Contribute to the implementation of internal and external accounting regulations (including IFRS)

• Perform analytical reviews of balance sheet and income statement positions

• Prepare group (IFRS) and local statutory reporting

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Group Tax, Management Accounting, IT, and Payroll

• Support corporate activities such as entity setup, acquisitions, and liquidations

• Drive process improvements and support SAP-related initiatives (R/3, S/4HANA)

• Provide technical accounting support and troubleshooting across international teams

• Participate in system and process testing for accounting applications

YOUR PROFILE

• Swiss Certified Accountant or Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field

• Minimum 3 years of experience in financial accounting, ideally within banking or financial services

• Strong knowledge of IFRS

• Experience with SAP R/3 or S/4HANA is an advantage

• Proficient in MS Office

• Fluent in German and English (written and spoken)

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

• Collaborative team player with a proactive mindset

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Senior Front Arena Developer 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start for 12 months with possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

You will serve as a senior key person within our Front Arena team, responsible for implementing new structured products across the value chain from front office (Sales & Trading) to mid-office functions, ensuring accurate product representation and comprehensive lifecycle management.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Customise and extend the Front Arena platform to deliver new risk and valuation capabilities

• Design, develop, test, and deploy robust functionalities integrated across trading and back-office ecosystems

• Ensure end-to-end ownership of critical services, guaranteeing high availability and minimal production downtime

• Lead integration efforts between Front Arena and upstream/downstream systems (pricing, market data, risk engines)

• Perform root cause analysis and resolve complex production incidents efficiently

• Conduct thorough code reviews to uphold quality, security, and alignment with architectural standards

• Identify and implement system improvements to boost performance, scalability, and operational resilience

• Contribute to change and release management processes within an agile (SAFe) delivery framework

• Uphold ethical conduct, risk discipline, and compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements

YOUR PROFILE

• 10+ years of experience in Front Arena roles supporting trading, mid-office, valuation, and risk

• 8+ years of hands-on development with Front Arena AEL, ACM, and ADFL (all three required)

• Solid understanding of capital markets, particularly structured products and equity derivatives

• In-depth knowledge of financial product lifecycles (e.g., cash flows, corporate actions, expiries)

• Practical experience with Front Arena data models, workflows, and component interactions

• Experience working in agile teams using tools such as Git or Bitbucket

• Proven ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders

• Comfortable working under pressure, with strong organisational skills and ability to prioritise dynamically

• Willingness to work on public Swiss/Zurich holidays where foreign markets are open (e.g. Aug 1st)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an intermediate security data engineer with deep expertise in SIEM platforms, telemetry pipelines, and security operations tooling to join our global team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you combine strong security foundations with a data engineering mindset and are comfortable architecting and operating high-volume, enterprise-scale logging and analytics infrastructure in a regulated financial services environment. You are proactive, technically curious, and thrive in both independent and collaborative work settings.

Your primary responsibilities will involve designing, operating, and evolving our centralised logging and SIEM platforms, building and maintaining data pipelines for intelligent log routing and enrichment, driving SOAR automation, and contributing to the expansion of our security data ecosystem — including early-stage observability use cases. You will work closely with security operations, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure reliable, high-quality data flows from source to insight.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated team, architect, operate, and continuously improve the Bank’s centralised logging and SIEM platforms, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability for enterprise-grade data volumes

• Design, build, and maintain telemetry and data pipelines, enabling routing, enrichment, filtering, and multi-destination delivery of security and operational log data while maintaining cost-efficiency

• Drive the development and operationalisation of SOAR workflows to accelerate incident response, automate repetitive tasks, and improve security operations efficiency

• Develop and maintain service monitoring, detection content, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable security intelligence to stakeholders across the organisation

• Collaborate with security operations, IT infrastructure, and application teams to integrate new data sources, ensure data quality, and expand platform coverage — including early-stage contributions to observability use cases

• Maintain technical documentation including architecture descriptions, runbooks, data flow diagrams, and security parameterisations

• Coordinate the mitigation or resolution of security-relevant platform incidents with internal security stakeholders and external vendors

• Contribute to the development of architecture, standards, and best practices for the centralised logging and telemetry ecosystem

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support, including participation in an on-call rotation ​

YOUR PROFILE

• Comfortable working across multiple application, infrastructure, and business teams

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and approaches in a rapidly evolving landscape Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and results-driven with strong abstract and conceptual thinking skills

• Structured and goal-oriented approach to work, with the ability to independently assess, prioritise, and resolve complex tasks and requests

• Creative problem solver who challenges the status quo and proposes innovative solutions to existing issues

• Strong communicator who can translate technical complexity into clear guidance for platform users, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams

• Contribute to the development of architecture, concepts, and processes related to the Centralised Logging and Telemetry ecosystem

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience engineering and administering enterprise SIEM platforms, with experience developing detection content, correlation searches, dashboards, and CIM-normalised data models

• Strong experience designing and operating data pipelines and log routing infrastructure, ideally with Cribl Stream or comparable telemetry pipeline tools

• Practical scripting and automation skills with one or more of: Python, Bash/Shell, JavaScript

• Working experience with GIT, SQL, REST APIs, and regular expressions

• Solid understanding of SOAR platforms and security operations automation

• Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible is an advantage

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

Come candidato ideale, si combinano solide fondazioni di sicurezza con una mentalità di ingegneria dei dati e sono confortevoli architettura e funzionamento di alta volume, di imprese di registrazione e di infrastrutture di analisi in un ambiente di servizi finanziari regolamentati. Siete proattivi, tecnicamente curioso, e prosperare in ambienti di lavoro indipendenti e collaborativi. Responsabilità - Nell'ambito di un team dedicato, architetto, opera e migliora continuamente le piattaforme di registrazione centralizzata e SIEM, garantendo elevata disponibilità, performance e possibilità di carburazione per volumi di dati di livello aziendale - Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di telemetrie e condotte di dati, consentendo l'instradamento, l'arricchimento, il filtraggio e la distribuzione multidestinata di dati di sicurezza e log operativi mantenendo al contempo l'efficienza in termini di costi - Guidare lo sviluppo e l'operatività dei flussi di lavoro SOAR per accelerare la risposta agli incidenti, automatizzare le attività ripetitive e migliorare le operazioni di sicurezza efficienza - Sviluppare e mantenere il monitoraggio dei servizi, i contenuti di rilevamento, i report e i dashboard che forniscono informazioni di sicurezza utilizzabili agli stakeholder in tutta l'organizzazione - Collaborare con operazioni di sicurezza, infrastruttura IT e squadre di applicazioni per integrare nuove fonti di dati, garantire la qualità dei dati e ampliare la copertura della piattaforma. incidenti relativi alla sicurezza con le parti interessate della sicurezza interna e i fornitori esterni - Contribuire allo sviluppo di architettura, standard e migliori pratiche per l'ecosistema centralizzato di registrazione e telemetria - Fornire supporto ingegneristico di secondo e terzo livello, compresa la partecipazione a una rotazione di chiamata

We are seeking for a Senior Backend and Distributed Systems Engineer with extensive experience designing, building, and operating mission critical financial systems. Proven expertise in Java based backend architectures, distributed systems, and low latency, high availability services. Strong production mindset with end-to-end ownership across the full software lifecycle - from architecture and design through deployment, operations, and optimisation. YOUR PROFILE

• Architecture: Distributed systems, microservices, event‑driven design, low‑latency systems

• Databases & Messaging: JPA, JDBC, relational databases, JMS

• Operating Systems: Unix/Linux, bash scripting

• Security: OAuth2, API security, IAM concepts

• Strong code review practices and pride in code quality

• Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure

• Knowledge of microservices architecture and containerisation (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

• Previous experience in the financial industry is a plus

• Willingness to collaborate in a global team with members in Zurich and Singapore

• Strong ownership mindset with focus on business impact and reliability

• Analytical problem‑solver with a performance‑ and quality‑driven approach

• Team player with the ability to work in an agile environment

jobs.title: Application Integration Engineer 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Application Integration Engineer is responsible for the development, implementation, and operational support of FIX integration solutions and Order Trade Flows on the company’s Financial Messaging Infrastructure (BCOM). The role includes project participation, customer onboarding, monitoring and automation initiatives (meshIQ), and collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Role Responsibilities:

FIX & Messaging Integration

• Develop, configure, and maintain FIX integrations using ITIVI APPIA FIX, IBM MQ, and IBM ACE

• Configure FIX sessions, protocol parameters, and connectivity for clients, brokers, and exchanges

• Develop and maintain message flows within the existing middleware architecture

• Design, coordinate, and execute FIX certification tests for onboarding clients and exchanges

Engineering & Project Support

• Support project requests from the Markets environment (Front Office, Trading, Brokerage)

• Analyze new client-specific requirements and design corresponding integration solutions

• Perform detailed root‑cause analysis in the event of production incidents

• Provide technical expertise during the client onboarding process

Operations & On‑Call Duty

• Ensure stable and continuous operation of the FIX and MQ messaging landscape

• Contribute to monitoring and automation initiatives using meshIQ products

• Participate in the team’s rotating 24/7 on‑call service

YOUR PROFILE
Education:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (university or university of applied sciences), or equivalent proven technical expertise

Technical Skills:

• 5+ years of hands‑on experience with the FIX protocol, including deep knowledge of Order/Trade Flows, FIX-Engine and Frameworks

• Solid Linux proficiency

• Programming skills in at least one language: ESQL, Bash, Perl, Java

• Strong experience with MQ client/broker connectivity and related industry standards

• Proven expertise in developing integration solutions in a banking environment using: IBM MQ, IBM Integration Bus (IIB), IBM ACE

• Experience with client and exchange connectivity in financial markets

• Good understanding of key financial products (Equities, FX, Derivatives)

• Knowledge of SWIFT (ISO20022 / MT / MX) is considered an advantage

Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders

• Analytical mindset with structured problem‑solving capabilities

• Ability to work independently in both project environments and 24/7 operational settings

• Service‑oriented attitude and readiness to take ownership of technical issues

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a risk professional to support our Third-Party Risk Management unit. The Third Party Risk Management unit as second line of defence function maintains and develops the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) framework, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with the Risk Management Framework. This position reports to the Head of TPRM, who  is the Global Policy Owner (GPO) of third party risk-related policies as well as the Risk Type Owner (RTO) of the risk type “Third Party Management Risk (incl. intragroup services)”.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Support the end-to-end implementation and global rollout of the Group’s third-party risk management framework in line with the defined roadmap

• Define business use cases and functional requirements for IT implementations and AI-enabled solutions; design and execute test procedures for infrastructure upgrades and system migrations

• Assist the RTO in portfolio risk assessments, operational case reviews, control monitoring, and international regulatory reporting; drive timely follow-up on action items, incidents, and escalation flags

• Compile, validate, and prepare quantitative and qualitative reporting packages for committees and key stakeholders

• Maintain and update central documentation (Wiki pages, procedures, templates, intranet), develop training materials, and deliver training sessions to ensure consistent adoption across locations

• Coordinate stakeholder meetings, track progress on framework implementation, and conduct quality checks on resolution strategies and exit plans globally

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree or equivalent (preferably in economics / law)

• Broad and practical experience in non-financial risk management, with a minimum of 3-5 years within management consulting or accounting / law firm

• Sound knowledge of outsourcing/third party risk regulations and industry best practices

• Familiarity with ServiceNow for process automation, ticketing, and IT service management workflows.

• Able to formulate clear business requirements for IT implementations and AI use cases within  the TPRM related applications, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements .

• Strong “hands on” analytical and project delivery capabilities, with the ability to turn concepts into practical, implementable solutions

• Excellent PowerPoint and presentation skills

• Proven ability to rapidly learn new concepts and ideas, and integrate and assimilate information of various levels of complexity and relationships across broad, multifunctional content areas

• Self-motivated, team-oriented and hands-on personality

• Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

• Able to work under pressure and react positively in the face of change

• Fluency in German and English, any further language is an advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Nous cherchons un professionnel des risques pour soutenir notre unité de gestion des risques de tiers. L'unité de gestion des risques des tiers, en tant que deuxième ligne de la fonction de défense, maintient et élabore le cadre de gestion des risques des tiers, en veillant au respect des exigences réglementaires et à l'harmonisation avec le cadre de gestion des risques. Ce poste relève du responsable de TPRM, qui est le propriétaire de la politique mondiale (GPO) des politiques de tiers liées au risque ainsi que du propriétaire du type de risque (RTO) du type de risque --Risque de gestion de tiers (y compris les services intragroupes). VOTRE DÉFIS
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre de bout en bout et le déploiement global du cadre de gestion des risques des tiers du Groupe conformément à la feuille de route définie
• Définir des cas d'utilisation commerciale et des exigences fonctionnelles pour les implémentations informatiques et les solutions adaptées à l'IA; concevoir et exécuter des procédures d'essai pour les mises à niveau de l'infrastructure et les migrations de systèmes
• Aider l'OTR à évaluer les risques du portefeuille, à examiner les cas opérationnels, à surveiller le contrôle et à établir des rapports réglementaires internationaux; assurer un suivi en temps opportun des mesures à prendre, des incidents et des drapeaux d'escalade
• Compiler, valider et préparer des ensembles de rapports quantitatifs et qualitatifs pour les comités et les principaux intervenants
• Tenir à jour et mettre à jour la documentation centrale (pages Web, procédures, modèles, intranet), élaborer du matériel de formation et offrir des séances de formation pour assurer une adoption uniforme dans tous les lieux d ' affectation
• Coordonner les réunions des parties prenantes, suivre les progrès accomplis dans la mise en œuvre du cadre et effectuer des vérifications de la qualité des stratégies de résolution et des plans de sortie à l ' échelle mondiale VOTRE PROFIL

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

L'Assistente supporta il Team e i Relationship Manager (RM) con tutte le richieste di Intermediari & FO e finali sugli aspetti di trading e operativi - con l'obiettivo di garantire operazioni senza soluzione di continuità e risposte rapide, competenti e complete. Le responsabilità includono il posizionamento degli ordini, la gestione delle richieste dei clienti, l'esecuzione dei pagamenti e il posizionamento dei prestiti e dei depositi. L'accuratezza e la tempestività sono fondamentali, con una gestione efficace delle richieste e dell'erogazione dei dati, più l'escalation a colleghi senior, se necessario. Il RM si affida all'Assistente per aiutare a promuovere e servire gli e-channel dedicati agli Intermediari & FO e per elaborare le relative richieste e richieste.
L'Assistente è coinvolto nello scambio di informazioni in corso con RMs, oltre sia gli stakeholder interni che esterni in corso di business con i clienti. In quanto tali, sono un modello di ruolo per l'assistenza clienti professionale, competente e di alta qualità e la fondazione dei nostri team di successo Front.

LA TUA SICUREZZA
Amministrazione e gestione del cliente

• Supporta la RM e il team nell'interazione del cliente in tutti gli aspetti

• Partecipa alle chiamate in arrivo e prende azione rapida

• Mantiene e aggiorna i record di istruzioni, dettagli e preferenze del cliente. Crea report basati sul sistema per la RM

• Fornisce ai clienti informazioni e dati verbali e/o scritti, senza dare né consigli né alcuna dichiarazione di opinione come valutazione del valore

• Elabora gli ordini, gli scambi, le transazioni, il posizionamento dei pagamenti (e-channel esterni) e gestisce ed esegue le richieste dei clienti

• Aiuta a promuovere l'utilizzo e l'adozione dei nostri intermediari e canali FO dedicati

• Monitora l'elenco di scadenza per i depositi, i prestiti, i mestieri; agisce quando l'istruzione è standard, cerca istruzioni (da RM o cliente) se necessario e richiesto

Gestione aziendale

• Organizza e segue riunioni dei clienti, compresa la logistica e la preparazione dei documenti

• Supporta il RM nelle indagini e nella risoluzione dei problemi, mantenendo stretta collaborazione tra le banche-interne/unità

Gestione del rischio

• Aderenza completa in ogni momento alla conformità, linee guida legali, regole interne, regolamenti e politiche

• È una prima linea di difesa del rischio, attraverso l'aumento delle preoccupazioni, a seguito di problemi e l'escalation come necessario

Il tuo progetto
Abilità personali e sociali

• Eccellenti capacità organizzative, in grado di lavorare rapidamente, indipendentemente all'interno della portata RM Assistente e con precisione anche sotto pressione

• Proattivo, amichevole e soluzione- così come l'atteggiamento orientato al cliente

• Forte giocatore di squadra con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione

• Aspetto professionale e impatto

• Alta integrità personale e consapevolezza del rischio / mentalità etica

Professionista

• Conoscenze fondazionali dei mercati finanziari: struttura, funzione e ambiente legale/regolatorio e consapevolezza del settore

• Comprensione di base dei prodotti e dei servizi applicabili ai clienti EAM, oltre ai principi di valutazione

• Competenze linguistiche eccellenti (verbale e scritta) in italiano e inglese. Il tedesco è un bene

• Molto buone competenze di MS Office

Istruzione e esperienza

• Formazione rilevante (apprendistato bancario o equivalente) e background professionale (esperienza lavorativa nell'industria finanziaria)

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Der Assistent unterstützt das Team und die Relationship Manager (RMs) bei allen Intermediaries & FO- und Endkundenanfragen zu Handels- und Betriebsaspekten - mit dem Ziel, einen nahtlosen Betrieb und schnelle, kompetente und vollständige Antworten zu gewährleisten. Zu den Verantwortlichkeiten gehören Auftragserteilung, Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen, Zahlungsausführung und Platzierung von Krediten und Einlagen. Genauigkeit und Aktualität sind von größter Bedeutung, mit einer effektiven Bearbeitung von Anfragen und der Bereitstellung von Daten sowie einer Eskalation für ältere Kollegen, wo dies erforderlich ist. Die RM stützt sich auf den Assistenten, um die den Vermittlern & FO gewidmeten E-Kanäle zu fördern und zu warten und die damit verbundenen Anfragen und Anfragen zu bearbeiten.
Der Assistent ist am laufenden Informationsaustausch mit RMs sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern im Rahmen der Geschäfte mit den Kunden beteiligt. Als solche sind sie Vorbild für eine professionelle, kompetente und qualitativ hochwertige Kundenbetreuung und das Fundament unserer erfolgreichen Front-Teams.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNGEN
Kundenverwaltung & Management

• Unterstützt das RM und Team bei der Kundeninteraktion in jeder Hinsicht

• Beteiligt sich an eingehenden Anrufen und ergreift sofortige Maßnahmen

• Behält und aktualisiert Aufzeichnungen von Kundenanweisungen, Details und Präferenzen. Erstellt systembasierte Berichte für die RM

• Bietet Mandanten mündliche und/oder schriftliche Informationen und Daten und gibt weder Ratschläge noch eine Stellungnahme als Werturteil.

• Verarbeitet Aufträge, Geschäfte, Transaktionen, Zahlungsplatzierung (außerhalb von E-Kanälen) und bearbeitet und führt Kundenanfragen aus

• Hilft, die Nutzung und Annahme unserer dedizierten Intermediaries & FO E-Kanäle zu fördern

• Überwacht die Fälligkeitsliste für Einlagen, Kredite, Trades; ergreift Maßnahmen, bei denen die Anweisung standardmäßig ist, sucht Anweisungen (von RM oder Client), falls erforderlich und erforderlich

Unternehmensführung

• Organisiert und verfolgt Kundentreffen, einschließlich Logistik und Dokumentenvorbereitung

• Unterstützt die RM bei Untersuchungen und Troubleshooting und pflegt eine enge bankinterne team- und abteilungsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

Risikomanagement

• Vollständige Einhaltung von Compliance, gesetzlichen Richtlinien, internen Regeln, Vorschriften und Richtlinien

• Ist eine erste Linie der Risikoabwehr, indem Bedenken geäußert, Fragen verfolgt und bei Bedarf eskaliert

IHR PROFIL
Persönliche und soziale Fähigkeiten

• Hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten, in der Lage, schnell, unabhängig im Assistant RM-Bereich und auch unter Druck präzise zu arbeiten

• Proaktive, freundliche und lösungsorientierte sowie kundenorientierte Haltung

• Starker Teamplayer mit hervorragenden Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Professionelles Aussehen und wirkungsvoll

• Hohe persönliche Integrität und Risikobewusstsein / ethische Denkweise

Professionell

• Grundkenntnisse der Finanzmärkte: Struktur, Funktion und rechtliches / regulatorisches Umfeld sowie Branchenbewusstsein

• Grundlegendes Verständnis relevanter Produkte und Dienstleistungen für EAM-Kunden sowie Bewertungsgrundsätze

• Hervorragende Sprachkenntnisse (verbal und schriftlich) in Italienisch und Englisch. Deutsch ist ein Asset

• Sehr gute MS Office Fähigkeiten

Bildung & Erfahrung

• Relevante Ausbildung (Banklehre oder gleichwertig) und beruflicher Hintergrund (Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbranche)

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer de la valeur au-delà de la richesse. Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

L'adjoint appuie l'équipe et les gestionnaires de relations (GR) avec toutes les demandes d'Intermediaries & FO et de clients finals sur les aspects commerciaux et opérationnels - avec l'objectif d'assurer des opérations sans faille et des réponses rapides, compétentes et complètes. Les responsabilités comprennent le placement des commandes, le traitement des demandes des clients, l'exécution des paiements et le placement des prêts et des dépôts. L'exactitude et l'actualité sont primordiales, avec le traitement efficace des demandes de renseignements et de la fourniture de données, et l'escalade vers les collègues supérieurs au besoin. La RM compte sur l'adjoint pour aider à promouvoir et à desservir les canaux électroniques dédiés aux intermédiaires et au FO et pour traiter les demandes et les demandes connexes.
L'adjoint participe à l'échange continu d'information avec les RM, ainsi qu'avec les intervenants internes et externes dans le cadre des activités avec les clients. C'est donc un modèle de soins professionnels, compétents et de haute qualité pour nos clients et la base de nos équipes Front réussies.

VOTRE DÉFIS
Administration et gestion des clients

• Soutient la RM et l'équipe dans l'interaction client à tous égards

• Assister aux appels entrants et agir rapidement

• Tenir et mettre à jour les dossiers des instructions, des détails et des préférences des clients. Crée des rapports basés sur le système pour la RM

• Fournit aux clients des informations et des données verbales et/ou écrites, ne donnant aucun avis ni aucune déclaration d'opinion comme jugement de valeur

• Traitement des commandes, des métiers, des transactions, du placement des paiements (en dehors des canaux électroniques) et traitement et exécution des demandes des clients

• Aide à promouvoir l'utilisation et l'adoption de nos canaux électroniques dédiés Intermediaries & FO

• Surveille la liste des échéances pour les dépôts, les prêts, les transactions; prend des mesures lorsque l'instruction est standard, demande des instructions (à la RM ou au client) si nécessaire et nécessaire

Gestion d'entreprise

• Organiser et suivre les réunions des clients, y compris la logistique et la préparation des documents

• Soutient la RM dans les enquêtes et le dépannage, en maintenant une collaboration étroite entre les banques et les équipes/unités internes

Gestion des risques

• Respect intégral en tout temps de la conformité, des directives juridiques, des règles internes, des règlements et des politiques

• Est une première ligne de défense des risques, en soulevant des préoccupations, en assurant le suivi des questions et en intensifiant au besoin

VOTRE PROFIL
Compétences personnelles et sociales

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, capables de travailler rapidement, de manière indépendante dans le cadre de l'assistant RM et avec précision même sous pression

• Une attitude proactive, amicale et orientée vers le client

• Fort joueur d'équipe avec d'excellentes compétences en communication

• Aspect professionnel et impact

• Haute intégrité personnelle et conscience des risques/état d'esprit éthique

Professionnel

• Connaissance fondamentale des marchés financiers: structure, fonction et environnement juridique/réglementaire ainsi que sensibilisation de l'industrie

• Compréhension de base des produits et services pertinents applicables aux clients du MAE, plus les principes d'évaluation

• Excellentes compétences linguistiques (verbales et écrites) en italien et en anglais. L'allemand est un atout

• Très bonnes compétences en MS Office

Éducation et expérience

• Enseignement (apprentissage bancaire ou équivalent) et formation professionnelle (expérience professionnelle dans le secteur financier)

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As a member of the Private Banking Compliance team, you will act as a dedicated center of competence and Compliance contact for Intermediaries and Finders topics.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Performing Intermediaries and Finders onboarding and periodic reviews, including detailed risk assessments and review of Know Your Intermediary (KYI) profiles

• Supporting relationship managers and management in implementing, advising, and supervising Compliance matters related to Intermediaries and Finders

• Conducting Anti-Money Laundering (AML) investigations when necessary

• Reviewing local policies and procedures when required

• Identifying and investigating serious cases of non-compliance

• Collaborating with key stakeholders within and outside Compliance

• Instilling a Compliance culture in employees to mitigate legal, regulatory, sanctions, and reputational risks

• Supporting Compliance projects and following up on internal and regulatory audits

• Providing training and training materials on Intermediaries and Finders, Compliance and AML topics

• Support the team with Intermediaries and Finders related tasks as needed, including framework setting and methodology definition

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor's degree (preferably in law, economics, business administration, or a banking-related subject)

• 3-5 years of experience in Intermediaries (asset managers, family offices) Compliance and Risk Management, Audit, or Compliance functions

• Knowledge of the Swiss regulatory environment, particularly AML regulations, and client documentation standards

• Good knowledge of MS Office and a flair for IT

• Strong personality with good organizational, operational, and communication skills

• Ability to work under pressure, with excellent analytical, teamwork, and problem-solving skills

• Proficient in writing concise assessments, with a strong sense of integrity and discretion

• Independent, efficient, and meticulous work method, with solution-oriented thinking

• Fluency in English, with additional languages being an advantage

jobs.title: Human Resource Consultant 80 – 100% (Zurich)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are looking for a team-oriented Human Resource Consultant (f/m/d) to strengthen our consulting services we provide to our organization.

The HR Consulting Team is embedded in the HR organization, collaborating closely with various HR stakeholders such as HR Business Partners, Recruiting-, HR Support Specialists and other HR competence centers in the day-to-day business.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Responsible for delivering comprehensive HR consulting to line management and employees across a diverse workforce in Zurich

• Consulting, coaching and supporting line managers in performing their managerial and leadership function and the employees along the whole employee life cycle

• Fostering strong partnership with the business at all levels of the organisation, regular exchange with line management on HR key topics

• Handling of complex employee relation cases in close collaboration with our HR Legal department and other internal and external stakeholders

• Support recruiting through preparing search, selecting- and interviewing candidates, managing negotiations and onboarding employees

• Supporting HR Business Partners in implementing HR core processes such as Compensation-, Performance Review, Talent Management, reorganisations, etc. in close collaboration with other HR competence center (HR Support, Strategic Recruiting, Pension Fund, Payroll, Compensation)

• Redundancy and exit management: Supporting line managers and employees in all kinds of exit scenarios (resignations, low performer management, behavior related terminations, restructuring measurements based on social plan, termination agreements)

• Maintaining our core HR system “HR Connect” (Workday) and continuously develop own expertise in handling it

• Actively participating in HR projects

YOUR PROFILE

• Relevant educational and professional background, ideally in HR (e.g. Advanced Diploma in HR Management or Certificates in Advanced Studies in Human Capital Management)

• Several years of professional experience in a similar role (min. +5 years), preferably in financial sector

• Skilled and practiced in advising, coaching and recruiting

• Confident in dealing with senior-, line managers and employees of different personalities in an international environment

• Ability to build an internal network based on credibility and trust, integrity and discretion are essential

• Ability to react and adapt to a constantly changing and demanding environment and to deal with different cultures and backgrounds

• Natural team player, empathic and resilient personality, charisma, power of persuasion and good judgement skills

• In-depth knowledge in Swiss employment law

• Sophisticated verbal and written communication and presentation skills in English

• Proficient user of relevant IT systems (MS Office, Workday)

• La capacità di costruire una rete interna basata su credibilità e fiducia, integrità e discrezione sono essenziali

• Capacità di reagire e adattarsi a un ambiente in continua evoluzione e esigente e di affrontare culture e sfondi diversi

• Giocatore di squadra naturale, personalità empatica e resiliente, carisma, potere di persuasione e buone capacità di giudizio

• Conoscenza approfondita del diritto del lavoro svizzero

• Sofisticate capacità di comunicazione e presentazione verbali e scritte in inglese

• Utenti competenti di sistemi informatici rilevanti (MS Office, Workday)

• Traitement de cas complexes de relations de travail en étroite collaboration avec notre service juridique RH et d'autres intervenants internes et externes

• Appuyer le recrutement en préparant les candidats à la recherche, à la sélection et à l'entrevue, en gérant les négociations et les employés à bord

• Soutenir les partenaires opérationnels des RH dans la mise en oeuvre des processus de base des RH tels que la rémunération, l'examen du rendement, la gestion des talents, les réorganisations, etc., en étroite collaboration avec d'autres centres de compétences en RH (appui aux RH, recrutement stratégique, caisse de retraite, paie, rémunération)

• Redondance et gestion des départs: Soutenir les gestionnaires hiérarchiques et les employés dans tous les types de scénarios de sortie (résignations, gestion des bas performances, licenciements liés au comportement, mesures de restructuration basées sur le plan social, accords de résiliation)

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As an experienced banking accountant, you will play a key role within Financial Accounting, covering accounting activities for Lending, Banking Operations (including Client Corporate Actions), and Cash Desk. Acting as a trusted subject-matter expert, you will manage daily accounting tasks and actively drive the continuous improvement of accounting processes and systems.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Advice, development and monitoring of sub-ledgers within the relevant business areas

• Actively participate in projects aimed at optimising and automating accounting processes, including the definition of booking logics and data flows

• Collaborate in the preparation and analysis of financial statements and reports in accordance with IFRS and Swiss Banking GAAP (RVI)

• Provide expert support related to internal and external audits, and for reconciliations between finance systems and core banking platforms

• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across departments such as Group Tax, Management Accounting, IT Operations, and Payroll

• Participate in the testing, implementation, and rollout of new functionalities in SAP and core banking systems

• Support in ensuring data quality and further developing  internal controls. Analysis, specification, and optimisation of existing processes

• Provide training to employees and prepare user documentation (primarily in English)

• Support the individual locations worldwide from a financial accounting perspective

• Ensuring consistent adherence to internal control systems

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed financial or business administration education with further training in accounting (e.g. specialist certificate in finance and accounting, Bachelor/Master in Accounting or Banking & Finance)

• Several years of professional experience in bank accounting, preferably in the areas of lending, banking operations or corporate actions

• Experience with T24 or comparable core banking systems mandatory

• Sound knowledge of banking products, particularly in lending

• Good understanding of IFRS and Swiss Banking GAAP (RVI) is an advantage

• Project experience with SAP and use of SAP is an advantage

• Sound handling of MS Office programmes

• Very good English language skills, both written and spoken. Fluency in German is an advantage

• Strong analytical skills as well as independent and meticulous  work approach

• Team-oriented personality with strong communication skills and resilience

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
